## File: dev/active/harmonic-jumping-crescent.md
````markdown
   1: # Blazor Enterprise Refactoring - ISLAMU Event
   2: 
   3: ## Executive Summary
   4: 
   5: Transform the ISLAMU Event Blazor frontend into an enterprise-grade application that fully utilizes all API capabilities. This plan addresses critical architectural issues, implements missing features, and establishes production-ready patterns.
   6: 
   7: **Scope**: 45+ entities, 180+ DTOs, complete event lifecycle management, organization workflows, and advanced filtering.
   8: 
   9: **Timeline**: 40-60 hours of focused implementation.
  10: 
  11: **Outcome**: Production-ready, maintainable, enterprise-grade Blazor WASM+Server application.
  12: 
  13: ---
  14: 
  15: ## Critical Issues Identified
  16: 
  17: ### 🔴 High Priority (Breaks Core Functionality)
  18: 
  19: 1. **Event Editing Broken**
  20:    - Sessions not updated when editing event
  21:    - Categories/tags not persisted on update
  22:    - New sessions added in editor but ignored on save
  23:    - **Impact**: Cannot modify events after creation
  24: 
  25: 2. **Event Session Management**
  26:    - Sessions created AFTER event (not atomic)
  27:    - No rollback if session creation fails
  28:    - Cannot edit existing sessions in event edit flow
  29:    - **Impact**: Data inconsistency, orphaned events
  30: 
  31: 3. **Hard-coded TenantId**
  32:    - `Guid.Parse("00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001")` in CreateEvent
  33:    - Should come from authenticated user context
  34:    - **Impact**: Multi-tenancy broken, security issue
  35: 
  36: 4. **No State Management**
  37:    - UserId extracted multiple times
  38:    - TenantId hard-coded
  39:    - No global auth context
  40:    - **Impact**: Maintainability nightmare
  41: 
  42: ### 🟡 Medium Priority (Missing Features)
  43: 
  44: 5. **Organization Member Management**
  45:    - API has full invitation workflow
  46:    - No UI for invitations, member roles, positions
  47:    - **Impact**: Cannot manage organization teams
  48: 
  49: 6. **Advanced Event Filtering**
  50:    - API supports filtering by madhab, age, gender, language, location
  51:    - UI only implements basic filters
  52:    - **Impact**: Poor discovery experience
  53: 
  54: 7. **Lookup Table Management**
  55:    - No admin UI for EventTypes, Formats, Statuses, Languages, etc.
  56:    - **Impact**: Cannot configure system without DB access
  57: 
  58: 8. **Registration Flow Incomplete**
  59:    - Approval workflow not implemented
  60:    - No registration status tracking
  61:    - **Impact**: Manual events cannot use approval system
  62: 
  63: ### 🟢 Low Priority (Optimization)
  64: 
  65: 9. **HTTP Client Anti-Pattern**
  66:    - ImageStorageService creates new HttpClient per upload
  67:    - Should use IHttpClientFactory
  68:    - **Impact**: Socket exhaustion risk
  69: 
  70: 10. **Sequential Operations**
  71:     - Category/tag assignment loops sequentially
  72:     - Should parallelize after event creation
  73:     - **Impact**: Slow event creation
  74: 
  75: ---
  76: 
  77: ## MudBlazor 7 Best Practices Integration
  78: 
  79: Based on latest MudBlazor documentation, we'll follow these patterns:
  80: 
  81: **Form Validation**:
  82: ```razor
  83: <EditForm Model="@model" OnValidSubmit="OnValidSubmit">
  84:     <DataAnnotationsValidator/>
  85:     <MudTextField @bind-Value="model.Title" For="@(() => model.Title)" Label="Title" />
  86:     <ValidationSummary />
  87: </EditForm>
  88: ```
  89: 
  90: **Dialog Pattern**:
  91: ```csharp
  92: var parameters = new DialogParameters<MyDialog>
  93: {
  94:     { x => x.ContentText, "Dialog content" },
  95:     { x => x.Data, myData }
  96: };
  97: var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<MyDialog>("Title", parameters);
  98: var result = await dialog.Result;
  99: ```
 100: 
 101: **Code-Behind Pattern** (Recommended for complex components):
 102: ```csharp
 103: // Component.razor
 104: @inherits ComponentBase
 105: @code { /* minimal inline code */ }
 106: 
 107: // Component.razor.cs
 108: public partial class Component : ComponentBase
 109: {
 110:     [Inject] private IService Service { get; set; }
 111:     // All logic here
 112: }
 113: ```
 114: 
 115: **EventCallback Usage**:
 116: ```csharp
 117: [Parameter] public EventCallback<T> OnDataChanged { get; set; }
 118: await OnDataChanged.InvokeAsync(data);
 119: ```
 120: 
 121: ---
 122: 
 123: ## Implementation Strategy
 124: 
 125: ### Phase 1: Foundation & Architecture (8-12 hours)
 126: 
 127: **Goal**: Fix critical architectural issues, establish enterprise patterns.
 128: 
 129: #### 1.1 State Management Foundation
 130: **Files to Create/Modify**:
 131: - `Explore.Blazor.Client/Services/AuthStateService.cs` (new)
 132: - `Explore.Blazor.Client/Providers/TenantContextProvider.cs` (new)
 133: - `Explore.Blazor/Components/App.razor` (modify)
 134: 
 135: **Implementation**:
 136: ```csharp
 137: // AuthStateService.cs - Central auth state management
 138: public class AuthStateService
 139: {
 140:     private readonly IHttpContextAccessor _httpContextAccessor;
 141: 
 142:     public async Task<string> GetCurrentUserIdAsync()
 143:     {
 144:         // Fallback chain: sub → nameidentifier → sid
 145:         return userId ?? throw new UnauthorizedException();
 146:     }
 147: 
 148:     public async Task<Guid> GetCurrentTenantIdAsync()
 149:     {
 150:         // Extract from claims or tenant context
 151:         return tenantId;
 152:     }
 153: }
 154: 
 155: // TenantContextProvider.razor - Cascading parameter provider
 156: <CascadingValue Value="@tenantContext">
 157:     @ChildContent
 158: </CascadingValue>
 159: ```
 160: 
 161: **Acceptance Criteria**:
 162: - ✅ TenantId/UserId extracted once per request
 163: - ✅ Available via DI or cascading parameter
 164: - ✅ No hard-coded GUIDs anywhere
 165: - ✅ Unauthorized users redirected to login

 167: ---
 168: 
 169: #### 1.2 Fix HTTP Client Pattern
 170: **Files to Modify**:
 171: - `Explore.Blazor.Client/Services/ImageStorageService.cs`
 172: - `Explore.Blazor/Program.cs`
 173: 
 174: **Implementation**:
 175: ```csharp
 176: // Program.cs - Register named HTTP client
 177: builder.Services.AddHttpClient("S3Upload", client => {
 178:     client.Timeout = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5);
 179: });
 180: 
 181: // ImageStorageService.cs
 182: private readonly IHttpClientFactory _httpClientFactory;
 183: 
 184: public async Task<bool> UploadImageAsync(string uploadUrl, IBrowserFile file)
 185: {
 186:     using var s3Client = _httpClientFactory.CreateClient("S3Upload");
 187:     // ... upload logic
 188: }
 189: ```
 190: 
 191: **Acceptance Criteria**:
 192: - ✅ IHttpClientFactory used for all HTTP calls

 195: 
 196: ---
 197: 
 198: #### 1.3 Service Layer Refactoring
 199: **Files to Create/Modify**:
 200: - `Explore.Blazor.Client/Services/EventOrchestrationService.cs` (new)
 201: - `Explore.Blazor.Client/Services/EventService.cs` (modify)
 202: 
 203: **Implementation**:
 204: ```csharp
 205: // EventOrchestrationService.cs - Handle complex multi-step operations
 206: public class EventOrchestrationService
 207: {
 208:     public async Task<CreateEventResult> CreateCompleteEventAsync(
 209:         CreateEventDto eventDto,
 210:         List<SessionEditorModel> sessions,
 211:         List<Guid> categoryIds,
 212:         List<Guid> tagIds,
 213:         IBrowserFile? featuredImage)
 214:     {
 215:         // Transactional orchestration:
 216:         // 1. Upload image (if provided)
 217:         // 2. Create event
 218:         // 3. Create sessions IN PARALLEL
 219:         // 4. Assign categories/tags IN PARALLEL
 220:         // 5. Rollback on any failure
 221: 
 222:         try
 223:         {
 224:             // ... implementation
 225:         }
 226:         catch (Exception ex)
 227:         {
 228:             // Rollback created entities
 229:             await RollbackEventAsync(createdEventId);
 230:             throw;
 231:         }
 232:     }
 233: }
 234: ```
 235: 
 236: **Acceptance Criteria**:
 237: - ✅ Event + sessions created atomically
 238: - ✅ Rollback on failure
 239: - ✅ Categories/tags assigned in parallel
 240: - ✅ Clear separation of concerns
 241: 
 242: ---
 243: 
 244: ### Phase 2: Event Management Fixes (10-15 hours)
 245: 
 246: #### 2.1 Fix Event Creation Flow
 247: **Files to Modify**:
 248: - `Explore.Blazor.Client/Pages/Event/CreateEvent.razor`
 249: - `Explore.Blazor.Client/Pages/Event/CreateEvent.razor.cs` (create code-behind)
 250: 
 251: **Implementation**:

 253: // CreateEvent.razor.cs

 285: #### 2.2 Fix Event Editing Flow
 286: **Files to Modify**:

 288: - `Explore.Blazor.Client/Pages/Event/EventEdit.razor.cs` (create code-behind)

 903: 3. Verify IHttpClientFactory used for all HTTP calls
 904: 4. Build succeeds with no warnings

 906: ### After Phase 2 (Event Management)
 907: 1. Create event with 3 sessions → verify all sessions saved
 908: 2. Edit event → add session → verify session persisted
 909: 3. Edit event → delete session → verify session removed
 910: 4. Update event categories/tags → verify changes saved
 911: 5. Create event without image → verify default image used

 913: ### After Phase 3 (Organization)
 914: 1. Invite user to organization → verify invitation created
 915: 2. Accept invitation → verify user added as member
 916: 3. Update member role → verify role changed
 917: 4. Remove member → verify member removed

 919: ### After Phase 4 (Discovery)
 920: 1. Filter by madhab → verify correct events shown
 921: 2. Filter by audience age → verify correct events shown
 922: 3. Combine filters → verify AND logic works
 923: 4. Clear filters → verify all events shown

 926: 1. Register for event → verify registration created

 929: 4. Organizer rejects → verify status updated

 950: ## Risk Mitigation
 951: 
 952: ### Data Loss Prevention
 953: - Implement undo/redo for form changes
 954: - Auto-save drafts to localStorage
 955: - Confirmation dialogs for destructive actions
 956: - Soft-delete pattern for events (archive instead of hard delete)
 957: 
 958: ### Performance Optimization
 959: - Lazy loading for large datasets
 960: - Virtual scrolling for long lists
 961: - Debounce search inputs (500ms)
 962: - Parallel API calls where possible
 963: - Cache lookup tables (1 hour TTL)
 964: 
 965: ### Security Considerations

## File: dev/active/README.md
````markdown
  1: # Dev Docs Pattern
  2: 
  3: A methodology for maintaining project context across Claude Code sessions and context resets.
  4: 
  5: ---
  6: 
  7: ## The Problem
  8: 
  9: **Context resets lose everything:**
 10: - Implementation decisions
 11: - Key files and their purposes
 12: - Task progress
 13: - Technical constraints
 14: - Why certain approaches were chosen
 15: 
 16: **After a reset, Claude has to rediscover everything.**
 17: 
 18: ---
 19: 
 20: ## The Solution: Persistent Dev Docs
 21: 
 22: A three-file structure that captures everything needed to resume work:
 23: 
 24: ```
 25: dev/active/[task-name]/
 26: ├── [task-name]-plan.md      # Strategic plan
 27: ├── [task-name]-context.md   # Key decisions & files
 28: └── [task-name]-tasks.md     # Checklist format
 29: ```
 30: 
 31: **These files survive context resets** - Claude reads them to get back up to speed instantly.
 32: 
 33: ---
 34: 
 35: ## Three-File Structure
 36: 
 37: ### 1. [task-name]-plan.md
 38: 
 39: **Purpose:** Strategic plan for the implementation
 40: 
 41: **Contains:**
 42: - Executive summary
 43: - Current state analysis
 44: - Proposed future state
 45: - Implementation phases
 46: - Detailed tasks with acceptance criteria
 47: - Risk assessment
 48: - Success metrics
 49: - Timeline estimates
 50: 
 51: **When to create:** At the start of a complex task
 52: 
 53: **When to update:** When scope changes or new phases discovered
 54: 
 55: **Example:**
 56: ```markdown
 57: # Feature Name - Implementation Plan
 58: 
 59: ## Executive Summary
 60: What we're building and why
 61: 
 62: ## Current State
 63: Where we are now
 64: 
 65: ## Implementation Phases
 66: 
 67: ### Phase 1: Infrastructure (2 hours)
 68: - Task 1.1: Set up database schema
 69:   - Acceptance: Schema compiles, relationships correct
 70: - Task 1.2: Create service structure
 71:   - Acceptance: All directories created
 72: 
 73: ### Phase 2: Core Functionality (3 hours)
 74: ...
 75: ```
 76: 
 77: ---
 78: 
 79: ### 2. [task-name]-context.md
 80: 
 81: **Purpose:** Key information for resuming work
 82: 
 83: **Contains:**
 84: - SESSION PROGRESS section (updated frequently!)
 85: - What's completed vs in-progress
 86: - Key files and their purposes
 87: - Important decisions made
 88: - Technical constraints discovered
 89: - Links to related files
 90: - Quick resume instructions
 91: 
 92: **When to create:** Start of task
 93: 
 94: **When to update:** **FREQUENTLY** - after major decisions, completions, or discoveries
 95: 
 96: **Example:**
 97: ```markdown
 98: # Feature Name - Context
 99: 
100: ## SESSION PROGRESS (2025-10-29)
101: 
102: ### ✅ COMPLETED
103: - Refactoring StatusType related classes (renamed StatusType to ApprovalStatus in all api layers of clean architecture)
104: 
105: ### 🟡 IN PROGRESS
106: - Creating example
107: - File: example/example.cs
108: 
109: ### ⚠️ BLOCKERS
110: - Need to decide on example
111: 
112: ## Key Files
113: 
114: **example/Controllers/ExampleController.cs**
115: - Extends example
116: - Handles HTTP requests for posts
117: - Delegates to example
118: 
119: **example/Controllers/Example2Controller.cs** (IN PROGRESS)
120: - Business logic for post operations
121: - Next: Add caching
122: 
123: ## Quick Resume
124: To continue:
125: 1. Read this file
126: 2. Continue implementing example
127: 3. See tasks file for remaining work
128: ```
129: 
130: **CRITICAL:** Update the SESSION PROGRESS section every time significant work is done!
131: 
132: ---
133: 
134: ### 3. [task-name]-tasks.md
135: 
136: **Purpose:** Checklist for tracking progress
137: 
138: **Contains:**
139: - Phases broken down by logical sections
140: - Tasks in checkbox format
141: - Status indicators (✅/🟡/⏳)
142: - Acceptance criteria
143: - Quick resume section
144: 
145: **When to create:** Start of task
146: 
147: **When to update:** After completing each task or discovering new tasks
148: 
149: **Example:**
150: ```markdown
151: # Feature Name - Task Checklist
152: 
153: ## Phase 1: Setup ✅ COMPLETE
154: - [x] Create example
155: - [x] Set up controllers
156: - [x] Configure example
157: 
158: ## Phase 2: Implementation 🟡 IN PROGRESS
159: - [x] Create ExampleController
160: - [ ] Create Example2Controller (IN PROGRESS)
161: - [ ] Create ExampleRepository
162: - [ ] Add validation
163: 
164: ## Phase 3: Testing ⏳ NOT STARTED
165: - [ ] Unit tests for service
166: - [ ] Integration tests
167: - [ ] Manual API testing
168: ```
169: 
170: ---
171: 
172: ## When to Use Dev Docs
173: 
174: **Use for:**
175: - ✅ Complex multi-day tasks
176: - ✅ Features with many moving parts
177: - ✅ Tasks likely to span multiple sessions
178: - ✅ Work that needs careful planning
179: - ✅ Refactoring large systems
180: 
181: **Skip for:**
182: - ❌ Simple bug fixes
183: - ❌ Single-file changes
184: - ❌ Quick updates
185: - ❌ Trivial modifications
186: 
187: **Rule of thumb:** If it takes more than 2 hours or spans multiple sessions, use dev docs.
188: 
189: ---
190: 
191: ## Workflow with Dev Docs
192: 
193: ### Starting a New Task
194: 
195: 1. **Use /dev-docs slash command:**
196:    ```
197:    /dev-docs refactor authentication system
198:    ```
199: 
200: 2. **Claude creates the three files:**
201:    - Analyzes requirements
202:    - Examines codebase
203:    - Creates comprehensive plan
204:    - Generates context and tasks files
205: 
206: 3. **Review and adjust:**
207:    - Check if plan makes sense
208:    - Add any missing considerations
209:    - Adjust timeline estimates
210: 
211: ### During Implementation
212: 
213: 1. **Refer to plan** for overall strategy
214: 2. **Update context.md** frequently:
215:    - Mark completed work
216:    - Note decisions made
217:    - Add blockers
218: 3. **Check off tasks** in tasks.md as you complete them
219: 
220: ### After Context Reset
221: 
222: 1. **Claude reads all three files**
223: 2. **Understands complete state** in seconds
224: 3. **Resumes exactly where you left off**
225: 
226: No need to explain what you were doing - it's all documented!
227: 
228: ---
229: 
230: ## Integration with Slash Commands
231: 
232: ### /dev-docs
233: **Creates:** New dev docs for a task
234: 
235: **Usage:**
236: ```
237: /dev-docs implement real-time notifications
238: ```
239: 
240: **Generates:**
241: - `dev/active/implement-real-time-notifications/`
242:   - implement-real-time-notifications-plan.md
243:   - implement-real-time-notifications-context.md
244:   - implement-real-time-notifications-tasks.md
245: 
246: ### /dev-docs-update
247: **Updates:** Existing dev docs before context reset
248: 
249: **Usage:**
250: ```
251: /dev-docs-update
252: ```
253: 
254: **Updates:**
255: - Marks completed tasks
256: - Adds new tasks discovered
257: - Updates context with session progress
258: - Captures current state
259: 
260: **Use when:** Approaching context limits or ending session
261: 
262: ---
263: 
264: ## File Organization
265: 
266: ```
267: dev/
268: ├── README.md              # This file
269: ├── active/                # Current work
270: │   ├── task-1/
271: │   │   ├── task-1-plan.md
272: │   │   ├── task-1-context.md
273: │   │   └── task-1-tasks.md
274: │   └── task-2/
275: │       └── ...
276: └── archive/               # Completed work (optional)
277:     └── old-task/
278:         └── ...
279: ```
280: 
281: **active/**: Work in progress
282: **archive/**: Completed tasks (for reference)
283: 
284: ---
285: 
286: ## Example: Real Usage
287: 
288: See **dev/active/public-infrastructure-repo/** in this repository for a real example:
289: - **plan.md** - 700+ line strategic plan for creating this showcase
290: - **context.md** - Tracks what's completed, decisions made, what's next
291: - **tasks.md** - Checklist of all phases and tasks
292: 
293: This is the actual dev docs used to build this showcase!
294: 
295: ---
296: 
297: ## Best Practices
298: 
299: ### Update Context Frequently
300: 
301: **Bad:** Update only at end of session
302: **Good:** Update after each major milestone
303: 
304: **SESSION PROGRESS section should always reflect reality:**
305: ```markdown
306: ## SESSION PROGRESS (YYYY-MM-DD)
307: 
308: ### ✅ COMPLETED (list everything done)
309: ### 🟡 IN PROGRESS (what you're working on RIGHT NOW)
310: ### ⚠️ BLOCKERS (what's preventing progress)
311: ```
312: 
313: ### Make Tasks Actionable
314: 
315: **Bad:** "Fix the authentication"
316: **Good:** "Implement JWT token validation in AuthMiddleware.ts (Acceptance: Tokens validated, errors to Sentry)"
317: 
318: **Include:**
319: - Specific file names
320: - Clear acceptance criteria
321: - Dependencies on other tasks
322: 
323: ### Keep Plan Current
324: 
325: If scope changes:
326: - Update the plan
327: - Add new phases
328: - Adjust timeline estimates
329: - Note why scope changed
330: 
331: ---
332: 
333: ## For Claude Code
334: 
335: **When user asks to create dev docs:**
336: 
337: 1. **Use the /dev-docs slash command** if available
338: 2. **Or create manually:**
339:    - Ask about the task scope
340:    - Analyze relevant codebase files
341:    - Create comprehensive plan
342:    - Generate context and tasks
343: 
344: 3. **Structure the plan with:**
345:    - Clear phases
346:    - Actionable tasks
347:    - Acceptance criteria
348:    - Risk assessment
349: 
350: 4. **Make context file resumable:**
351:    - SESSION PROGRESS at top
352:    - Quick resume instructions
353:    - Key files list with explanations
354: 
355: **When resuming from dev docs:**
356: 
357: 1. **Read all three files** (plan, context, tasks)
358: 2. **Start with context.md** - has current state
359: 3. **Check tasks.md** - see what's done and what's next
360: 4. **Refer to plan.md** - understand overall strategy
361: 
362: **Update frequently:**
363: - Mark tasks complete immediately
364: - Update SESSION PROGRESS after significant work
365: - Add new tasks as discovered
366: 
367: ---
368: 
369: ## Creating Dev Docs Manually
370: 
371: If you don't have the /dev-docs command:
372: 
373: **1. Create directory:**
374: ```bash
375: mkdir -p dev/active/your-task-name
376: ```
377: 
378: **2. Create plan.md:**
379: - Executive summary
380: - Implementation phases
381: - Detailed tasks
382: - Timeline estimates
383: 
384: **3. Create context.md:**
385: - SESSION PROGRESS section
386: - Key files
387: - Important decisions
388: - Quick resume instructions
389: 
390: **4. Create tasks.md:**
391: - Phases with checkboxes
392: - [ ] Task format
393: - Acceptance criteria
394: 
395: ---
396: 
397: ## Benefits
398: 
399: **Before dev docs:**
400: - Context reset = start over
401: - Forget why decisions were made
402: - Lose track of progress
403: - Repeat work
404: 
405: **After dev docs:**
406: - Context reset = read 3 files, resume instantly
407: - Decisions documented
408: - Progress tracked
409: - No repeated work
410: 
411: **Time saved:** Hours per context reset
412: 
413: ---
````

````markdown
  1: # S3 Object Storage Abstraction - Context
  2: 
  3: ## SESSION PROGRESS (2026-02-11)
  4: 
  5: ### Completed
  6: - Full research of current S3 implementation (all files read and analyzed)
  7: - Web research on S3-compatible providers, multi-tenant patterns, credential storage
  8: - Codebase exploration agent completed with comprehensive gap analysis
  9: - Plan document created with 7 phases
 10: - Research report on private/public buckets, archive tiers, WASM/SSR considerations
 11: - Context and tasks files created
 12: - Phase 1: Created `S3Configuration` POCO and `IS3ConfigResolver` interface
 13: - Phase 2: Added 8 S3 governance setting keys to `GovernanceSettingKeys.cs`
 14: - Phase 3: Added 8 seed IDs (0530-0537) and 8 SystemSetting seed entries
 15: - Phase 4: Implemented `S3ConfigResolver` in `Infrastructure/Storage/`
 16: - Phase 5: Refactored `ObjectStorageService` to use `IS3ConfigResolver`, updated DI, added `TestConnectionAsync`, updated `GeneratePresignedDownloadUrl` to `Task<string>` and all 15 callers
 17: - Phase 6: Created 13 unit tests in `S3ConfigResolverTests.cs` — all 203 app unit tests pass
 18: - Phase 7: Updated `CODEBASE_STRUCTURE.md`, updated dev docs
 19: 
 20: ### Blockers
 21: - None
 22: 
 23: ---
 24: 
 25: ## Key Decisions
 26: 
 27: 1. **Mirror email pattern exactly** — Same architecture as SmtpConfigResolver (ISettingsResolver cascade, IMemoryCache, per-tenant resolution)
 28: 2. **Keep IObjectStorageService interface unchanged** — All 23+ consumer files don't need changes
 29: 3. **No public bucket support** — Private + presigned URLs is sufficient (YAGNI)
 30: 4. **No archive tiers** — Not supported by all providers; premature optimization
 31: 5. **ForcePathStyle defaults to true** — Required by most non-AWS providers (Hetzner, MinIO, B2, R2)
 32: 6. **Cache IAmazonS3 client per tenant in resolver** — Avoid creating TCP connections per request
 33: 7. **Keep env var bootstrap** — S3Settings.cs stays during transition; env vars populate initial seed data
 34: 8. **S3 seed IDs use range 0530-0537** — After email range 0520-0528
 35: 
 36: ## Key Files
 37: 
 38: ### Current Implementation (To Be Refactored)
 39: 
 40: **`Explore.Infrastructure/Services/ObjectStorageService.cs`**
 41: - Main S3 service implementation
 42: - Uses singleton `IAmazonS3` client + `IOptions<S3Settings>`
 43: - Has `_presignClient` for PublicEndpoint presigned URLs
 44: - Hardcoded 40-min upload URL expiration
 45: - **Will be refactored** to use `IS3ConfigResolver` instead
 46: 
 47: **`Explore.Infrastructure/S3Settings.cs`**
 48: - Simple 6-property POCO (Region, BucketName, AccessKeyId, SecretAccessKey, Endpoint, PublicEndpoint)
 49: - Located in Infrastructure layer (should be Application for Clean Architecture)
 50: - **Will be superseded** by `S3Configuration` in Application/Models but kept for env var bootstrap
 51: 
 52: **`Explore.Infrastructure/InfrastructureServicesRegistration.cs`** (lines 29-78)
 53: - Singleton `IAmazonS3` client factory with complex endpoint logic
 54: - Transient `IObjectStorageService` registration
 55: - **Will be simplified** to scoped `IS3ConfigResolver` + scoped service
 56: 
 57: **`Explore.Application/Contracts/Infrastructure/IObjectStorageService.cs`**
 58: - 3 methods: GeneratePresignedUploadUrl, GeneratePresignedDownloadUrl, GetFileStream
 59: - **Minor change**: Add `TestConnectionAsync` method
 60: 
 61: ### Reference Pattern (Email — Already Implemented)
 62: 
 63: **`Explore.Infrastructure/Mail/SmtpConfigResolver.cs`**
 64: - The exact pattern to replicate for S3
 65: - Uses `ISettingsResolver`, `ITenantContext`, `IMemoryCache`
 66: - 5-min cache with `SmtpConfig:{tenantId}` key
 67: - Returns null if host is empty → S3 equivalent: return null if endpoint is empty
 68: 
 69: **`Explore.Application/Contracts/Infrastructure/ISmtpConfigResolver.cs`**
 70: - Interface: `ResolveAsync()` + `InvalidateCache(Guid?)`
 71: - S3 will have identical interface shape
 72: 
 73: **`Explore.Application/Models/SmtpConfiguration.cs`**
 74: - Clean POCO with all config properties
 75: - S3 equivalent will have: Region, BucketName, AccessKeyId, SecretAccessKey, Endpoint, PublicEndpoint, ForcePathStyle, UploadUrlExpirationMinutes
 76: 
 77: **`Explore.Domain/Constants/GovernanceSettingKeys.cs`**
 78: - Has email keys (Email*) at the bottom
 79: - S3 keys will be added in new section below email
 80: 
 81: **`Explore.Persistence/Seed/SeedIds.cs`**
 82: - Email IDs: 0520-0528
 83: - S3 IDs: 0530-0537
 84: 
 85: **`Explore.Persistence/Seed/LookupTableSeeder.cs`**
 86: - Contains `SeedSystemSettings()` method with all SystemSetting entries
 87: - S3 entries will be added at the end with Category = "ObjectStorage"
 88: 
 89: ### Consumers (No Changes Needed)
 90: 
 91: - `StorageObjectController.cs` — API endpoints
 92: - 4 CQRS handlers in `Features/StorageObjects/Handlers/`
 93: - `ImageStorageService.cs` — Blazor client
 94: - `StorageObjectRepository.cs` — persistence
 95: 
 96: ### Test Files (To Be Created)
 97: 
 98: - `Event.Application.UnitTests/Infrastructure/S3ConfigResolverTests.cs` — new
 99: 
100: ## Provider Compatibility Notes
101: 
102: - **Hetzner** (current): `ServiceURL=https://fsn1.your-objectstorage.com`, ForcePathStyle=true, AuthenticationRegion="fsn1"
103: - **MinIO** (Docker dev): `ServiceURL=http://localhost:9000`, ForcePathStyle=true
104: - **AWS S3**: Use `RegionEndpoint` (not ServiceURL), ForcePathStyle=false
105: - **Critical**: Never set both `ServiceURL` and `RegionEndpoint` — throws `AmazonClientException`
106: 
107: ## Quick Resume
108: 
109: To continue:
110: 1. Read this file for current state
111: 2. Read `s3-storage-abstraction-tasks.md` for checklist
112: 3. Start with Phase 1 (Application layer)
113: 4. Build after each phase to catch errors early
114: 5. Run tests after Phase 6
````

## File: docs/MULTI_TENANCY.md
````markdown
  1: # Multi-Tenancy Architecture
  2: 
  3: > **Conceptual Guide for Multi-Tenant System Design**
  4: >
  5: > This document describes the multi-tenancy model, authority hierarchy, and data isolation patterns.
  6: > For implementation details and code patterns, see the relevant skills in `.claude/skills/`.
  7: 
  8: **Last Updated**: January 2026
  9: 
 10: ---
 11: 
 12: ## Overview
 13: 
 14: The platform operates as a **multi-tenant system** where multiple independent organizations (tenants) share the same application infrastructure while maintaining complete data isolation. The architecture supports both dedicated single-tenant deployments and shared multi-tenant SaaS models.
 15: 
 16: ---
 17: 
 18: ## Hierarchy of Authority
 19: 
 20: ### Two-Tier Administration Model
 21: 
 22: The system distinguishes between two fundamentally different administrative roles:
 23: 
 24: | Tier | Role | Scope | Typical Use Case |
 25: |------|------|-------|------------------|
 26: | **Tier 1** | Instance Administrator | Infrastructure, global policies, module enablement | SaaS provider, IT department |
 27: | **Tier 2** | Tenant Administrator | Community data, local configuration, user management | Organization leader, community admin |
 28: 
 29: ### Instance Administrator (Super Admin)
 30: 
 31: **Responsibilities:**
 32: - Physical server and infrastructure management
 33: - Global resource limits and quotas
 34: - Module enablement/disablement at platform level
 35: - Enforcement policies that cannot be overridden
 36: - Tenant provisioning and lifecycle management
 37: - System-wide security policies
 38: 
 39: **Cannot Do:**
 40: - Access tenant-specific business data
 41: - Make decisions on behalf of tenants
 42: - Override tenant preferences within allowed bounds
 43: 
 44: ### Tenant Administrator (Customer)
 45: 
 46: **Responsibilities:**
 47: - Community-specific configuration
 48: - User management within their tenant
 49: - Branding and customization
 50: - Local business rules and workflows
 51: - Content moderation policies
 52: 
 53: **Constrained By:**
 54: - Instance-level enforcement policies
 55: - Module availability set by Instance Admin
 56: - Resource quotas and limits
 57: 
 58: ---
 59: 
 60: ## Cascading Configuration Engine
 61: 
 62: ### Resolution Strategy
 63: 
 64: Settings are resolved at runtime using a **fall-through strategy**:
 65: 
 66: 1. **Check Tenant Override** → Does the tenant have a specific value?
 67: 2. **Check Instance Enforcement** → Is this setting locked by the Instance Admin?
 68: 3. **Fall to Default** → Use the system default value
 69: 
 70: ### Setting Types
 71: 
 72: | Type | Behavior | Example |
 73: |------|----------|---------|
 74: | **Locked** | Tenant cannot override | Security policies, payment provider |
 75: | **Delegated** | Tenant may customize | Theme colors, notification preferences |
 76: | **Default-Only** | System default, no UI exposed | Internal technical settings |
 77: 
 78: ### Enforcement Scenarios
 79: 
 80: **Scenario: Render Mode Control**
 81: - Instance Admin sets `RenderMode = Auto` with `IsLocked = false`
 82: - Tenant Admin sees a dropdown and can change to `Server` or `WebAssembly`
 83: - If Instance Admin sets `IsLocked = true`, dropdown is disabled/hidden
 84: 
 85: **Scenario: Module Restriction**
 86: - Instance Admin configures `AllowedModules = ["Core", "Islamic"]`
 87: - Tenant Admin cannot enable "Tech" module even if code exists
 88: - Tenant only sees modules within their allowed set
 89: 
 90: ---
 91: 
 92: ## Data Isolation
 93: 
 94: ### Tenant Boundary Enforcement
 95: 
 96: Every tenant-scoped entity implements `ITenantEntity`:
 97: - Contains `TenantId` property
 98: - Automatically filtered in all queries via global query filters
 99: - Cannot be accidentally accessed across tenant boundaries
100: 
101: ### Isolation Guarantees
102: 
103: | Layer | Mechanism |
104: |-------|-----------|
105: | **Database** | Global query filters on `TenantId` |
106: | **Application** | Tenant context injected per-request |
107: | **API** | Middleware validates tenant claims |
108: | **UI** | Routes scoped to tenant context |
109: 
110: ### Cross-Tenant Operations
111: 
112: Cross-tenant operations are **explicitly forbidden** except:
113: - Instance Admin reporting and analytics
114: - System-wide notifications (opt-in)
115: - Federation sync (ATProto/ActivityPub)
116: 
117: ---
118: 
119: ## Tenant Lifecycle
120: 
121: ### Provisioning Flow
122: 
123: 1. **Request** → Tenant Admin requests new tenant (or Instance Admin creates)
124: 2. **Validation** → Check quotas, naming conflicts, policy compliance
125: 3. **Creation** → Database schema initialized with tenant seed data
126: 4. **Configuration** → Module selection, initial settings
127: 5. **Activation** → Tenant becomes operational
128: 
129: ### Tenant States
130: 
131: | State | Description | Operations Allowed |
132: |-------|-------------|-------------------|
133: | **Pending** | Created but not activated | Configuration only |
134: | **Active** | Fully operational | All operations |
135: | **Suspended** | Temporarily disabled | Read-only access |
136: | **Archived** | Soft-deleted | None (data retained) |
137: | **Purged** | Permanently deleted | None (data removed) |
138: 
139: ---
140: 
141: ## Single-Tenant vs Multi-Tenant Deployment
142: 
143: ### Virtual Tenant Strategy
144: 
145: The codebase is **always multi-tenant internally** to avoid maintaining separate codebases. Single-tenant mode is achieved through a "Virtual Tenant" that masks the complexity.
146: 
147: | Mode | Behavior |
148: |------|----------|
149: | **Single-Tenant** | `TenantId` hardcoded to `Default`; tenant management UI hidden |
150: | **Multi-Tenant** | `TenantId` resolved from subdomain/header; full tenant management |
151: 
152: ### Runtime Mode Switching
153: 
154: The deployment mode can be changed at runtime without application restart:
155: 1. Instance Admin toggles setting in dashboard
156: 2. Database updated, cache invalidated
157: 3. Next request uses new mode
158: 4. UI adapts automatically (tenant menu appears/disappears)
159: 
160: ---
161: 
162: ## Onboarding Patterns
163: 
164: ### Instance Admin First-Run
165: 
166: When the platform is first installed:
167: 1. First user becomes Instance Admin
168: 2. Wizard asks deployment purpose (Dedicated vs. SaaS)
169: 3. Module selection for the instance
170: 4. Default tenant configuration
171: 
172: ### Tenant Registration Policies
173: 
174: | Policy | Description |
175: |--------|-------------|
176: | **Open** | Self-service registration via public form |
177: | **Invite-Only** | Instance Admin sends invitation link |
178: | **Sales-Gated** | Request must be approved by sales team |
179: | **Closed** | No new tenants (maintenance mode) |
180: 
181: ---
182: 
183: ## Tenant Branding & Customization
184: 
185: ### Navigation Customization
186: 
187: Tenants can define custom external navigation links to seamlessly integrate the event platform with their main website.
188: 
189: - **Entity**: `TenantNavigationLink`
190: - **Management**: Tenant Admins via Admin Portal (`/admin/tenant/navigation`)
191: - **Features**:
192:   - Custom Label and URL
193:   - Ordering support
194:   - "Open in New Tab" option
195:   - Icon selection (MudBlazor icons)
196: 
197: These links are rendered dynamically in the main application sidebar, appearing below standard navigation items. This reduces friction for end-users by providing easy access back to the organization's main site.
198: 
199: ---
200: 
201: ## Related Documentation
202: 
203: - **[ADMIN_HIERARCHY.md](ADMIN_HIERARCHY.md)** - Detailed authority model
204: - **[DEPLOYMENT_MODES.md](DEPLOYMENT_MODES.md)** - Single vs multi-tenant deployment
205: - **[EXTENSIBILITY.md](EXTENSIBILITY.md)** - Module and aspect architecture
206: - **[ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md)** - Overall system architecture
207: 
208: ## Implementation Reference
209: 
210: For code patterns and implementation details:
211: - **`dotnet-efcore-guidelines`** skill - Tenant query filters
212: - **`auth-patterns`** skill - Tenant context extraction
213: - **`clean-architecture-rules`** skill - Layer boundaries
````

281:         var authContext = context.AddTestAuthorization();
282:         ApplyTo(authContext);
283:         return authContext;
284:     }
285: 
286: 
287: 
288: 
289: 
290:     public void ApplyTo(TestAuthorizationContext authContext)
291:     {
292:         if (_isAuthorizing)
293:         {
294:             authContext.SetAuthorizing();
295:             return;
296:         }
297: 
298:         if (!_isAuthenticated)
299:         {
300:             authContext.SetNotAuthorized();
301:             return;
302:         }
303: 
304: 
305:         var claims = BuildClaims();
306: 
307: 
308:         authContext.SetAuthorized(_userName ?? "TestUser", _authState);
309: 
310: 
311:         if (claims.Count > 0)
312:         {
313:             authContext.SetClaims(claims.ToArray());
314:         }
315: 
316: 
317:         if (_roles.Count > 0)
318:         {
319:             authContext.SetRoles(_roles.ToArray());
320:         }
321: 
322: 
323:         if (_policies.Count > 0)
324:         {
325:             authContext.SetPolicies(_policies.ToArray());
326:         }
327:     }
328: 
329: 
330: 
331: 
332:     private List<Claim> BuildClaims()
333:     {
334:         var claims = new List<Claim>();
335: 
336: 
337:         if (_userId.HasValue)
338:         {
339:             var userIdString = _userId.Value.ToString();
340:             claims.Add(new Claim("sub", userIdString));
341:             claims.Add(new Claim(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier, userIdString));
342:         }
343: 
344: 
345:         if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_userName))
346:         {
347:             claims.Add(new Claim(ClaimTypes.Name, _userName));
348:         }
349: 
350: 
351:         if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_email))
352:         {
353:             claims.Add(new Claim(ClaimTypes.Email, _email));
354:         }
355: 
356: 
357:         if (_tenantId.HasValue)
358:         {
359:             claims.Add(new Claim("tenant_id", _tenantId.Value.ToString()));
360:         }
361: 
362: 
363:         foreach (var role in _roles)
364:         {
365:             claims.Add(new Claim(ClaimTypes.Role, role));
366:             claims.Add(new Claim("role", role));
367:         }
368: 
369: 
370:         claims.AddRange(_customClaims);
371: 
372:         return claims;
373:     }
374: 
375: 
376: 
377: 
378: 
379: 
380:     public ClaimsPrincipal BuildPrincipal()
381:     {
382:         if (!_isAuthenticated)
383:         {
384:             return new ClaimsPrincipal(new ClaimsIdentity());
385:         }
386: 
387:         var claims = BuildClaims();
388:         var identity = new ClaimsIdentity(claims, _authType ?? "TestAuth");
389:         return new ClaimsPrincipal(identity);
390:     }
391: 
392: 
393: 
394: 
395: 
396: 
397:     public AuthenticationState BuildAuthenticationState()
398:     {
399:         return new AuthenticationState(BuildPrincipal());
400:     }
401: 
402:     #endregion
403: }

608:                ?? new HalResourceOfOrganizationDto();
609:     }

 98:     public async Task GetFeaturedEventsAsync_ReturnsEmptyCollection_WhenApiThrows()
 99:     {
100: 
101:         _apiClient.GetEventsAsync().ThrowsAsyncForAnyArgs(new ApiException("API Error", 500, null, null, null));
102: 
103: 
104:         var result = await _service.GetFeaturedEventsAsync();
105: 
106: 
107:         await Assert.That(result).IsEmpty();
108:     }
109: 
110:     #endregion
111: 
112: 
113: 
114:     #region GetTotalMembersCountAsync Tests
115: 
116:     [Test]
117:     public async Task GetTotalMembersCountAsync_ReturnsPlaceholderValue()
118:     {
119: 
120:         var result = await _service.GetTotalMembersCountAsync();
121: 
122: 
123:         await Assert.That(result).IsEqualTo(1247);
124:     }
125: 
126:     #endregion
127: 
128: 
129: 
130:     #region GetUpcomingEventsCountAsync Tests
131: 
132:     [Test]
133:     public async Task GetUpcomingEventsCountAsync_ReturnsTotalCountFromApi()
134:     {

136:         var halResponse = CreateEventHalResponse(new List<EventListDto>(), totalCount: 42);
137: 
138:         _apiClient.GetEventsAsync().ReturnsForAnyArgs(halResponse);
139: 
140: 
141:         var result = await _service.GetUpcomingEventsCountAsync();
142: 
143: 
144:         await Assert.That(result).IsEqualTo(42);

152:

155: 
156:

158:     }

160:     #endregion

167:         IList<EventListDto> items, int totalCount)
168:     {

170:         {
171:             _embedded = new HalCollectionEmbeddedOfEventListDto
172:             {
173:                 Items = items.Cast<object>().ToList()
174:             },
175:             TotalCount = totalCount
176:         };
177:     }
178: 
179:     #endregion
180: }

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Components/Admin/Instance/InstanceAdminSettingsLayout.razor
````razor
  1: @* ABOUTME: Sidebar layout component for Instance Admin Settings with four sections. *@
  2: @* ABOUTME: Loads instance settings via IInstanceOnboardingService and delegates to section components. *@
  3: 
  4: @using MudBlazor
  5: @using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components
  6: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services
  7: 
  8: @inject IInstanceOnboardingService InstanceOnboardingService
  9: @inject ISnackbar Snackbar
 10: 
 11: <div class="settings-layout">
 12:     <MudContainer MaxWidth="MaxWidth.Large" Class="py-8">
 13:         <!-- Header -->
 14:         <div class="settings-header mb-8">
 15:             <MudText Typo="Typo.h4" Style="font-weight: 800;">Instance Settings</MudText>
 16:             <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Secondary" Class="mt-2">Manage platform governance, domain, branding, modules, and storage settings</MudText>
 17:         </div>
 18: 
 19:         @if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_errorMessage))
 20:         {
 21:             <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Error" Class="mb-4">@_errorMessage</MudAlert>
 22:         }
 23: 
 24:         @if (_isLoading)
 25:         {
 26:             <MudStack AlignItems="AlignItems.Center" Class="py-12">
 27:                 <MudProgressCircular Indeterminate="true" Color="Color.Primary" />
 28:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Secondary" Class="mt-4">Loading instance settings...</MudText>
 29:             </MudStack>
 30:         }
 31:         else if (!_canEdit)
 32:         {
 33:             <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Warning" Class="mb-4">
 34:                 You do not have instance administrator permissions to view or modify these settings.
 35:             </MudAlert>
 36:         }
 37:         else
 38:         {
 39:             <!-- Main Layout: Sidebar + Content -->
 40:             <MudGrid Spacing="4">
 41:                 <!-- Sidebar Navigation -->
 42:                 <MudItem xs="12" sm="12" md="3">
 43:                     <MudPaper Elevation="0" Class="settings-sidebar pa-0 rounded-lg border-solid border-1 mud-border-lines-default">
 44:                         <MudList T="string" Dense="false" DisablePadding="true">
 45:                             <MudListItem Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Gavel"
 46:                                          Text="Governance"
 47:                                          Class="@GetNavItemClass("governance")"
 48:                                          OnClick="@(() => SelectSection("governance"))" />
 49:                             <MudListItem Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Language"
 50:                                          Text="Domain"
 51:                                          Class="@GetNavItemClass("domain")"
 52:                                          OnClick="@(() => SelectSection("domain"))" />
 53:                             <MudListItem Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Palette"
 54:                                          Text="Branding"
 55:                                          Class="@GetNavItemClass("branding")"
 56:                                          OnClick="@(() => SelectSection("branding"))" />
 57:                             <MudListItem Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Extension"
 58:                                          Text="Modules"
 59:                                          Class="@GetNavItemClass("modules")"
 60:                                          OnClick="@(() => SelectSection("modules"))" />
 61:                             <MudListItem Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Cloud"
 62:                                          Text="Object Storage"
 63:                                          Class="@GetNavItemClass("storage")"
 64:                                          OnClick="@(() => SelectSection("storage"))" />
 65:                         </MudList>
 66:                     </MudPaper>
 67:                 </MudItem>
 68: 
 69:                 <!-- Content Area -->
 70:                 <MudItem xs="12" sm="12" md="9">
 71:                     <MudPaper Elevation="0" Class="settings-content pa-6 rounded-lg border-solid border-1 mud-border-lines-default">
 72:                         @if (_currentSection == "governance")
 73:                         {
 74:                             <InstanceGovernanceSection Model="_model" />
 75:                         }
 76:                         else if (_currentSection == "domain")
 77:                         {
 78:                             <InstanceDomainSection Model="_model" />
 79:                         }
 80:                         else if (_currentSection == "branding")
 81:                         {
 82:                             <InstanceBrandingSection Model="_model" />
 83:                         }
 84:                         else if (_currentSection == "modules")
 85:                         {
 86:                             <InstanceModulesSection Model="_model" />
 87:                         }
 88:                         else if (_currentSection == "storage")
 89:                         {
 90:                             <InstanceStorageSection Model="_storageModel" OnboardingService="InstanceOnboardingService" />
 91:                         }
 92: 
 93:                         <MudDivider Class="my-4" />
 94: 
 95:                         <MudStack Row="true" Justify="Justify.FlexEnd">
 96:                             <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled"
 97:                                        Color="Color.Primary"
 98:                                        OnClick="SaveAsync"
 99:                                        Disabled="_isSaving"
100:                                        StartIcon="@(_isSaving ? Icons.Material.Filled.HourglassEmpty : Icons.Material.Filled.Save)">
101:                                 @(_isSaving ? "Saving..." : "Save Instance Settings")
102:                             </MudButton>
103:                         </MudStack>
104:                     </MudPaper>
105:                 </MudItem>
106:             </MudGrid>
107:         }
108:     </MudContainer>
109: </div>
110: 
111: @code {
112:     private InstanceGovernanceSettingsModel _model = new();
113:     private InstanceStorageSettingsModel _storageModel = new();
114:     private bool _isLoading = true;
115:     private bool _isSaving;
116:     private bool _canEdit;
117:     private string? _errorMessage;
118:     private string _currentSection = "governance";
119: 
120:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
121:     {
122:         var status = await InstanceOnboardingService.GetStatusAsync();
123:         _canEdit = status?.IsCurrentUserInstanceAdmin == true;
124: 
125:         if (!_canEdit)
126:         {
127:             _isLoading = false;
128:             return;
129:         }
130: 
131:         _model = await InstanceOnboardingService.GetSettingsAsync();
132:         _storageModel = await InstanceOnboardingService.GetStorageSettingsAsync();
133:         _isLoading = false;
134:     }
135: 
136:     private async Task SaveAsync()
137:     {
138:         _isSaving = true;
139:         _errorMessage = null;
140: 
141:         var response = await InstanceOnboardingService.UpdateSettingsAsync(_model);
142: 
143:         if (response.Success)
144:         {
145:             var storageResponse = await InstanceOnboardingService.UpdateStorageSettingsAsync(_storageModel);
146:             _isSaving = false;
147: 
148:             if (storageResponse.Success)
149:             {
150:                 Snackbar.Add("Instance settings saved.", Severity.Success);
151:                 return;
152:             }
153: 
154:             _errorMessage = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(storageResponse.Message)
155:                 ? "Governance settings saved, but storage settings failed."
156:                 : storageResponse.Message;
157:             return;
158:         }
159: 
160:         _isSaving = false;
161:         _errorMessage = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(response.Message)
162:             ? "Failed to save instance settings."
163:             : response.Message;
164:     }
165: 
166:     private void SelectSection(string section)
167:     {
168:         _currentSection = section;
169:     }
170: 
171:     private string GetNavItemClass(string section)
172:     {
173:         return _currentSection == section ? "settings-nav-active" : "";
174:     }
175: }
````

107:     private bool _previousShowActions;

111:         if (ReferenceEquals(Aspect, _previousAspect) && ShowActions == _previousShowActions)

126:             (int)GenderSegregationMode.Segregated => "Segregated",
127:             (int)GenderSegregationMode.Family => "Family",
128:             _ => "Mixed"
129:         };
130:     }
131: 
132:     private Color GetGenderModeColor()
133:     {
134:         return Aspect?.GenderMode switch
135:         {
136:             (int)GenderSegregationMode.MenOnly => Color.Info,
137:             (int)GenderSegregationMode.WomenOnly => Color.Secondary,
138:             (int)GenderSegregationMode.Segregated => Color.Warning,
139:             (int)GenderSegregationMode.Family => Color.Success,
140:             _ => Color.Default
141:         };
142:     }
143: 
144:     private string GetPrayerTimeDisplay()
145:     {
146:         if (Aspect?.ReferencePrayer == null) return string.Empty;
147: 
148:         var prayerName = Aspect.ReferencePrayer switch
149:         {
150:             (int)PrayerTime.Fajr => "Fajr",
151:             (int)PrayerTime.Sunrise => "Sunrise",
152:             (int)PrayerTime.Dhuhr => "Dhuhr",
153:             (int)PrayerTime.Asr => "Asr",
154:             (int)PrayerTime.Maghrib => "Maghrib",
155:             (int)PrayerTime.Isha => "Isha",
156:             _ => "Unknown"
157:         };
158: 
159:         if (Aspect.PrayerTimeOffset.HasValue && Aspect.PrayerTimeOffset.Value != 0)
160:         {
161:             var offsetText = Aspect.PrayerTimeOffset.Value > 0
162:                 ? $"+{Aspect.PrayerTimeOffset.Value} min"
163:                 : $"{Aspect.PrayerTimeOffset.Value} min";
164:             return $"{prayerName} ({offsetText})";
165:         }
166: 
167:         return prayerName;
168:     }
169: }

117:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Success" Style="font-weight: 600;">

127:     [Parameter]
128:     public EventTechAspectDto? Aspect { get; set; }
129: 
130:     [Parameter]
131:     public Guid EventId { get; set; }
132: 
133:     [Parameter]
134:     public bool ShowActions { get; set; } = true;
135: 
136:     [Parameter]
137:     public EventCallback OnEdit { get; set; }
138: 
139:     [Parameter]
140:     public EventCallback OnDelete { get; set; }
141: 
142:     private EventTechAspectDto? _previousAspect;
143:     private bool _previousShowActions;
144: 
145:     protected override bool ShouldRender()
146:     {
147:         if (ReferenceEquals(Aspect, _previousAspect) && ShowActions == _previousShowActions)
148:             return false;
149: 
150:         _previousAspect = Aspect;
151:         _previousShowActions = ShowActions;
152:         return true;
153:     }
154: 
155:     private string GetSkillLevelDisplay()
156:     {
157:         return Aspect?.SkillLevel switch
158:         {
159:             (int)SkillLevel.AllLevels => "All Levels",
160:             (int)SkillLevel.Beginner => "Beginner",
161:             (int)SkillLevel.Intermediate => "Intermediate",
162:             (int)SkillLevel.Advanced => "Advanced",
163:             _ => "All Levels"
164:         };
165:     }
166: 
167:     private Color GetSkillLevelColor()
168:     {
169:         return Aspect?.SkillLevel switch
170:         {
171:             (int)SkillLevel.Beginner => Color.Success,
172:             (int)SkillLevel.Intermediate => Color.Warning,
173:             (int)SkillLevel.Advanced => Color.Error,
174:             _ => Color.Default
175:         };
176:     }
177: 
178:     private string GetRepoName()
179:     {
180:         if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(Aspect?.GithubRepoUrl)) return string.Empty;
181: 
182:         try
183:         {
184:             var uri = new Uri(Aspect.GithubRepoUrl);
185:             var path = uri.AbsolutePath.TrimStart('/');
186:             return path.Length > 30 ? path.Substring(0, 27) + "..." : path;
187:         }
188:         catch
189:         {
190:             return "View Repository";
191:         }
192:     }
193: 
194:     private IEnumerable<string> GetTechStackTags()
195:     {
196:         if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(Aspect?.TechStackTags))
197:             return Enumerable.Empty<string>();
198: 
199:         return Aspect.TechStackTags
200:             .Split(',', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries)
201:             .Select(t => t.Trim())
202:             .Where(t => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(t));
203:     }
204: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Components/Event/SelectSessionDialog.razor
````razor
 1: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients
 2: @using MudBlazor
 3: @inject IEventService EventService
 4: 
 5: <MudDialog>
 6:     <TitleContent>
 7:         <MudText Typo="Typo.h6">Select a Session</MudText>
 8:     </TitleContent>
 9:     <DialogContent>
10:         <MudDataGrid T="EventSessionListDto" Items="@sessions" ReadOnly="true" Bordered="true" Dense="true">
11:             <Columns>
12:                 <PropertyColumn Property="x => x.Title" />
13:                 <PropertyColumn Property="x => x.StartTime" />
14:                 <TemplateColumn StickyRight="true">
15:                     <CellTemplate Context="context">
16:                         <MudButton OnClick="@(() => Select(context.Item))" Variant="Variant.Text">Select</MudButton>
17:                     </CellTemplate>
18:                 </TemplateColumn>
19:             </Columns>
20:         </MudDataGrid>
21:     </DialogContent>
22: </MudDialog>
23: 
24: @code {
25:     [CascadingParameter]
26:     private IDialogReference? DialogReference { get; set; }
27: 
28:     private List<EventSessionListDto> sessions = new();
29: 
30:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
31:     {
32:         var result = await EventService.GetAllSessionsAsync();
33:         sessions = result.ToList();
34:     }
35: 
36:     private void Select(EventSessionListDto item)
37:     {
38:         DialogReference?.Dismiss(DialogResult.Ok(item.Id));
39:     }
40: }

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Components/EventReviewDialog.razor
````razor
  1: @using MudBlazor
  2: @using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations
  3: 
  4: <MudDialog>
  5:     <DialogContent>
  6: <div class="review-dialog-content">
  7:             <div class="rating-section">
  8:                 <div class="rating-label">How would you rate this event?</div>
  9:                 <div class="star-rating">
 10:                     @for (int i = 1; i <= 5; i++)
 11:                     {
 12:                         var starIndex = i;
 13:                         <span class="star @(starIndex <= rating ? "filled" : "")"
 14:                               @onclick="@(() => SetRating(starIndex))">
 15:                             @if (starIndex <= rating)
 16:                             {
 17:                                 <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Star" />
 18:                             }
 19:                             else
 20:                             {
 21:                                 <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.StarBorder" />
 22:                             }
 23:                         </span>
 24:                     }
 25:                 </div>
 26:                 @if (rating > 0)
 27:                 {
 28:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Primary" Class="mt-2">
 29:                         @GetRatingText()
 30:                     </MudText>
 31:                 }
 32:             </div>
 33: 
 34:             <div class="comment-section">
 35:                 <div class="comment-label">Share your experience (optional)</div>
 36:                 <MudTextField @bind-Value="comment"
 37:                               Label="Your review"
 38:                               Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 39:                               Lines="5"
 40:                               Placeholder="Tell us about your experience at this event..."
 41:                               MaxLength="500"
 42:                               Counter="500" />
 43:             </div>
 44: 
 45:             @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(errorMessage))
 46:             {
 47:                 <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Error" Class="mb-3">@errorMessage</MudAlert>
 48:             }
 49:         </div>
 50:     </DialogContent>
 51:     <DialogActions>
 52:         <MudButton OnClick="Cancel"
 53:                    Variant="Variant.Text"
 54:                    Color="Color.Default">
 55:             Cancel
 56:         </MudButton>
 57:         <MudButton OnClick="Submit"
 58:                    Variant="Variant.Filled"
 59:                    Color="Color.Primary"
 60:                    Disabled="@(rating == 0)"
 61:                    StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Send">
 62:             Submit Review
 63:         </MudButton>
 64:     </DialogActions>
 65: </MudDialog>
 66: 
 67: @code {
 68:     [CascadingParameter]
 69:     private IDialogReference? DialogReference { get; set; }
 70: 
 71:     [Parameter]
 72:     public string EventTitle { get; set; } = "";
 73: 
 74:     [Parameter]
 75:     public Guid EventId { get; set; }
 76: 
 77:     private int rating = 0;
 78:     private string comment = "";
 79:     private string errorMessage = "";
 80: 
 81:     private void SetRating(int value)
 82:     {
 83:         rating = value;
 84:         errorMessage = "";
 85:     }
 86: 
 87:     private string GetRatingText()
 88:     {
 89:         return rating switch
 90:         {
 91:             1 => "Poor",
 92:             2 => "Fair",
 93:             3 => "Good",
 94:             4 => "Very Good",
 95:             5 => "Excellent",
 96:             _ => ""
 97:         };
 98:     }
 99: 
100:     private void Submit()
101:     {
102:         if (rating == 0)
103:         {
104:             errorMessage = "Please select a rating";
105:             return;
106:         }
107: 
108:         // Here you would call the API to submit the review
109:         // For now, just close the dialog with success
110:         DialogReference?.Close(DialogResult.Ok(new { Rating = rating, Comment = comment }));
111:     }
112: 
113:     private void Cancel()
114:     {
115:         DialogReference?.Close(DialogResult.Cancel());
116:     }
117: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Components/Settings/SettingsPersonalInfo.razor
````razor
  1: @using MudBlazor
  2: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services
  3: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients
  4: @using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components
  5: @using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Forms
  6: @inject IUserService UserService
  7: @inject ISnackbar Snackbar
  8: 
  9: <div class="settings-section">
 10:     <!-- Section Header -->
 11:     <div class="settings-section-header mb-6">
 12:         <MudText Typo="Typo.h5" Style="font-weight: 700;">Personal Information</MudText>
 13:         <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Secondary">Update your personal details and profile picture</MudText>
 14:     </div>
 15: 
 16:     @if (_loading)
 17:     {
 18:         <div class="d-flex flex-column align-center justify-center py-8">
 19:             <MudProgressCircular Color="Color.Primary" Size="Size.Large" Indeterminate="true" />
 20:             <MudText Typo="Typo.body1" Class="mt-4" Color="Color.Secondary">Loading profile...</MudText>
 21:         </div>
 22:     }
 23:     else if (_user == null)
 24:     {
 25:         <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Error" Variant="Variant.Filled">Failed to load user profile.</MudAlert>
 26:     }
 27:     else
 28:     {
 29:         @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_errorMessage))
 30:         {
 31:             <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Error" Variant="Variant.Filled" Class="mb-6 rounded-lg" ShowCloseIcon="true" CloseIconClicked="@(() => _errorMessage = null)">
 32:                 @_errorMessage
 33:             </MudAlert>
 34:         }
 35: 
 36:         @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_successMessage))
 37:         {
 38:             <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Success" Variant="Variant.Filled" Class="mb-6 rounded-lg" ShowCloseIcon="true" CloseIconClicked="@(() => _successMessage = null)">
 39:                 @_successMessage
 40:             </MudAlert>
 41:         }
 42: 
 43:         <MudForm @ref="_form" @bind-IsValid="_success">
 44:             <!-- Profile Picture Section -->
 45:             <div class="settings-profile-picture mb-8">
 46:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.subtitle2" Style="font-weight: 600;" Class="mb-4">Profile Picture</MudText>
 47:                 <div class="d-flex align-center gap-6">
 48:                     <div style="width: 120px;">
 49:                         <ImageUpload @bind-PreviewUrl="_profileImagePreview"
 50:                                    FileDataSelected="OnProfileImageFileDataSelected"
 51:                                    PlaceholderText="Select Profile Picture"
 52:                                    UploadButtonText="Change"
 53:                                    Width="120px"
 54:                                    Height="120px"
 55:                                    HintText="JPG, PNG, GIF, WebP (Max 5MB)" 
 56:                                    Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Person" />
 57:                     </div>
 58:                     <div>
 59:                         <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Secondary">
 60:                             Recommended: Square image, at least 400x400px
 61:                         </MudText>
 62:                     </div>
 63:                 </div>
 64:             </div>
 65: 
 66:             <!-- Divider -->
 67:             <MudDivider Class="my-6" />
 68: 
 69:             <!-- Name Section -->
 70:             <div class="settings-form-section mb-8">
 71:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.subtitle2" Style="font-weight: 600;" Class="mb-4">Name</MudText>
 72:                 <MudGrid Spacing="3">
 73:                     <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
 74:                         <MudTextField @bind-Value="_user.FirstName" 
 75:                                       Label="First Name" 
 76:                                       Required="true" 
 77:                                       Variant="Variant.Outlined" 
 78:                                       Adornment="Adornment.Start" 
 79:                                       AdornmentIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Person" />
 80:                     </MudItem>
 81:                     <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
 82:                         <MudTextField @bind-Value="_user.LastName" 
 83:                                       Label="Last Name" 
 84:                                       Required="true" 
 85:                                       Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 86:                                       Adornment="Adornment.Start" 
 87:                                       AdornmentIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Person" />
 88:                     </MudItem>
 89:                 </MudGrid>
 90:             </div>
 91: 
 92:             <!-- Divider -->
 93:             <MudDivider Class="my-6" />
 94: 
 95:             <!-- Contact Section -->
 96:             <div class="settings-form-section mb-8">
 97:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.subtitle2" Style="font-weight: 600;" Class="mb-4">Contact Information</MudText>
 98:                 <MudGrid Spacing="3">
 99:                     <MudItem xs="12">
100:                         <MudTextField @bind-Value="_user.Email" 
101:                                       Label="Email" 
102:                                       Variant="Variant.Outlined" 
103:                                       ReadOnly="true" 
104:                                       HelperText="Email cannot be changed"
105:                                       Adornment="Adornment.Start" 
106:                                       AdornmentIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Email" />
107:                     </MudItem>
108:                     <MudItem xs="12">
109:                         <MudTextField @bind-Value="_user.Username" 
110:                                       Label="Username" 
111:                                       Variant="Variant.Outlined" 
112:                                       Adornment="Adornment.Start" 
113:                                       AdornmentIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.AlternateEmail" />
114:                     </MudItem>
115:                 </MudGrid>
116:             </div>
117: 
118:             <!-- Divider -->
119:             <MudDivider Class="my-6" />
120: 
121:             <!-- Action Buttons -->
122:             <div class="d-flex justify-end gap-3 mt-8">
123:                 <MudButton Variant="Variant.Outlined" 
124:                            Color="Color.Default" 
125:                            OnClick="ResetForm"
126:                            Class="rounded-pill px-6">
127:                     Cancel
128:                 </MudButton>
129:                 <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled" 
130:                            Color="Color.Primary" 
131:                            OnClick="SaveSettings" 
132:                            Disabled="@(!_success || _isSaving)" 
133:                            StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Save"
134:                            Class="rounded-pill px-6">
135:                     @if (_isSaving)
136:                     {
137:                         <MudProgressCircular Class="mr-2" Size="Size.Small" Indeterminate="true" />
138:                         <span>Saving...</span>
139:                     }
140:                     else
141:                     {
142:                         <span>Save Changes</span>
143:                     }
144:                 </MudButton>
145:             </div>
146:         </MudForm>
147:     }
148: </div>
149: 
150: @code {
151:     [Inject]
152:     private IDialogService DialogService { get; set; } = null!;
153: 
154:     private MudForm? _form;
155:     private bool _loading = true;
156:     private bool _isSaving = false;
157:     private bool _success = true;
158:     private string? _errorMessage;
159:     private string? _successMessage;
160:     private string? _profileImagePreview;
161:     private UserDto? _user;
162:     private UserDto? _originalUser;
163: 
164:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
165:     {
166:         await LoadUserDataAsync();
167:     }
168: 
169:     private async Task LoadUserDataAsync()
170:     {
171:         try
172:         {
173:             _loading = true;
174:             _user = await UserService.GetCurrentUserAsync();
175:             _originalUser = new UserDto
176:             {
177:                 Id = _user?.Id,
178:                 FirstName = _user?.FirstName,
179:                 LastName = _user?.LastName,
180:                 Email = _user?.Email,
181:                 Username = _user?.Username,
182:                 ProfileImageUri = _user?.ProfileImageUri
183:             };
184:             _profileImagePreview = _user?.ProfileImageUri;
185:         }
186:         catch (Exception ex)
187:         {
188:             _errorMessage = $"Failed to load user profile: {ex.Message}";
189:         }
190:         finally
191:         {
192:             _loading = false;
193:         }
194:     }
195: 
196:     private async Task SaveSettings()
197:     {
198:         if (_user == null)
199:             return;
200: 
201:         try
202:         {
203:             _isSaving = true;
204:             _errorMessage = null;
205:             _successMessage = null;
206: 
207:             var updateDto = new UpdateUserDto
208:             {
209:                 Id = _user.Id,
210:                 FirstName = _user.FirstName,
211:                 LastName = _user.LastName,
212:                 Email = _user.Email,
213:                 Username = _user.Username
214:             };
215: 
216:             var result = await UserService.UpdateUserAsync(updateDto);
217:             if (result?.Success == true)
218:             {
219:                 _successMessage = "Profile updated successfully!";
220:                 _originalUser = new UserDto
221:                 {
222:                     Id = _user.Id,
223:                     FirstName = _user.FirstName,
224:                     LastName = _user.LastName,
225:                     Email = _user.Email,
226:                     Username = _user.Username,
227:                     ProfileImageUri = _user.ProfileImageUri
228:                 };
229:             }
230:             else
231:             {
232:                 _errorMessage = result?.Message ?? "Failed to save profile";
233:             }
234:         }
235:         catch (Exception ex)
236:         {
237:             _errorMessage = $"Failed to save profile: {ex.Message}";
238:         }
239:         finally
240:         {
241:             _isSaving = false;
242:         }
243:     }
244: 
245:     private void ResetForm()
246:     {
247:         if (_originalUser != null && _user != null)
248:         {
249:             _user.FirstName = _originalUser.FirstName;
250:             _user.LastName = _originalUser.LastName;
251:             _user.Username = _originalUser.Username;
252:             _profileImagePreview = _originalUser.ProfileImageUri;
253:             _errorMessage = null;
254:             _successMessage = null;
255:         }
256:     }
257: 
258:     private Task OnProfileImageFileDataSelected(FileUploadData? fileData)
259:     {
260:         try
261:         {
262:             if (_user != null && fileData != null)
263:             {
264:                 var base64 = Convert.ToBase64String(fileData.Content);
265:                 _profileImagePreview = $"data:{fileData.ContentType};base64,{base64}";
266:             }
267:         }
268:         catch (Exception ex)
269:         {
270:             _errorMessage = $"Failed to upload image: {ex.Message}";
271:         }
272: 
273:         return Task.CompletedTask;
274:     }
275: }
````

20:     {

46:     {

48:             return null;
49: 
50:         var combined = date.Value.Date + time.Value;
51:         return ConvertLocalToUtc(combined);
52:     }

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Pages/Admin/Instance/InstanceSettings.razor
````razor
  1: @* Replaced by InstanceAdminSettings.razor — kept for reference only *@
  2: @using MudBlazor
  3: @using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization
  4: @attribute [Authorize]
  5: @inject IInstanceOnboardingService InstanceOnboardingService
  6: @inject ISnackbar Snackbar
  7: @inject NavigationManager Navigation
  8: 
  9: <MudContainer MaxWidth="MaxWidth.Medium" Class="py-8">
 10:     <MudPaper Class="pa-6">
 11:         <MudText Typo="Typo.h4" Class="mb-2">Instance Settings</MudText>
 12:         <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Class="mb-4">
 13:             Runtime governance controls for deployment mode and instance-level policy defaults.
 14:         </MudText>
 15: 
 16:         @if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_errorMessage))
 17:         {
 18:             <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Error" Class="mb-4">@_errorMessage</MudAlert>
 19:         }
 20: 
 21:         @if (_isLoading)
 22:         {
 23:             <MudProgressCircular Indeterminate="true" Color="Color.Primary" />
 24:         }
 25:         else if (!_canEdit)
 26:         {
 27:             <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Warning">
 28:                 You do not have instance administrator permissions.
 29:             </MudAlert>
 30:         }
 31:         else
 32:         {
 33:             <MudStack Spacing="3">
 34:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.h6">Platform Governance</MudText>
 35:                 <MudSelect T="string" Label="Deployment Mode" @bind-Value="_model.DeploymentMode" Variant="Variant.Outlined">
 36:                     <MudSelectItem Value="@("SingleTenant")">Single Tenant</MudSelectItem>
 37:                     <MudSelectItem Value="@("MultiTenant")">Multi Tenant</MudSelectItem>
 38:                 </MudSelect>
 39: 
 40:                 <MudSwitch T="bool" @bind-Value="_model.AllowTenantSelfServiceRegistration" Color="Color.Primary">
 41:                     Allow tenant self-service registration
 42:                 </MudSwitch>
 43:                 <MudSelect T="string" Label="Default Public Home Page" @bind-Value="_model.DefaultPublicHomePage" Variant="Variant.Outlined">
 44:                     <MudSelectItem Value="@("EventList")">Event List</MudSelectItem>
 45:                     <MudSelectItem Value="@("LandingPage")">Landing Page</MudSelectItem>
 46:                 </MudSelect>
 47:                 <MudSwitch T="bool" @bind-Value="_model.LockTenantHomePagePreference" Color="Color.Primary">
 48:                     Lock tenant home page preference
 49:                 </MudSwitch>
 50: 
 51:                 <MudDivider />
 52:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.h6">Domain Governance</MudText>
 53:                 <MudTextField Label="Instance Base Domain"
 54:                               Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 55:                               @bind-Value="_model.InstanceBaseDomain"
 56:                               Placeholder="example.com" />
 57:                 <MudSwitch T="bool" @bind-Value="_model.AllowTenantCustomDomains" Color="Color.Primary">
 58:                     Allow tenant custom domains
 59:                 </MudSwitch>
 60:                 <MudSwitch T="bool" @bind-Value="_model.LockTenantSubdomain" Color="Color.Primary">
 61:                     Lock tenant subdomain changes
 62:                 </MudSwitch>
 63:                 <MudSwitch T="bool" @bind-Value="_model.LockTenantCustomDomain" Color="Color.Primary">
 64:                     Lock tenant custom domain changes
 65:                 </MudSwitch>
 66: 
 67:                 <MudDivider />
 68:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.h6">Policy Defaults</MudText>
 69:                 <MudSwitch T="bool" @bind-Value="_model.EnableIslamicModule" Color="Color.Primary">
 70:                     Enable Islamic module
 71:                 </MudSwitch>
 72:                 <MudSwitch T="bool" @bind-Value="_model.EnableTechModule" Color="Color.Primary">
 73:                     Enable Tech module
 74:                 </MudSwitch>
 75:                 <MudSwitch T="bool" @bind-Value="_model.AllowUserSubmittedEvents" Color="Color.Primary">
 76:                     Allow user-submitted events
 77:                 </MudSwitch>
 78:                 <MudSwitch T="bool" @bind-Value="_model.RequireOrganizationVerification" Color="Color.Primary">
 79:                     Require organization verification
 80:                 </MudSwitch>
 81:                 <MudSwitch T="bool" @bind-Value="_model.AllowTenantToOmitVerification" Color="Color.Primary">
 82:                     Allow tenant admins to omit organization verification
 83:                 </MudSwitch>
 84: 
 85:                 <MudDivider />
 86:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.h6">Default Branding</MudText>
 87:                 <MudTextField Label="Brand Display Name"
 88:                               Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 89:                               @bind-Value="_model.DefaultBrandDisplayName" />
 90:                 <MudTextField Label="Brand Logo URL"
 91:                               Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 92:                               @bind-Value="_model.DefaultBrandLogoUrl" />
 93:                 <MudTextField Label="Brand Favicon URL"
 94:                               Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 95:                               @bind-Value="_model.DefaultBrandFaviconUrl" />
 96:                 <MudTextField Label="Advanced: Custom CSS URL (Optional)"
 97:                               Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 98:                               @bind-Value="_model.DefaultBrandCustomCssUrl" />
 99:                 <MudSwitch T="bool" @bind-Value="_model.LockTenantBrandDisplayName" Color="Color.Primary">
100:                     Lock tenant brand display name
101:                 </MudSwitch>
102:                 <MudSwitch T="bool" @bind-Value="_model.LockTenantBrandLogoUrl" Color="Color.Primary">
103:                     Lock tenant brand logo
104:                 </MudSwitch>
105:                 <MudSwitch T="bool" @bind-Value="_model.LockTenantBrandFaviconUrl" Color="Color.Primary">
106:                     Lock tenant brand favicon
107:                 </MudSwitch>
108:                 <MudSwitch T="bool" @bind-Value="_model.LockTenantBrandCustomCssUrl" Color="Color.Primary">
109:                     Lock tenant custom CSS URL
110:                 </MudSwitch>
111: 
112:                 <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled" Color="Color.Primary" OnClick="SaveAsync" Disabled="_isSaving">
113:                     Save Instance Settings
114:                 </MudButton>
115:             </MudStack>
116:         }
117:     </MudPaper>
118: </MudContainer>
119: 
120: @code {
121:     private InstanceGovernanceSettingsModel _model = new();
122:     private bool _isLoading = true;
123:     private bool _isSaving;
124:     private bool _canEdit;
125:     private string? _errorMessage;
126: 
127:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
128:     {
129:         var status = await InstanceOnboardingService.GetStatusAsync();
130:         _canEdit = status?.IsCurrentUserInstanceAdmin == true;
131: 
132:         if (!_canEdit)
133:         {
134:             _isLoading = false;
135:             return;
136:         }
137: 
138:         _model = await InstanceOnboardingService.GetSettingsAsync();
139:         _isLoading = false;
140:     }
141: 
142:     private async Task SaveAsync()
143:     {
144:         _isSaving = true;
145:         _errorMessage = null;
146: 
147:         var response = await InstanceOnboardingService.UpdateSettingsAsync(_model);
148:         _isSaving = false;
149: 
150:         if (response.Success)
151:         {
152:             Snackbar.Add("Instance settings saved.", Severity.Success);
153:             Navigation.NavigateTo("/", forceLoad: true);
154:             return;
155:         }
156: 
157:         _errorMessage = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(response.Message)
158:             ? "Failed to save instance settings."
159:             : response.Message;
160:     }
161: }
````
