195: 
196: ## Handling Nullable DID (did_status)
197: 
198: The key insight is that DID creation is **async**. Here's how to handle it:
199: ```
200: ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
201: │                    DID Status State Machine                                  │
202: ├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
203: │                                                                             │
204: │  ┌─────────┐     Background job      ┌─────────┐                           │
205: │  │ pending │ ──────────────────────▶ │ active  │                           │
206: │  └─────────┘     creates DID         └─────────┘                           │
207: │       │                                                                     │
208: │       │ DID creation fails                                                  │
209: │       ▼                                                                     │
210: │  ┌─────────┐     Retry succeeds      ┌─────────┐                           │
211: │  │ failed  │ ──────────────────────▶ │ active  │                           │
212: │  └─────────┘                         └─────────┘                           │
213: │                                                                             │
214: │  WHAT USERS CAN DO:                                                         │
215: │  ──────────────────                                                         │
216: │  pending → Browse, edit profile (read-heavy)                                │
217: │  failed  → Same as pending, show "retry" button                            │
218: │  active  → Full access: post events, comment, etc. (write access)          │
219: │                                                                             │
220: └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
221: ```
````

## File: docs/OPERATIONS.md
````markdown
  1: # Deployment Modes & Customization
  2: 
  3: > **Project-Agnostic Operations & Deployment Guide**
  4: >
  5: > Placeholders use `{Placeholder}` syntax - see [TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md](TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md).
  6: 
  7: ## Placeholder Substitutions
  8: 
  9: | Placeholder | Replace With | Example (ISLAMU Event) |
 10: |-------------|--------------|------------------------|
 11: | `{Project}` | Your solution name | `Explore` |
 12: | `{Project}.Infrastructure` | Infrastructure project | `Explore.Infrastructure` |
 13: | `{Instance Name}` | Your instance display name | `ISLAMU Event` |
 14: 
 15: ---
 16: 
 17: This platform is designed to be **highly customizable** to support diverse deployment scenarios—from single-organization instances to full SaaS platforms serving multiple tenants. This section covers all customization options.
 18: 
 19: ### Implementation Example: ISLAMU Event
 20: The ISLAMU Event platform (project name: Explore) is the reference implementation of this system, designed for Islamic event discovery globally.
 21: 
 22: ## Deployment Modes
 23: 
 24: The platform supports two primary deployment modes:
 25: 
 26: ```
 27: ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
 28: │                      DEPLOYMENT MODES                               │
 29: ├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
 30: │                                                                     │
 31: │  MODE 1: Single-Instance Deployment                                 │
 32: │  ─────────────────────────────────────                              │
 33: │  • Multi-tenancy DISABLED                                           │
 34: │  • One organization/community per deployment                        │
 35: │  • Simpler configuration and maintenance                            │
 36: │  • Example: ISLAMU's own Islamic events instance                    │
 37: │  • Example: A university running their own event platform           │
 38: │                                                                     │
 39: │  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐    │
 40: │  │              Single Instance                                │    │
 41: │  │  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐    │    │
 42: │  │  │  events.islamu.org                                  │    │    │
 43: │  │  │  • All events in one space                          │    │    │
 44: │  │  │  • Single admin team                                │    │    │
 45: │  │  │  • Unified branding                                 │    │    │
 46: │  │  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘    │    │
 47: │  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘    │
 48: │                                                                     │
 49: │  MODE 2: Multi-Tenant SaaS Deployment                               │
 50: │  ────────────────────────────────────                               │
 51: │  • Multi-tenancy ENABLED                                            │
 52: │  • Multiple isolated organizations/communities                      │
 53: │  • For SaaS providers offering ISLAMU Event as a service            │
 54: │  • Each tenant has custom domain, branding, settings                │
 55: │  • Shared infrastructure, isolated data                             │
 56: │                                                                     │
 57: │  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐    │
 58: │  │              Multi-Tenant SaaS Platform                     │    │
 59: │  │  ┌───────────────┐ ┌───────────────┐ ┌───────────────┐      │    │
 60: │  │  │ Tenant A      │ │ Tenant B      │ │ Tenant C      │      │    │
 61: │  │  │ mosque-a.com  │ │ uni-events.eu │ │ community.org │      │    │
 62: │  │  │ Own settings  │ │ Own settings  │ │ Own settings  │      │    │
 63: │  │  │ Own branding  │ │ Own branding  │ │ Own branding  │      │    │
 64: │  │  └───────────────┘ └───────────────┘ └───────────────┘      │    │
 65: │  │                    Shared Infrastructure                    │    │
 66: │  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘    │
 67: │                                                                     │
 68: └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
 69: ```
 70: 
 71: ### Environment Configuration for Deployment Mode
 72: 
 73: ```yaml
 74: # docker-compose.yml
 75: services:
 76:   explore-api:
 77:     environment:
 78:       # Deployment Mode
 79:       - EXPLORE__MULTITENANCY__ENABLED=false          # true for SaaS mode
 80:       - EXPLORE__MULTITENANCY__DEFAULT_TENANT=default # Used when disabled
 81:       
 82:       # Instance Identity (Single-Instance Mode)
 83:       - EXPLORE__INSTANCE__NAME=ISLAMU Event
 84:       - EXPLORE__INSTANCE__DOMAIN=events.islamu.ngo
 85:       - EXPLORE__INSTANCE__DESCRIPTION=Islamic Event Discovery Platform
 86: ```
 87: 
 88: ## Blazor Rendering Modes
 89: 
 90: The platform supports **three Blazor rendering modes** configurable via environment variables:
 91: 
 92: | Mode | Description | Use Case |
 93: |------|-------------|----------|
 94: | **Server** | Server-side rendering | real-time updates |
 95: | **WebAssembly** | Client-side rendering in browser | Offline capability, reduced server load |
 96: | **Auto** | Server initially, then WebAssembly | Best of both worlds (recommended) |
 97: 
 98: ### Configuration
 99: 
100: ```yaml
101: # docker-compose.yml
102: services:
103:   explore-blazor:
104:     environment:
105:       # Blazor Rendering Mode: Server | WebAssembly | Auto
106:       - BLAZOR__RENDER_MODE=Auto
107:       
108:       # Additional Blazor Settings
109:       - BLAZOR__PRERENDER=true                    # Enable prerendering for SEO
110:       - BLAZOR__DETAILED_ERRORS=false             # Show detailed errors (dev only)
111:       - BLAZOR__WEBSOCKET_COMPRESSION=true        # Compress SignalR traffic
112: ```
113: 
114: ```csharp
115: // Program.cs - Runtime configuration
116: var renderMode = builder.Configuration["Blazor:RenderMode"] ?? "Auto";
117: 
118: builder.Services.AddRazorComponents()
119:     .AddInteractiveServerComponents()
120:     .AddInteractiveWebAssemblyComponents();
121: 
122: // In App.razor - Dynamic render mode
123: @code {
124:     private IComponentRenderMode RenderMode => 
125:         Configuration["Blazor:RenderMode"] switch
126:         {
127:             "Server" => RenderMode.InteractiveServer,
128:             "WebAssembly" => RenderMode.InteractiveWebAssembly,
129:             "Auto" => RenderMode.InteractiveAuto,
130:             _ => RenderMode.InteractiveAuto
131:         };
132: }
133: ```
134: 
135: ## Observability Pipeline (Aspire + Serilog + OpenTelemetry + Loki)
136: 
137: The recommended production flow is:
138: 
139: ```
140: App logs -> Microsoft.Extensions.Logging -> OpenTelemetry provider -> OTLP -> OpenTelemetry Collector -> Loki
141: ```
142: 
143: ### Required Rules
144: 
145: - Use Serilog for structured JSON logs and enrichers.
146: - Keep `UseSerilog(..., writeToProviders: true)` in app hosts so logs continue through the provider pipeline.
147: - Configure OTLP once via Aspire ServiceDefaults using `builder.Services.AddOpenTelemetry().UseOtlpExporter()`.
148: - Do not use `Serilog.Sinks.Loki` for this architecture.
149: 
150: ### Critical OpenTelemetry Constraint
151: 
152: Do not mix these two patterns in the same app:
153: 
154: - Cross-cutting exporter: `UseOtlpExporter()`
155: - Signal-specific exporters: `AddOtlpExporter()` (logs, metrics, or traces)
156: 
157: Mixing both causes a runtime `NotSupportedException` in OpenTelemetry .NET.
158: 
159: ### Environment Variables
160: 
161: ```yaml
162: services:
163:   explore-api:
164:     environment:
165:       - OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=http://otel-collector:4318
166:       - OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_PROTOCOL=http/protobuf
167: 
168:   explore-blazor:
169:     environment:
170:       - OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=http://otel-collector:4318
171:       - OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_PROTOCOL=http/protobuf
172: ```
173: 
174: ### Loki/Collector Notes
175: 
176: - Send logs to Loki through OpenTelemetry Collector OTLP pipelines.
177: - Ensure Loki OTLP ingestion is enabled with structured metadata support (`allow_structured_metadata: true`).
178: - Keep Prometheus scraping enabled on `/metrics` for metric collection.
179: 
180: ## Instance-Level Administration
181: 
182: Instance Administrators (not organization admins) can configure platform-wide behavior through the **Instance Settings** panel or environment variables.
183: 
184: ### Organization & Event Publishing Policies
185: 
186: Configurable inside the **Instance Settings** panel in the webapp for instance administrator.
187: 
188: ```
189: ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
190: │              INSTANCE-LEVEL POLICY CONFIGURATION                    │
191: ├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
192: │                                                                     │
193: │  ORGANIZATION CREATION POLICY                                       │
194: │  ────────────────────────────                                       │
195: │  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
196: │  │  Option A: Open Registration (Default)                       │   │
197: │  │  • Anyone can create an organization                         │   │
198: │  │  • Organizations start as "Unverified"                       │   │
199: │  │  • Can publish events immediately                            │   │
200: │  │                                                              │   │
201: │  │  Option B: Approval Required (ISLAMU Instance)               │   │
202: │  │  • Anyone can REQUEST to create an organization              │   │
203: │  │  • Instance admin must APPROVE before org is active          │   │
204: │  │  • Only approved orgs can publish events                     │   │
205: │  │                                                              │   │
206: │  │  Option C: Invite Only                                       │   │
207: │  │  • Only instance admins can create organizations             │   │
208: │  │  • Most restrictive, for curated platforms                   │   │
209: │  └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
210: │                                                                     │
211: │  USER EVENT PUBLISHING POLICY                                       │
212: │  ────────────────────────────                                       │
213: │  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
214: │  │  Option A: Users Can Publish (marked as "User Reported")     │   │
215: │  │  • Individual users can post events                          │   │
216: │  │  • Events flagged with "User Reported" badge                 │   │
217: │  │  • Subject to community moderation                           │   │
218: │  │                                                              │   │
219: │  │  Option B: Users Cannot Publish Directly                     │   │
220: │  │  • Only organizations can publish events                     │   │
221: │  │  • Higher quality control                                    │   │
222: │  │                                                              │   │
223: │  │  Option C: Users Publish with Approval                       │   │
224: │  │  • Users submit events for review                            │   │
225: │  │  • Instance moderators approve before publishing             │   │
226: │  │  • Balance between openness and quality                      │   │
227: │  │                                                              │   │
228: │  │  Option D: Users Publish without approval nor verification   │   │
229: │  │  • Users submit events                                       │   │
230: │  │  • fully open                                                │   │
231: │  └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
232: │                                                                     │
233: └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
234: ```
235: 
236: 
237: ## Cerbos Authorization Service
238: 
239: Cerbos is the Policy Decision Point (PDP) for fine-grained authorization. It runs as an opt-in Docker service.
240: 
241: ### Deployment
242: 
243: ```bash
244: # Start Cerbos alongside the platform
245: docker compose --profile authz up -d
246: 
247: # Verify health
248: curl http://localhost:3592/_cerbos/health
249: ```
250: 
251: ### Schema Initialization
252: 
253: For Tier 2+ deployments using PostgreSQL-backed policy storage:
254: 
255: ```bash
256: # Initialize the Cerbos schema in a dedicated database or schema
257: psql -h localhost -U cerbos_user -d cerbos -f cerbos/init/cerbos-schema.sql
258: ```
259: 
260: The schema creates 5 tables (`policy`, `policy_dependency`, `policy_ancestor`, `policy_revision`, `attr_schema_defs`) plus an audit trigger that tracks all policy changes.
261: 
262: ### Configuration
263: 
264: Cerbos is configured via `cerbos/config/.cerbos.yaml`:
265: 
266: | Setting | Default | Description |
267: |---------|---------|-------------|
268: | `server.httpListenAddr` | `:3592` | HTTP API port |
269: | `server.grpcListenAddr` | `:3593` | gRPC port |
270: | `server.adminAPI.enabled` | `true` | Admin API for PolicySyncService |
271: | `storage.driver` | `overlay` | PG primary + disk fallback |
272: | `compile.cacheDuration` | `60s` | Policy compilation cache |
273: 
274: Environment variables:
275: - `CERBOS_ADMIN_USER` — Admin API username
276: - `CERBOS_ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH` — Bcrypt hash of admin password
277: - `CERBOS_PG_URL` — PostgreSQL connection string for policy store
278: 
279: ### Policy Management
280: 
281: **Base policies** (18 resource kinds) are shipped as YAML files in `cerbos/policies/` and mounted into the container. These define the default authorization rules for each resource type.
282: 
283: **Dynamic policies** are generated by `PolicySyncService` when role permissions change (e.g., admin creates a custom role). These are pushed to Cerbos via the Admin API and stored in PostgreSQL.
284: 
285: The overlay driver ensures: PostgreSQL policies take precedence → disk policies as fallback.
286: 
287: ### Health Monitoring
288: 
289: | Endpoint | Method | Description |
290: |----------|--------|-------------|
291: | `/_cerbos/health` | GET | Returns 200 if Cerbos is healthy |
292: | `/_cerbos/metrics` | GET | Prometheus metrics (if enabled) |
293: 
294: The `RuntimeAuthorizationProvider` has a Polly circuit breaker (trips after 50% failure rate over 30s, breaks for 15s). When tripped, all authorization falls back to `LocalAuthorizationProvider`.
295: 
296: ### Backup & Restore
297: 
298: **Policy store backup:**
299: ```bash
300: pg_dump -h localhost -U cerbos_user -d cerbos --schema=cerbos > cerbos-backup.sql
301: ```
302: 
303: **Restore:**
304: ```bash
305: psql -h localhost -U cerbos_user -d cerbos < cerbos-backup.sql
306: ```
307: 
308: Base YAML policies are version-controlled in `cerbos/policies/` — no separate backup needed.
309: 
310: ### Upgrade Procedure
311: 
312: 1. Pull new Cerbos image: `docker pull ghcr.io/cerbos/cerbos:latest`
313: 2. Rolling restart (Tier 2+): restart one instance at a time
314: 3. Verify health after each restart: `curl http://<instance>:3592/_cerbos/health`
315: 4. Run policy compilation check: `cerbos compile cerbos/policies/`
316: 
317: ### Troubleshooting
318: 
319: | Symptom | Cause | Resolution |
320: |---------|-------|------------|
321: | `Connection refused` on port 3592 | Cerbos not running | `docker compose --profile authz up -d` |
322: | Policy compile errors in CI | Invalid YAML syntax | Run `cerbos compile cerbos/policies/` locally |
323: | Circuit breaker tripped (logs: "Cerbos circuit open") | Cerbos unreachable or slow | Check Cerbos container logs, restart if needed |
324: | `authorization.provider = local` but Cerbos running | SystemSetting override | Update SystemSetting to `cerbos` via admin panel |
325: | PolicySyncService 401 Unauthorized | Wrong admin credentials | Verify `CERBOS_ADMIN_USER` and `CERBOS_ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH` env vars |
326: 
327: For deployment tier guidance, see [DEPLOYMENT_TIERS.md](DEPLOYMENT_TIERS.md).
328: 
329: ---
330: 
331: ## Tenant-Level Configuration (BYOK - Bring Your Own Keys)
332: 
333: Tenant-level BYOK integrations are a **roadmap** capability.
334: 
335: **Current state**:
336: 
337: - Object storage integration exists (S3-compatible) via `{Project}.Infrastructure`.
338: - Other per-tenant integrations (analytics, payments, AI services, email/SMS routing) are not implemented yet.
339: 
340: ### Implementation Example: ISLAMU Event
341: In the Explore project, object storage is implemented in `Explore.Infrastructure` with S3-compatible providers.
342: 
343: ```
344: ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
345: │               TENANT BYOK INTEGRATIONS (PLANNED)                    │
346: ├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
347: │                                                                     │
348: │  ANALYTICS (planned)                 PAYMENTS (planned)              │
349: │  ─────────                          ────────                        │
350: │  • Google Analytics                 • Stripe                        │
351: │  • Plausible Analytics                                              │
352: │  • PostHog                                                          │
353: │                                                                     │
354: │                                                                     │
355: │                                                                     │
356: │                                                                     │
357: │  AI SERVICES (planned)                                               │
358: │  ───────────                                                        │
359: │  • OpenAI                                                           │
360: │  • Anthropic Claude                                                 │
361: │  • Azure OpenAI                                                     │
362: │  • Ollama (self-hosted)                                             │
363: │  • Custom LLM endpoint                                              │
364: │                                                                     │
365: │  EMAIL & SMS (planned)               STORAGE                          │
366: │  ───────────                        ───────                         │
367: │  • SendGrid                         • AWS S3                        │
368: │  • Mailgun                          • Azure Blob                    │
369: │  • Amazon SES                       • Google Cloud Storage          │
370: │  • Twilio (SMS)                     • MinIO (self-hosted)           │
371: │  • Custom SMTP                      • Local filesystem              │
372: │                                                                     │
373: └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
374: ```
375: 
376: 
377: 
378: ## Organization-Level Integrations
379: 
380: Organization administrators can configure their own notification channels and webhooks for their organization's events.
381: 
382: ```
383: ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
384: │              ORGANIZATION INTEGRATION OPTIONS                       │
385: ├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
386: │                                                                     │
387: │  NOTIFICATION CHANNELS                                              │
388: │  ─────────────────────                                              │
389: │  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
390: │  │  Slack Integration                                           │   │
391: │  │  • New event created → Post to channel                       │   │
392: │  │  • New registration → Notify organizers                      │   │
393: │  │  • Event reminder → Scheduled messages                       │   │
394: │  │  • Capacity alert → Warning when nearly full                 │   │
395: │  │                                                              │   │
396: │  │  Telegram Integration                                        │   │
397: │  │  • Bot notifications to group/channel                        │   │
398: │  │  • Event announcements                                       │   │
399: │  │  • Registration confirmations                                │   │
400: │  │                                                              │   │
401: │  │  Email Notifications                                         │   │
402: │  │  • Customizable templates                                    │   │
403: │  │  • Digest options (immediate/daily/weekly)                   │   │
404: │  │  • Role-based routing                                        │   │
405: │  │                                                              │   │
406: │  │  Discord Integration                                         │   │
407: │  │  • Webhook-based notifications                               │   │
408: │  │  • Rich embeds for events                                    │   │
409: │  │                                                              │   │
410: │  │  Matrix Integration                                          │   │
411: │  │  • Room notifications                                        │   │
412: │  │  • Decentralized messaging                                   │   │
413: │  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
414: │                                                                     │
415: │  WEBHOOKS                                                           │
416: │  ────────                                                           │
417: │  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
418: │  │  Configurable webhooks for all event types:                  │   │
419: │  │                                                              │   │
420: │  │  Event Lifecycle:                                            │   │
421: │  │  • event.created        • event.published                    │   │
422: │  │  • event.updated        • event.cancelled                    │   │
423: │  │  • event.deleted        • event.started                      │   │
424: │  │  • event.ended          • event.reminder (configurable)      │   │
425: │  │                                                              │   │
426: │  │  Participation:                                              │   │
427: │  │  • participant.registered    • participant.cancelled         │   │
428: │  │  • participant.checked_in    • participant.waitlisted        │   │
429: │  │  • capacity.threshold_reached                                │   │
430: │  │                                                              │   │
431: │  │  Organization:                                               │   │
432: │  │  • organization.member_joined   • organization.member_left   │   │
433: │  │  • organization.verified        • organization.settings_changed│  │
434: │  │                                                              │   │
435: │  │  Moderation:                                                 │   │
436: │  │  • report.created       • report.resolved                    │   │
437: │  │  • comment.flagged      • content.removed                    │   │
438: │  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
439: │                                                                     │
440: └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
441: ```

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Components/Event/EditSessionDialog.razor
````razor
 1: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients
 2: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Validators
 3: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Helpers
 4: @using FluentValidation
 5: @using MudBlazor
 6: 
 7: <MudDialog>
 8:     <TitleContent>
 9:         <MudText Typo="Typo.h6">
10:             <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Edit" Class="mr-3 mb-n1" />
11:             Edit Session
12:         </MudText>
13:     </TitleContent>
14:     <DialogContent>
15:         <MudForm @ref="form" @bind-IsValid="success" Model="sessionDto">
16:             <MudTextField @bind-Value="sessionDto.Title" Label="Title" For="@(() => sessionDto.Title)" Required="true" RequiredError="Title is required." />
17:             <MudTextField @bind-Value="sessionDto.Description" Label="Description" For="@(() => sessionDto.Description)" Lines="3" />
18:             <MudDatePicker @bind-Date="startDate" Label="Start Date" Required="true" />
19:             <MudTimePicker @bind-Time="startTime" Label="Start Time" Required="true" />
20:             <MudDatePicker @bind-Date="endDate" Label="End Date" Required="true" />
21:             <MudTimePicker @bind-Time="endTime" Label="End Time" Required="true" />
22:             <MudNumericField @bind-Value="sessionDto.MaxAudienceAttendees" Label="Max Audience" For="@(() => sessionDto.MaxAudienceAttendees)" Min="0" />
23:         </MudForm>
24:     </DialogContent>
25:     <DialogActions>
26:         <MudButton OnClick="Cancel">Cancel</MudButton>
27:         <MudButton Color="Color.Primary" OnClick="Submit">Update</MudButton>
28:     </DialogActions>
29: </MudDialog>
30: 
31: @code {
32:     [CascadingParameter]
33:     private IMudDialogInstance MudDialog { get; set; } = default!;
34: 
35:     [Parameter] public EventSessionDto ExistingSession { get; set; }
36: 
37:     private UpdateEventSessionDtoValidator validator = new();
38:     private MudForm form;
39:     private bool success;
40: 
41:     private UpdateEventSessionDto sessionDto = new();
42: 
43:     private DateTime? startDate = DateTime.Now;
44:     private TimeSpan? startTime = DateTime.Now.TimeOfDay;
45:     private DateTime? endDate = DateTime.Now.AddHours(1);
46:     private TimeSpan? endTime = DateTime.Now.AddHours(1).TimeOfDay;
47: 
48:     protected override void OnInitialized()
49:     {
50:         sessionDto.EventId = ExistingSession.EventId;
51:         sessionDto.Id = ExistingSession.Id;
52:         sessionDto.Title = ExistingSession.Title;
53:         sessionDto.Description = ExistingSession.Description;
54:         sessionDto.StartTime = ExistingSession.StartTime;
55:         sessionDto.EndTime = ExistingSession.EndTime;
56:         sessionDto.MaxAudienceAttendees = ExistingSession.MaxAudienceAttendees;
57: 
58:         // Set date/time pickers from existing session
59:         if (ExistingSession.StartTime.HasValue)
60:         {
61:             startDate = ExistingSession.StartTime.Value.Date.ToLocalTime();
62:             startTime = ExistingSession.StartTime.Value.TimeOfDay;
63:         }
64:         if (ExistingSession.EndTime.HasValue)
65:         {
66:             endDate = ExistingSession.EndTime.Value.Date.ToLocalTime();
67:             endTime = ExistingSession.EndTime.Value.TimeOfDay;
68:         }
69:     }
70: 
71:     private async Task Submit()
72:     {
73:         await form.Validate();
74:         if (form.IsValid)
75:         {
76:             // Use DateTimeHelper for consistent UTC conversion
77:             var startDateTime = startDate.Value.Date + startTime.Value;
78:             var endDateTime = endDate.Value.Date + endTime.Value;
79: 
80:             sessionDto.StartTime = DateTimeHelper.ConvertLocalToUtc(startDateTime);
81:             sessionDto.EndTime = DateTimeHelper.ConvertLocalToUtc(endDateTime);
82: 
83:             MudDialog.Close(DialogResult.Ok(sessionDto));
84:         }
85:     }
86: 
87:     void Cancel() => MudDialog.Cancel();
88: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Components/Event/ManageSpeakersDialog.razor
````razor
  1: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients

  3: @using MudBlazor
  4: @using MudBlazor.Services

  9: <MudDialog>

 20: 
 21:             <MudText Typo="Typo.h6">Current Speakers</MudText>

 24:                 {

 26:                         @speaker.ActorDisplayName

 28:                     </MudListItem>

 36:     </DialogActions>

 38: 
 39: @code {
 40:     [CascadingParameter] IMudDialogInstance MudDialog { get; set; } = default!;
 41:     [Parameter] public Guid SessionId { get; set; }
 42: 
 43:     private List<EventSessionSpeakerListDto> speakers = new();
 44:     private ActorListDto? selectedActor;
 45:     private List<ActorListDto> allActors = new();
 46: 
 47:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
 48:     {
 49:         await LoadSpeakers();
 50:         var actorsCollection = await ActorService.GetActorsAsync();
 51:         allActors = actorsCollection.ToList();
 52:     }
 53: 
 54:     private async Task LoadSpeakers()
 55:     {
 56:         // Note: Service returns ICollection<object> due to neutralized methods
 57:         var rawSpeakers = await EventSessionSpeakerService.GetSpeakersBySessionAsync(SessionId);
 58:         speakers = new List<EventSessionSpeakerListDto>(); // Will be empty until API is updated
 59:     }
 60: 
 61:     private async Task<IEnumerable<ActorListDto>> SearchActors(string value, CancellationToken token)
 62:     {
 63:         if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
 64:         {
 65:             return allActors;
 66:         }
 67:         return allActors.Where(x => x.DisplayName.Contains(value, StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase));
 68:     }
 69: 
 70:     private async Task AddSpeaker()
 71:     {
 72:         if (selectedActor != null && selectedActor.Id.HasValue)
 73:         {
 74:             // Note: Using anonymous object since CreateEventSessionSpeakerDto is not available
 75:             var newSpeaker = new { ActorId = selectedActor.Id.Value, EventSessionId = SessionId };
 76:             var response = await EventSessionSpeakerService.AddSpeakerToSessionAsync(newSpeaker);
 77:             if (response?.Success == true)
 78:             {
 79:                 Snackbar.Add("Speaker added.", Severity.Success);
 80:                 await LoadSpeakers();
 81:                 selectedActor = null;
 82:                 StateHasChanged();
 83:             }
 84:             else
 85:             {
 86:                 Snackbar.Add(response?.Message ?? "Failed to add speaker", Severity.Error);
 87:             }
 88:         }
 89:     }
 90: 
 91:     private async Task RemoveSpeaker(Guid? speakerId)
 92:     {
 93:         if (!speakerId.HasValue) return;
 94:         await EventSessionSpeakerService.RemoveSpeakerFromSessionAsync(speakerId.Value);
 95:         Snackbar.Add("Speaker removed.", Severity.Success);
 96:         await LoadSpeakers();
 97:         StateHasChanged();
 98:     }
 99: 
100:     void Submit() => MudDialog.Close(DialogResult.Ok(true));
101:     void Cancel() => MudDialog.Cancel();
102: }

147:     {
148:         if (currentUser == null)
149:         {
150:             Snackbar.Add("You must be logged in to register.", Severity.Error);
151:             return;
152:         }
153: 
154:         if (EventSessionId == Guid.Empty)
155:         {
156:             Snackbar.Add("Registration is unavailable for this session.", Severity.Error);
157:             return;
158:         }
159: 
160:         isSubmitting = true;
161: 
162:         try
163:         {
164:             var response = await EventService.RegisterForEventSessionAsync(registrationModel);
165: 
166:             if (response?.Success == true)
167:             {

169:                 Snackbar.Add("You have been successfully registered!", Severity.Success);
170:             }

172:             {

174:             }
175:         }
176:         catch (Exception ex)
177:         {
178:             Snackbar.Add($"Registration error: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
179:         }
180:         finally
181:         {
182:             isSubmitting = false;
183:         }
184:     }
185: 
186:     private void Cancel()
187:     {
188:         DialogReference?.Close();
189:     }
190:

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Components/S3Image.razor
````razor
  1: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services
  2: @using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging
  3: @inject IImageStorageService ImageStorageService
  4: @inject ILogger<S3Image> Logger
  5: <div class="s3-image-container" style="@ContainerStyle">
  6:     @if (isLoading && !hasError)
  7:     {
  8:         <div class="s3-image-placeholder">
  9:             <div class="loading-spinner">
 10:                 <MudProgressCircular Color="Color.Primary" Size="Size.Small" Indeterminate="true" />
 11:             </div>
 12:         </div>
 13:     }
 14:     else if (hasError)
 15:     {
 16:         <div class="s3-image-error">
 17:             <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.BrokenImage" Color="Color.Secondary" Size="Size.Large" />
 18:             <MudText Typo="Typo.caption">@(ErrorText ?? "Failed to load image")</MudText>
 19:         </div>
 20:     }
 21:     else if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(imageUrl))
 22:     {
 23:         <img src="@imageUrl"
 24:              alt="@Alt"
 25:              class="s3-image @(isLoading ? "loading" : "")"
 26:              @onload="OnImageLoaded"
 27:              @onerror="OnImageError" />
 28:     }
 29:     else
 30:     {
 31:         <div class="s3-image-placeholder">
 32:             <MudIcon Icon="@(PlaceholderIcon ?? Icons.Material.Filled.Image)"
 33:                     Color="Color.Secondary"
 34:                     Size="Size.Large" />
 35:         </div>
 36:     }
 37: </div>
 38: 
 39: @code {
 40:     /// <summary>
 41:     /// The S3 image key to load
 42:     /// </summary>
 43:     [Parameter] public string? ImageKey { get; set; }
 44: 
 45:     /// <summary>
 46:     /// Direct image URL (if already fetched)
 47:     /// </summary>
 48:     [Parameter] public string? ImageUrl { get; set; }
 49: 
 50:     /// <summary>
 51:     /// Alt text for the image
 52:     /// </summary>
 53:     [Parameter] public string Alt { get; set; } = "Image";
 54: 
 55:     /// <summary>
 56:     /// CSS object-fit property
 57:     /// </summary>
 58:     [Parameter] public string ObjectFit { get; set; } = "cover";
 59: 
 60:     /// <summary>
 61:     /// Border radius for the image
 62:     /// </summary>
 63:     [Parameter] public string? BorderRadius { get; set; }
 64: 
 65:     /// <summary>
 66:     /// Additional styles for the container
 67:     /// </summary>
 68:     [Parameter] public string? ContainerStyle { get; set; }
 69: 
 70:     /// <summary>
 71:     /// Icon to show when no image is available
 72:     /// </summary>
 73:     [Parameter] public string? PlaceholderIcon { get; set; }
 74: 
 75:     /// <summary>
 76:     /// Text to show on error
 77:     /// </summary>
 78:     [Parameter] public string? ErrorText { get; set; }
 79: 
 80:     /// <summary>
 81:     /// Whether to use a fallback image on error
 82:     /// </summary>
 83:     [Parameter] public string? FallbackUrl { get; set; }
 84: 
 85:     private string? imageUrl;
 86:     private bool isLoading = true;
 87:     private bool hasError = false;
 88: 
 89:     protected override async Task OnParametersSetAsync()
 90:     {
 91:         await LoadImageAsync();
 92:     }
 93: 
 94:     private async Task LoadImageAsync()
 95:     {
 96:         isLoading = true;
 97:         hasError = false;
 98:         imageUrl = null;
 99: 
100:         try
101:         {
102:             // If ImageUrl is provided directly, use it
103:             if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(ImageUrl))
104:             {
105:                 imageUrl = ImageUrl;
106:                 isLoading = false;
107:                 return;
108:             }
109: 
110:             // If ImageKey is provided, fetch the pre-signed URL
111:             if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(ImageKey))
112:             {
113:                 var url = await ImageStorageService.GetImageUrlAsync(ImageKey);
114: 
115:                 if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(url))
116:                 {
117:                     imageUrl = url;
118:                 }
119:                 else
120:                 {
121:                     hasError = true;
122:                 }
123: 
124:                 isLoading = false;
125:             }
126:             else
127:             {
128:                 // No image key or URL provided
129:                 isLoading = false;
130:             }
131:         }
132:         catch (Exception ex)
133:         {
134:             Logger.LogError(ex, "Error loading S3 image for key {ImageKey}", ImageKey);
135:             hasError = true;
136:             isLoading = false;
137:         }
138:     }
139: 
140:     private void OnImageLoaded()
141:     {
142:         isLoading = false;
143:         StateHasChanged();
144:     }
145: 
146:     private void OnImageError()
147:     {
148:         if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(FallbackUrl))
149:         {
150:             imageUrl = FallbackUrl;
151:         }
152:         else
153:         {
154:             hasError = true;
155:         }
156: 
157:         isLoading = false;
158:         StateHasChanged();
159:     }
160: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Layout/MainLayout.razor.cs
````csharp
  1: using System.Net.Http;
  2: using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services;
  3: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components;
  4: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Authorization;
  5: using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
  6: using MudBlazor;
  7: 
  8: namespace Explore.Blazor.Client.Layout;
  9: 
 10: public partial class MainLayout : LayoutComponentBase
 11: {
 12:     private bool _isDarkMode = false;
 13:     private bool _isInitialized = false;
 14:     private MudTheme? _theme;
 15:     private MudThemeProvider _mudThemeProvider = null!;
 16: 
 17:     [Inject]
 18:     protected IUserService UserService { get; set; } = null!;
 19: 
 20:     [Inject]
 21:     protected AuthenticationStateProvider AuthenticationStateProvider { get; set; } = null!;
 22: 
 23:     [Inject]
 24:     protected ILogger<MainLayout> Logger { get; set; } = null!;
 25: 
 26:     [Inject]
 27:     protected HttpClient HttpClient { get; set; } = null!;
 28: 
 29:     [CascadingParameter(Name = "InitialTheme")]
 30:     public bool? InitialTheme { get; set; }
 31: 
 32:     public string DarkLightModeButtonIcon => _isDarkMode switch
 33:     {
 34:         true => Icons.Material.Rounded.AutoMode,
 35:         false => Icons.Material.Outlined.DarkMode,
 36:     };
 37: 
 38:     protected override void OnInitialized()
 39:     {
 40:         base.OnInitialized();
 41: 
 42: 
 43:         if (InitialTheme.HasValue)
 44:         {
 45:             _isDarkMode = InitialTheme.Value;
 46:         }
 47: 
 48:         _theme = new()
 49:         {
 50:             PaletteLight = _lightPalette,
 51:             PaletteDark = _darkPalette,
 52:             LayoutProperties = new LayoutProperties()
 53:         };
 54:     }
 55: 
 56:     protected override async Task OnAfterRenderAsync(bool firstRender)
 57:     {
 58:         if (firstRender)
 59:         {
 60: 
 61:             try
 62:             {
 63:                 var authState = await AuthenticationStateProvider.GetAuthenticationStateAsync();
 64:                 if (authState.User.Identity?.IsAuthenticated == true)
 65:                 {
 66:                     await UserService.SyncUserAsync();
 67:                 }
 68:             }
 69:             catch (Exception ex)
 70:             {
 71:                 Logger.LogWarning(ex, "Error syncing user");
 72:             }
 73: 
 74: 
 75:             if (!InitialTheme.HasValue)
 76:             {
 77:                 try
 78:                 {
 79: 
 80:                     _isDarkMode = false;
 81: 
 82: 
 83:                     var systemDark = await _mudThemeProvider.GetSystemDarkModeAsync();
 84:                     if (systemDark)
 85:                     {
 86:                         _isDarkMode = true;
 87:                         await InvokeAsync(StateHasChanged);
 88:                     }
 89:                 }
 90:                 catch (Exception ex)
 91:                 {
 92:                     Logger.LogWarning(ex, "Error initializing theme");
 93:                 }
 94:             }
 95: 
 96:             _isInitialized = true;
 97:         }
 98:     }
 99: 
100:     private async Task DarkModeToggle()
101:     {
102:         _isDarkMode = !_isDarkMode;
103:         var themeValue = _isDarkMode ? "dark" : "light";
104: 
105:         try
106:         {
107: 
108:             await HttpClient.PostAsync($"/bff/theme?theme={Uri.EscapeDataString(themeValue)}", null);
109:         }
110:         catch (Exception ex)
111:         {
112:             Logger.LogWarning(ex, "Error saving theme preference");
113:         }
114:     }
115: 
116:     private readonly PaletteLight _lightPalette = new()
117:     {
118:         Primary = "#00D16F",
119:         Secondary = "#1A1A1A",
120:         Black = "#0A0A0A",
121:         AppbarText = "#1A1A1A",
122:         AppbarBackground = "rgba(245,245,247,0.8)",
123:         Background = "#F5F5F7",
124:         Surface = "#FFFFFF",
125:         DrawerBackground = "#F5F5F7",
126:         DrawerText = "#1A1A1A",

  1: .navbar {
  2:     width: 100%;
  3:     min-height: 64px;
  4:     padding: 10px 20px;
  5:     background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--mud-palette-surface) 90%, transparent);

  7:     -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  8:     border-bottom: 1px solid
  9:         color-mix(in srgb, var(--mud-palette-lines-default) 40%, transparent);
 10:     box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);

267:     border-radius: 8px;

269:     font-weight: 500;
270:     transition: all 0.15s ease;

272:

277:         transparent

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Pages/Admin/AdminList.razor.cs
````csharp
  1: using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients;
  2: using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services;
  3: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components;
  4: using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
  5: using MudBlazor;
  6: 
  7: namespace Explore.Blazor.Client.Pages.Admin;
  8: 
  9: public partial class AdminList
 10: {
 11:     [Inject] protected IDialogService DialogService { get; set; } = null!;
 12:     [Inject] protected NavigationManager Nav { get; set; } = null!;
 13:     [Inject] protected IAdminService AdminService { get; set; } = null!;
 14:     [Inject] protected IUserService UserService { get; set; } = null!;
 15:     [Inject] protected ILogger<AdminList> Logger { get; set; } = null!;
 16: 
 17: 
 18:     private enum RequestStatus { Pending = 1, Approved = 2, Rejected = 3 }
 19: 
 20:     private ICollection<OrganizationListDto> _organizationRequests = new List<OrganizationListDto>();
 21:     private string _search = string.Empty;
 22:     private int _activeTab = 0;
 23:     private bool _isLoading = true;
 24:     private string? _errorMessage;
 25:     private HashSet<RequestStatus> _selectedStatuses = new();
 26:     private enum SortOption { OldestFirst, NewestFirst, Name, Status }
 27:     private SortOption _sort = SortOption.OldestFirst;
 28: 
 29:     private int PendingCount => _organizationRequests.Count(r => r.ApprovalStatusId == (int)RequestStatus.Pending);
 30:     private int ApprovedCount => _organizationRequests.Count(r => r.ApprovalStatusId == (int)RequestStatus.Approved);
 31:     private int RejectedCount => _organizationRequests.Count(r => r.ApprovalStatusId == (int)RequestStatus.Rejected);
 32: 
 33:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
 34:     {
 35:         await LoadOrganizationRequests();
 36:     }
 37: 
 38:     private async Task LoadOrganizationRequests()
 39:     {
 40:         _isLoading = true;
 41:         _errorMessage = null;
 42: 
 43:         try
 44:         {
 45:             Logger.LogDebug("Loading organizations from API");
 46:             var tempOrgs = await AdminService.GetOrganizationRequestsAsync();
 47: 
 48:             if (tempOrgs != null)
 49:             {
 50:                 _organizationRequests = tempOrgs;
 51:                 Logger.LogDebug("Loaded {OrganizationCount} organizations", _organizationRequests.Count);
 52:             }
 53:             else
 54:             {
 55:                 _organizationRequests = new List<OrganizationListDto>();
 56:             }
 57:         }
 58:         catch (Exception ex)
 59:         {
 60:             _errorMessage = $"Failed to load organizations: {ex.Message}";
 61:             Logger.LogError(ex, "Failed to load organizations");
 62:             _organizationRequests = new List<OrganizationListDto>();
 63:         }
 64:         finally
 65:         {
 66:             _isLoading = false;
 67:         }
 68:     }
 69: 
 70:     private bool IsStatusSelected(RequestStatus s) => _selectedStatuses.Contains(s);
 71: 
 72:     private void ToggleStatus(RequestStatus s)
 73:     {
 74:         if (_selectedStatuses.Contains(s)) _selectedStatuses.Remove(s); else _selectedStatuses.Add(s);
 75:     }
 76: 
 77:     private void ClearFilters()
 78:     {
 79:         _selectedStatuses.Clear();
 80:         _search = string.Empty;
 81:         _sort = SortOption.OldestFirst;
 82:     }
 83: 
 84:     private IEnumerable<OrganizationListDto> GetFilteredAndSorted(RequestStatus? status)
 85:     {
 86:         IEnumerable<OrganizationListDto> q = _organizationRequests;
 87: 
 88:         if (status.HasValue)
 89:             q = q.Where(r => r.ApprovalStatusId == (int)status.Value);
 90: 
 91: 
 92:         if (_selectedStatuses.Count > 0)
 93:         {
 94:             var allowed = _selectedStatuses.Select(s => (int)s).ToHashSet();
 95:             q = q.Where(r => r.ApprovalStatusId.HasValue && allowed.Contains(r.ApprovalStatusId.Value));
 96:         }
 97: 
 98:         if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_search))
 99:         {
100:             var s = _search.Trim().ToLowerInvariant();
101:             q = q.Where(r =>
102:                 (r.FullName?.ToLowerInvariant().Contains(s) ?? false) ||
103:                 (r.Id.ToString().ToLowerInvariant().Contains(s)) ||
104:                 (r.Email?.ToLowerInvariant().Contains(s) ?? false) ||
105:                 (r.City?.ToLowerInvariant().Contains(s) ?? false) ||
106:                 (r.Country?.ToLowerInvariant().Contains(s) ?? false));
107:         }
108: 
109: 
110:         q = _sort switch
111:         {
112:             SortOption.NewestFirst => q.OrderByDescending(r => r.CreatedAt),
113:             SortOption.Name => q.OrderBy(r => r.FullName),
114:             SortOption.Status => q.OrderBy(r => r.ApprovalStatusId),
115:             _ => q.OrderBy(r => r.CreatedAt)
116:         };
117: 
118:         return q;
119:     }
120: 
121:     private async Task Approve(OrganizationListDto req)
122:     {
123:         if (!req.Id.HasValue) return;
124: 
125:         bool? ok = await DialogService.ShowMessageBox(
126:             "Confirm approval",
127:             $"Approve {req.FullName}?",
128:             yesText: "Approve", cancelText: "Cancel");
129: 
130:         if (ok == true)
131:         {
132:             var success = await AdminService.ApproveOrganizationAsync(req.Id.Value);
133:             if (success)
134:             {
135:                 await LoadOrganizationRequests();
136:             }
137:             else
138:             {
139:                 _errorMessage = $"Failed to approve {req.FullName}";
140:             }
141:         }
142:     }
143: 
144:     private async Task Reject(OrganizationListDto req)
145:     {
146:         if (!req.Id.HasValue) return;
147: 
148:         bool? ok = await DialogService.ShowMessageBox(
149:             "Confirm rejection",
150:             $"Reject {req.FullName}?",
151:             yesText: "Reject", cancelText: "Cancel");
152: 
153:         if (ok == true)
154:         {
155:             var success = await AdminService.RejectOrganizationAsync(req.Id.Value);
156:             if (success)
157:             {
158:                 await LoadOrganizationRequests();
159:             }
160:             else
161:             {
162:                 _errorMessage = $"Failed to reject {req.FullName}";
163:             }
164:         }
165:     }
166: 
167:     private async Task RevertToPending(OrganizationListDto req)
168:     {
169:         if (!req.Id.HasValue) return;
170:         var success = await AdminService.RevertToPendingAsync(req.Id.Value);
171:         if (success)
172:         {
173:             await LoadOrganizationRequests();
174:         }
175:         else
176:         {
177:             _errorMessage = $"Failed to revert {req.FullName} to pending";
178:         }
179:     }
180: 
181:     private void ViewDetails(OrganizationListDto req)
182:     {
183:         if (req.Id.HasValue)
184:         {
185:             Nav.NavigateTo($"/admin/organization/{req.Id.Value}");
186:         }
187:     }
188: }
````

 41:     private async Task HandleSubmit()
 42:     {
 43:         if (!CanSubmit()) return;
 44: 
 45:         isSubmitting = true;
 46:         errorMessage = string.Empty;
 47: 
 48:         try
 49:         {
 50:             organization.MetadataJson = OrganizationAppearanceMetadataHelper.Upsert(organization.MetadataJson, _appearance);
 51:             var createdOrganization = await OrganizationService.CreateOrganizationAsync(organization);
 52: 
 53:             if (createdOrganization != null)
 54:             {

 56:                 Logger.LogInformation("Organization successfully created with ID: {OrganizationId}", createdOrganization.Id);
 57:                 await Task.Delay(1000);
 58:                 NavigationManager.NavigateTo("/organization/success");
 59:             }
 60:             else
 61:             {
 62:                 errorMessage = "An error occurred while creating the organization. Please try again.";
 63:             }
 64:         }
 65:         catch (Exception ex)
 66:         {
 67:             errorMessage = $"Error creating organization: {ex.Message}";
 68:             Logger.LogError(ex, "Exception during organization creation");
 69:         }
 70:         finally
 71:         {
 72:             isSubmitting = false;
 73:         }
 74:     }
 75: 
 76:     private async Task OnLogoFileDataSelected(FileUploadData? fileData)
 77:     {
 78:         _selectedLogoData = fileData;
 79:         _logoUploadError = null;
 80: 
 81:         if (fileData == null)
 82:         {
 83:             _uploadedLogoStorageObjectId = null;
 84:             organization.ProfilePictureId = null;
 85:             return;
 86:         }
 87: 
 88:         _isUploadingLogo = true;
 89: 
 90:         await InvokeAsync(StateHasChanged);
 91:

 93:         {
 94:             var uploadResult = await ImageStorageService.UploadAndCreateRecordFromBytesAsync(fileData);
 95: 
 96:             if (uploadResult?.Success == true)
 97:             {
 98:                 _uploadedLogoStorageObjectId = uploadResult.StorageObjectId;
 99:                 organization.ProfilePictureId = uploadResult.StorageObjectId;
100:                 _logoUploadError = null;
101:             }
102:             else
103:             {
104:                 _logoUploadError = uploadResult?.ErrorMessage ?? "Failed to upload logo.";
105:                 await ClearLogoUploadState();
106:             }
107:         }
108:         catch (Exception ex)
109:         {
110:             Logger.LogError(ex, "Exception during logo upload");
111:             _logoUploadError = $"Upload error: {ex.Message}";
112:             await ClearLogoUploadState();
113:         }
114:         finally
115:         {
116:             _isUploadingLogo = false;
117: 
118:             await InvokeAsync(StateHasChanged);
119:         }
120:     }

144:     {

146:                confirmInformation &&
147:                !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(organization.FullName) &&
148:                !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(organization.Email) &&
149:                !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(organization.Address) &&
150:                !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(organization.City) &&
151:                !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(organization.Country) &&
152:                organization.Postcode > 0 &&
153:                !_isUploadingLogo;
154:     }
155: }

 52:                 ?? user.FindFirst("http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/ws/2005/05/identity/claims/nameidentifier")?.Value
 53:                 ?? user.FindFirst("oid")?.Value;

 86:     {
 87:         if (organization != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(currentUserId))
 88:         {
 89:             try
 90:             {

 92:                 var me = members.FirstOrDefault(m => m.UserId.ToString().Equals(currentUserId, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
 93:                 if (me != null)

116: 
117:             if (organization != null)

120:                 await CheckEditPermissions();

143:

153:     {

155: 
156:         try

159:             errorMessage = string.Empty;
160:             successMessage = string.Empty;
161: 
162:             editModel.MetadataJson = OrganizationAppearanceMetadataHelper.Upsert(editModel.MetadataJson, _appearance);
163:             var success = await OrganizationService.UpdateOrganizationAsync(Id, editModel!);
164: 
165:             if (success?.Success == true)

168:                 isEditMode = false;

170:             }

172:         catch (Exception ex)

175:             errorMessage = $"Failed to update organization: {ex.Message}";
176:         }
177:         finally
178:         {
179:             isSaving = false;
180:         }
181:     }

183:     private string? ValidateEmail(string email)
184:     {
185:         if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(email))
186:             return "Email is required";
187: 
188:         if (!email.Contains("@"))
189:             return "Invalid email format";
190: 
191:         return null;
192:     }

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Services/BffUnauthorizedHandler.cs
````csharp
  1: using System.Linq;
  2: using System.Net;
  3: using System.Net.Http;
  4: using System.Threading;
  5: using System.Threading.Tasks;
  6: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components;
  7: using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
  8: 
  9: namespace Explore.Blazor.Client.Services;
 10: 
 11: public sealed class BffUnauthorizedHandler : DelegatingHandler
 12: {
 13:     private static readonly string[] AnonymousApiPathPrefixes =
 14:     [
 15:         "/api/v1/publicexperience/settings",
 16:         "/api/v1/instanceonboarding/status"
 17:     ];
 18: 
 19:     private readonly NavigationManager _nav;
 20:     private readonly ILogger<BffUnauthorizedHandler> _logger;
 21: 
 22:     public BffUnauthorizedHandler(NavigationManager nav, ILogger<BffUnauthorizedHandler> logger)
 23:     {
 24:         _nav = nav;
 25:         _logger = logger;
 26:     }
 27: 
 28:     protected override async Task<HttpResponseMessage> SendAsync(HttpRequestMessage request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
 29:     {
 30:         HttpResponseMessage response;
 31:         try
 32:         {
 33:             response = await base.SendAsync(request, cancellationToken);
 34:         }
 35:         catch (Exception ex)
 36:         {
 37:             _logger.LogError(ex, "BFF handler: request failed for {Method} {Uri}", request.Method, request.RequestUri);
 38:             throw;
 39:         }
 40: 
 41:         if (response.StatusCode == HttpStatusCode.Unauthorized)
 42:         {
 43:             var path = request.RequestUri?.AbsolutePath ?? string.Empty;
 44:             var currentRelativePath = _nav.ToBaseRelativePath(_nav.Uri);
 45:             if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(currentRelativePath))
 46:             {
 47:                 currentRelativePath = "/";
 48:             }
 49:             else if (!currentRelativePath.StartsWith('/'))
 50:             {
 51:                 currentRelativePath = "/" + currentRelativePath;
 52:             }
 53:             else
 54:             {
 55:                 var queryIndex = currentRelativePath.IndexOf('?', System.StringComparison.Ordinal);
 56:                 if (queryIndex >= 0)
 57:                 {
 58:                     currentRelativePath = currentRelativePath[..queryIndex];
 59:                 }
 60:             }
 61: 
 62: 
 63:             if (path.StartsWith("/login", System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
 64:                 path.StartsWith("/logout", System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
 65:                 path.StartsWith("/auth", System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
 66:             {
 67:                 _logger.LogDebug("BFF handler: received 401 from auth endpoint {Method} {Uri}", request.Method, request.RequestUri);
 68:                 return response;
 69:             }
 70: 
 71: 
 72:             if (currentRelativePath.StartsWith("/login", System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
 73:                 currentRelativePath.StartsWith("/logout", System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
 74:             {
 75:                 _logger.LogDebug("BFF handler: suppressing 401 redirect while on auth page {CurrentPath}", currentRelativePath);
 76:                 return response;
 77:             }
 78: 
 79: 
 80:             if (AnonymousApiPathPrefixes.Any(prefix => path.StartsWith(prefix, System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)))
 81:             {
 82:                 _logger.LogDebug("BFF handler: received 401 from anonymous endpoint {Method} {Uri}", request.Method, request.RequestUri);
 83:                 return response;
 84:             }
 85: 
 86:             _logger.LogWarning("BFF handler: received 401 for {Method} {Uri} - redirecting to /login", request.Method, request.RequestUri);
 87: 
 88:             var relativeCurrentPath = _nav.ToBaseRelativePath(_nav.Uri);
 89:             if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(relativeCurrentPath))
 90:             {
 91:                 relativeCurrentPath = "/";
 92:             }
 93:             else if (!relativeCurrentPath.StartsWith('/'))
 94:             {
 95:                 relativeCurrentPath = "/" + relativeCurrentPath;
 96:             }
 97: 
 98:             var returnUrl = Uri.EscapeDataString(relativeCurrentPath);
 99:             _nav.NavigateTo($"/login?returnUrl={returnUrl}", forceLoad: true);
100:         }
101: 
102:         return response;
103:     }
104: }
````

## File: README.md
````markdown
  1: <a name="readme-top"></a>
  2: 
  3: <div align="center">
  4: 
  5: # ISLAMU Event
  6: 
  7: # Event Platform & Management System — v0.1.0 Beta
  8: 
  9: ⚠️ **Beta Release**: Currently at v0.1.0 — First public release ready for beta testing and early adopters. API may change before 1.0.0 stable release.
 10: 
 11: ISLAMU Event is a self-hostable, decentralized, multi-tenant event platform for any community or industry.
 12: The ISLAMU organization hosts a public instance focused on Islamic events, but the software itself is purpose-agnostic, fully white-label, and designed to be rebranded for any use case.
 13: 
 14: ![GitHub Workflow Status][github-workflow-status-shield]
 15: [![Codecov][codecov-shield]][codecov-link]
 16: [![Quality Gate Status][sonarcloud-shield]][sonarcloud-link]
 17: [![GitHub License][github-license-shield]][github-license-link]
 18: [![GitHub Repo Stars][github-stars-shield]][github-stars-link]
 19: [![GitHub Last Commit][github-last-commit-shield]][github-last-commit-link]
 20: [![Contributors][github-contributors-shield]][github-contributors-link]
 21: [![Discussions][github-discussions-shield]][github-discussions-link]
 22: [![Discord][discord-shield]][discord-link]
 23: 
 24: [**ISLAMU's Islamic Instance**][islamu-platform] · [**Docs**](docs/index.md) · [**Roadmap**][roadmap-link]
 25: 
 26: </div>
 27: 
 28: ---
 29: 
 30: ## ℹ About ISLAMU Event
 31: 
 32: ISLAMU Event is a **self-hostable event discovery and management platform** that helps communities find, organize, and promote events. Built with advanced filtering, verification workflows, and cultural intelligence to serve diverse communities worldwide.
 33: 
 34: > **v0.1.0 Beta** — First public release ready for beta testing. [See what's included →](docs/semantic_versioning/v0.1.0.md)
 35: 
 36: > Give us a Star ⭐️
 37: 
 38: ### Platform Flexibility
 39: - **The software is general-purpose**: Adaptable for any kind of events, communities, and organizations (tech meetups, conferences, workshops, community gatherings)
 40: - **The ISLAMU-hosted instance is Islamic-focused**: Our public instance at [event.openislamu.org](https://event.openislamu.org) is curated for Islamic events and community needs
 41: - **White-label ready**: Rebrand and customize the platform for your specific use case with full control over branding, policies, and features
 42: 
 43: ## ✨ Why ISLAMU Event
 44: 
 45: ### Key Differentiators
 46: 
 47: - **🔐 Security-First:** BFF pattern (no tokens in browser), Cerbos fine-grained authorization, Infisical secrets management
 48: - **🛡️ Verified Organizations:** Two-tier verification system for trust and quality
 49: - **⚡ Multi-Tenancy:** Runtime mode switching (Single-tenant ↔ Multi-tenant) without code changes
 50: - **🔧 Modular Events:** Plugin-style aspects (Islamic, Tech) with per-tenant enablement
 51: - **🎯 Cultural Intelligence:** Advanced filtering based on enabled modules. filter by madhab, gender, age, prayer times, skill level...
 52: - **🏗️ Enterprise Architecture:** Clean Architecture + CQRS with MediatR, REST Level 3 (HATEOAS)
 53: - **🌍 Federation-Ready:** ATProto/ActivityPub data models complete (Phase 1), protocol endpoints planned for 1.0.0
 54: - **🧪 Test Coverage:** 7 test projects (TUnit, bUnit, architecture tests)
 55: - **📖 Open Source:** AGPL-3.0 licensed for transparency and community ownership
 56: 
 57: ---
 58: 
 59: ## 🎯 Core Features (v0.1.0)
 60: 
 61: ### For Event Seekers
 62: 
 63: - **🔍 Advanced Discovery:** 33 query parameters including title search, date range, location radius, categories, tags, and more
 64: - **👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Culturally-Aware Filters:** Age ranges, gender segregation modes, madhab targeting, prayer-relative timing (for instances that enable these modules)
 65: - **🌐 Multi-Language Support:** Event sessions with multiple language options
 66: - **📱 Responsive Design:** Mobile-friendly Blazor UI with MudBlazor components
 67: - **✅ RSVP & Registration:** Waitlists, approval workflows, registration limits per session
 68: 
 69: ### For Event Organizers
 70: 
 71: - **📅 Multi-Session Events:** Conferences, seminars, recurring programs with speakers, agendas, and language variants
 72: - **🛡️ Organization Verification:** Two-tier system (user-submitted vs. verified organizations)
 73: - **👥 Member Management:** Invite members, assign roles (Owner, Admin, Editor, Viewer), track permissions
 74: - **⭐ Reviews & Ratings:** Users can review verified organizations to build trust
 75: - **🎯 Modular Event Types:** Enable Islamic or Tech aspects per event based on tenant configuration
 76: - **📊 Flexible Publishing:** Open registration, approval-required, or invite-only policies
 77: 
 78: ### For Platform Owners
 79: 
 80: - **🐳 Docker-Ready:** One-command deployment with `docker-compose up -d`
 81: - **💼 Multi-Tenancy:** Switch between single-tenant and SaaS modes at runtime without code changes
 82: - **🛠️ White-Label Control:** Custom branding, domains, logos, navigation links, policies per tenant
 83: - **🔧 Admin Hierarchy:** Instance admins, tenant admins, and organization admins with cascading settings
 84: - **🌍 Federation Foundation:** ATProto/ActivityPub data models complete (Phase 1), protocol endpoints planned for 1.0.0
 85: - **📚 Comprehensive Docs:** Architecture, deployment, configuration, troubleshooting, and API reference
 86: - **🔐 Enterprise Security:** BFF pattern, Cerbos authorization, Infisical secrets, HATEOAS REST API
 87: 
 88: ##  Deployment & Hosting Options
 89: 
 90: This platform is designed to be flexible and self-hostable for any organization.
 91: 
 92: - **Single-Instance Mode**: One organization or community per deployment
 93: - **Multi-Tenant SaaS Mode**: Multiple isolated tenants with custom domains and branding
 94: 
 95: See [Operations Guide][operations-doc] for full deployment details and examples.
 96: 
 97: ## 🎨 Branding & Customization
 98: 
 99: ISLAMU Event is built for white-label use:
100: 
101: - **Change instance name and domain**
102: - **Customize logos, colors, and UI**
103: - **Define your own categories, tags, and policies**
104: - **Decide who can publish events and how verification works**
105: 
106: See [Configuration Guide][configuration-doc] for full customization options.
107: 
108: ## 🛡️ Enterprise Security & Compliance
109: 
110: We treat security as a first-class citizen, not an afterthought.
111: 
112: * **Identity & Access:** Managed via **Keycloak**, supporting MFA, Social Login, and SAML/LDAP integration.
113: * **Authorization:** Fine-grained access control (FGAC) powered by **Cerbos**: Policy Decision Point that coordinates unified policy-based authorization, allowing for complex "Who can do what" logic with human readable yaml for non technical users.
114: * **Data Integrity:** All database interactions use **Parameterized EF Core queries** to eliminate SQL injection.
115: * **Secret Management:** Zero hardcoded credentials; all secrets are injected at runtime via **Infisical**.
116: * **Observability:** Integrated **OpenTelemetry** for distributed tracing and real-time security monitoring.
117: 
118: ### Security Features
119: 
120: - **🔒 HTTPS Enforcement:** All traffic encrypted with HSTS
121: - **🔐 Modern Authentication:** OAuth 2.0/OIDC via Keycloak
122: - **🗝️ Secret Management:** Infisical vault for credentials
123: - **🛡️ Authorization:** Policy-based access control via Cerbos
124: - **🔍 Input Validation:** FluentValidation + ASP.NET Core model binding
125: - **🚫 SQL Injection Prevention:** Parameterized queries (EF Core)
126: - **🌐 CORS:** Configurable origin whitelist
127: - **⏱️ Rate Limiting:** ASP.NET Core middleware
128: 
129: ### Extensibility Model
130: 
131: Events use **composition over inheritance**:
132: 
133: ```
134: Event (Core)
135:   ├── IslamicDetails (optional aspect)
136:   ├── TechDetails (optional aspect)
137:   └── EducationalDetails (optional aspect)
138: ```
139: 
140: A "Ramadan Tech Workshop" has both Islamic and Tech aspects. No class explosion.
141: 
142: See [EXTENSIBILITY.md](docs/EXTENSIBILITY.md) and [MODULAR_EVENTS.md](docs/MODULAR_EVENTS.md).
143:

261: ## 🏗️ Technical Overview
262: 
263: ISLAMU Event is built on **Clean Architecture + CQRS** with a **BFF (Backend-for-Frontend)** pattern.
264: 
265: ### Technology Stack (v0.1.0)
266: 
267: | Component | Technology | Purpose |
268: |-----------|------------|---------|
269: | **Runtime** | .NET 10.0 | Latest LTS framework |
270: | **Architecture** | Clean Architecture + CQRS | Layer separation with MediatR |
271: | **Frontend** | Blazor Server + WASM | Hybrid rendering (InteractiveAuto) |
272: | **UI Components** | MudBlazor | Material Design components |
273: | **Database** | PostgreSQL + PostGIS | Relational + spatial queries |
274: | **ORM** | Entity Framework Core 10 | Data access with named query filters |
275: | **Authentication** | Keycloak (OIDC/OAuth 2.0) | Identity provider with BFF pattern |
276: | **Authorization** | Cerbos | Policy Decision Point (PDP) for FGAC |
277: | **Secrets** | Infisical | Vault with auto-refresh + health checks |
278: | **API Docs** | Scalar + Swagger/NSwag | OpenAPI 3.0 with HAL+JSON |
279: | **Logging** | Serilog | Structured logging to Loki |
280: | **Telemetry** | OpenTelemetry | Distributed tracing + Prometheus metrics |
281: | **Orchestration** | .NET Aspire (dev), Docker (prod) | Service orchestration |
282: | **Test Framework** | TUnit + bUnit | Unit + integration + component tests |
283: 
284: ### The Request Lifecycle (CQRS)
285: We utilize **MediatR** for a decoupled command/query pipeline. This ensures that our business logic is isolated from transport layers (API/Blazor).
286: 
287: ```mermaid
288: graph TD
289:     subgraph Client_Layer [Presentation]
290:         A[Blazor WASM / Mobile] -->|HTTPS/REST| B[ASP.NET Core API]
291:     end
292: 
293:     subgraph Application_Layer [Business Logic]
294:         B -->|Command/Query| C[MediatR Pipeline]
295:         C -->|Validation| D[FluentValidation]
296:         D -->|Execution| E[Domain Handler]
297:     end
298: 
299:     subgraph Infrastructure_Layer [Data & Services]
300:         E -->|EF Core| F[(PostgreSQL + PostGIS)]
301:         E -->|OIDC| G[Keycloak]
302:         E -->|Events| H[Svix Webhooks]
303:     end
304: 
305:     E -.->|Future| I[ATProto / ActivityPub Gateway]
306: ```
307: 
308: ```mermaid
309: graph LR
310:     A[Request] --> B[Controller]
311:     B --> C[MediatR]
312:     C --> D[Handler]
313:     D --> E[Repository]
314:     E --> F[(PostgreSQL)]
315:     D --> G[Response]
316: ```
