 35:     private readonly ITenantContext _tenantContext;
 36:     private readonly IMapper _mapper;
 37: 
 38:     // ✅ Inject repositories, not DbContext
 39:     public Create{Entity}CommandHandler(
 40:         I{Entity}Repository {entity}Repository,
 41:         I{RelatedEntity1}Repository {relatedEntity1}Repository,
 42:         I{RelatedEntity2}Repository {relatedEntity2}Repository,
 43:         I{LookupEntity}Repository {lookupEntity}Repository,
 44:         IUserContext userContext,
 45:         ITenantContext tenantContext,
 46:         IMapper mapper)
 47:     {
 48:         _{entity}Repository = {entity}Repository;
 49:         _{relatedEntity1}Repository = {relatedEntity1}Repository;
 50:         _{relatedEntity2}Repository = {relatedEntity2}Repository;
 51:         _{lookupEntity}Repository = {lookupEntity}Repository;
 52:         _userContext = userContext;
 53:         _tenantContext = tenantContext;
 54:         _mapper = mapper;
 55:     }
 56: 
 57:     public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>> Handle(Create{Entity}Command request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
 58:     {
 59:         var response = new BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>();
 60: 
 61:         // Validation...
 62:         var {entity} = _mapper.Map<{Entity}>(request.{Entity}Dto);
 63:         {entity}.ViewCount = 0;
 64: 
 65:         // ✅ Use repository methods
 66:         {entity} = await _{entity}Repository.Create({entity});
 67: 
 68:         response.Success = true;
 69:         response.Id = {entity}.Id;
 70:         response.Message = "{Entity} created successfully.";
 71: 
 72:         return response;
 73:     }
 74: }
 75: ```
 76: 
 77: **Why Repositories?**
 78: - ✅ Application layer doesn't depend on EF Core
 79: - ✅ Can mock repositories for unit tests
 80: - ✅ Encapsulates complex queries
 81: - ✅ Consistent data access patterns
 82: 
 83: ---
 84: 
 85: ## AutoMapper Usage
 86: 
 87: **Query Handler Example**:
 88: ```csharp
 89: // File: {Project}.Application/Features/{Entities}/Handlers/Queries/Get{Entity}ListRequestHandler.cs
 90: namespace {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Handlers.Queries;
 91: 
 92: using System.Collections.Generic;
 93: using System.Threading;
 94: using System.Threading.Tasks;
 95: using AutoMapper;
 96: using {Project}.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 97: using {Project}.Application.DTOs.{Entity};
 98: using {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Requests.Queries;
 99: using MediatR;
100: 
101: public class Get{Entity}ListRequestHandler : IRequestHandler<Get{Entity}ListRequest, List<{Entity}ListDto>>
102: {
103:     private readonly I{Entity}Repository _{entity}Repository;
104:     private readonly IMapper _mapper;
105: 
106:     public Get{Entity}ListRequestHandler(I{Entity}Repository {entity}Repository, IMapper mapper)
107:     {
108:         _{entity}Repository = {entity}Repository;
109:         _mapper = mapper;
110:     }
111: 
112:     public async Task<List<{Entity}ListDto>> Handle(Get{Entity}ListRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
113:     {
114:         // ✅ Repository returns List<{Entity}> (entities)
115:         var {entities} = await _{entity}Repository.Get{Entities}WithDetails();
116: 
117:         // ✅ AutoMapper maps entities → DTOs
118:         return _mapper.Map<List<{Entity}ListDto>>({entities});
119:     }
120: }
121: ```
122: 
123: **Common AutoMapper Patterns**:
124: ```csharp
125: // Map DTO → Entity (Create)
126: var entity = _mapper.Map<{Entity}>(request.{Entity}Dto);
127: 
128: // Map DTO → Existing Entity (Update)
129: _mapper.Map(request.{Entity}Dto, existingEntity);
130: 
131: // Map Entity → DTO (Read)
132: var dto = _mapper.Map<{Entity}Dto>(entity);
133: 
134: // Map Entity Collection → DTO Collection (List)
135: var dtos = _mapper.Map<List<{Entity}ListDto>>(entities);
136: ```
137: 
138: ---
139: 
140: ## CancellationToken Pattern
141: 
142: **Always include `CancellationToken` parameter in Handle method**:
143: 
144: ```csharp
145: public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>> Handle(
146:     Create{Entity}Command request,
147:     CancellationToken cancellationToken)  // ✅ Always include
148: {
149:     // Pass cancellationToken to all async operations that accept it
150:     await _{entity}Repository.Create({entity});
151: }
152: ```
153: 
154: **Why?**
155: - ✅ Enables request cancellation
156: - ✅ Prevents wasted work when client disconnects
157: - ✅ Required by MediatR `IRequestHandler<TRequest, TResponse>`
158: 
159: ---
160: 
161: ## Manual Validator Instantiation Pattern
162: 
163: **CRITICAL PATTERN**: Validators are instantiated manually with dependencies, NOT injected via DI.
164: 
165: ```csharp
166: public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>> Handle(Create{Entity}Command request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
167: {
168:     var response = new BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>();
169: 
170:     // ✅ CRITICAL: Manual validator instantiation with all required repositories
171:     var validator = new Create{Entity}DtoValidator(
172:         _{relatedEntity1}Repository,
173:         _{relatedEntity2}Repository,
174:         _{lookupEntity}Repository,
175:         _{storageObject}Repository);
176: 
177:     var validationResult = await validator.ValidateAsync(request.{Entity}Dto, cancellationToken);
178: 
179:     if (!validationResult.IsValid)
180:     {
181:         response.Success = false;
182:         response.Message = "{Entity} creation failed.";
183:         response.Errors = validationResult.Errors.Select(e => e.ErrorMessage).ToList();
184:         return response;
185:     }
186: 
187:     // Continue with business logic...
188: }
189: ```
190: 
191: **Why Manual Instantiation?**
192: - ✅ Fine-grained control over dependencies
193: - ✅ Validators can have different repository dependencies per use case
194: - ✅ No need to register validators in DI container
195: - ✅ Clear and explicit
196: 
197: ---
198: 
199: ## Command Handler Pattern (Create)
200: 
201: **Full Pattern**:
202: ```csharp
203: public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>> Handle(Create{Entity}Command request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
204: {
205:     var response = new BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>();
206: 
207:     // 1. Manual validation
208:     var validator = new Create{Entity}DtoValidator(/* repositories */);
209:     var validationResult = await validator.ValidateAsync(request.{Entity}Dto);
210: 
211:     if (!validationResult.IsValid)
212:     {
213:         response.Success = false;
214:         response.Message = "{Entity} creation failed.";
215:         response.Errors = validationResult.Errors.Select(e => e.ErrorMessage).ToList();
216:         return response;
217:     }
218: 
219:     // 2. Map DTO → Entity
220:     var {entity} = _mapper.Map<{Entity}>(request.{Entity}Dto);
221: 
222:     // 3. Set default values (not in DTO)
223:     {entity}.ViewCount = 0;
224:     {entity}.TenantId = _tenantContext.TenantId;
225: 
226:     // 4. Save through repository
227:     {entity} = await _{entity}Repository.Create({entity});
228: 
229:     // 5. Return success response
230:     response.Success = true;
231:     response.Id = {entity}.Id;
232:     response.Message = "{Entity} created successfully.";
233: 
234:     return response;
235: }
236: ```
237: 
238: ---
239: 
240: ## Command Handler Pattern (Update)
241: 
242: **Full Pattern**:
243: ```csharp
244: public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>> Handle(Update{Entity}Command request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
245: {
246:     var response = new BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>();
247: 
248:     // 1. Validate
249:     var validator = new Update{Entity}DtoValidator(/* repositories */);
250:     var validationResult = await validator.ValidateAsync(request.{Entity}Dto);
251: 
252:     if (!validationResult.IsValid)
253:     {
254:         response.Success = false;
255:         response.Message = "{Entity} update failed.";
256:         response.Errors = validationResult.Errors.Select(e => e.ErrorMessage).ToList();
257:         return response;
258:     }
259: 
260:     // 2. Get existing entity
261:     var {entity} = await _{entity}Repository.GetById(request.{Entity}Dto.Id);
262: 
263:     if ({entity} == null)
264:     {
265:         response.Success = false;
266:         response.Message = "{Entity} not found.";
267:         return response;
268:     }
269: 
270:     // 3. Map DTO → Existing Entity
271:     _mapper.Map(request.{Entity}Dto, {entity});
272: 
273:     // 4. Update through repository
274:     await _{entity}Repository.Update({entity});
275: 
276:     // 5. Return success response
277:     response.Success = true;
278:     response.Id = {entity}.Id;
279:     response.Message = "{Entity} updated successfully.";
280: 
281:     return response;
282: }
283: ```
284: 
285: ---
286: 
287: ## Command Handler Pattern (Delete)
288: 
289: **Full Pattern**:
290: ```csharp
291: public async Task<bool> Handle(Delete{Entity}Command request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
292: {
293:     // 1. Get entity
294:     var {entity} = await _{entity}Repository.GetById(request.Id);
295: 
296:     // 2. Check if exists
297:     if ({entity} == null)
298:         return false;
299: 
300:     // 3. Delete through repository
301:     await _{entity}Repository.Delete({entity});
302: 
303:     // 4. Return success
304:     return true;
305: }
306: ```
307: 
308: **Note**: Delete returns `bool`, not `BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>`.
309: 
310: ---
311: 
312: ## Query Handler Pattern (List)
313: 
314: **Full Pattern**:
315: ```csharp
316: public async Task<List<{Entity}ListDto>> Handle(Get{Entity}ListRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
317: {
318:     // 1. Get entities from repository
319:     var {entities} = await _{entity}Repository.Get{Entities}WithDetails();
320: 
321:     // 2. Map entities → DTOs
322:     return _mapper.Map<List<{Entity}ListDto>>({entities});
323: }
324: ```
325: 
326: **Key Points**:
327: - ❌ No validation needed for queries
328: - ❌ No BaseCommandResponse wrapper
329: - ✅ Return DTOs directly
330: - ✅ Repository returns entities, handler maps to DTOs
331: 
332: ---
333: 
334: ## Query Handler Pattern (Details)
335: 
336: **Full Pattern**:
337: ```csharp
338: public async Task<{Entity}Dto> Handle(Get{Entity}DetailsRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
339: {
340:     // 1. Get entity from repository
341:     var {entity} = await _{entity}Repository.Get{Entity}WithDetails(request.Id);
342: 
343:     // 2. Return null if not found (controller handles NotFound)
344:     if ({entity} == null)
345:         return null;
346: 
347:     // 3. Map entity → DTO
348:     return _mapper.Map<{Entity}Dto>({entity});
349: }
350: ```
351: 
352: **Key Points**:
353: - ✅ Return `null` for not found (not exception)
354: - ✅ Controller checks for null and returns `NotFound()`
355: - ✅ Simple and straightforward
356: 
357: ---
358: 
359: ## Error Handling Pattern
360: 
361: **Commands**:
362: ```csharp
363: // Validation errors
364: if (!validationResult.IsValid)
365: {
366:     response.Success = false;
367:     response.Message = "Operation failed.";
368:     response.Errors = validationResult.Errors.Select(e => e.ErrorMessage).ToList();
369:     return response;
370: }
371: 
372: // Not found errors
373: if (entity == null)
374: {
375:     response.Success = false;
376:     response.Message = "Entity not found.";
377:     return response;
378: }
379: 
380: // Success
381: response.Success = true;
382: response.Id = entity.Id;
383: response.Message = "Operation successful.";
384: return response;
385: ```
386: 
387: **Queries**:
388: ```csharp
389: // Not found
390: if (entity == null)
391:     return null;  // Let controller handle NotFound()
392: 
393: // Success
394: return _mapper.Map<{Entity}Dto>(entity);
395: ```
396: 
397: ---
398: 
399: ## Dependency Injection Registration
400: 
401: **Handlers are auto-registered by MediatR**:
402: ```csharp
403: // File: {Project}.API/Program.cs
404: using {Project}.Application.Profiles;
405: 
406: // Register MediatR (scans assembly for handlers)
407: builder.Services.AddMediatR(cfg =>
408:     cfg.RegisterServicesFromAssembly(typeof(MappingProfile).Assembly));
409: 
410: // Register AutoMapper
411: builder.Services.AddAutoMapper(typeof(MappingProfile));
412: ```
413: 
414: **No need to manually register each handler!**
415: 
416: ---
417: 
418: ## Common Patterns Summary
419: 
420: | Pattern | Command | Query |
421: |---------|---------|-------|
422: | **Response Type** | `BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>` (or `bool` for Delete) | DTO type directly |
423: | **Validation** | Manual with validator | Not needed |
424: | **Repository** | CRUD operations | Read with `.Include()` |
425: | **Mapping** | DTO → Entity | Entity → DTO |
426: | **Error Handling** | Success flag + errors | Return null |
427: | **Controller** | Check `Success` flag | Check for null |
428: 
429: ---
430: 
431: **See Also**:
432: - [command-patterns.md](command-patterns.md) - Command request/handler structure
433: - [query-patterns.md](query-patterns.md) - Query request/handler structure
434: - [validation-integration.md](validation-integration.md) - FluentValidation patterns
````

## File: .claude/skills/cqrs-mediatr-guidelines/resources/query-patterns.md
````markdown
  1: # Query Patterns - Project Conventions
  2: 
  3: > **Project-Agnostic Query Patterns**
  4: >
  5: > Placeholders use `{Placeholder}` syntax - see [docs/TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md](../../../../docs/TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md).
  6: 
  7: ## Query Conventions
  8: 
  9: Queries in this project follow a specific pattern with `Request` suffix (not `Query`) and return DTOs directly.
 10: 
 11: ## File Organization
 12: 
 13: ```
 14: {Project}.Application/Features/{Entities}/
 15: ├── Requests/Queries/
 16: │   ├── Get{Entity}ListRequest.cs
 17: │   ├── Get{Entity}DetailsRequest.cs
 18: │   └── GetMy{Entities}Request.cs
 19: └── Handlers/Queries/
 20:     ├── Get{Entity}ListRequestHandler.cs
 21:     ├── Get{Entity}DetailsRequestHandler.cs
 22:     └── GetMy{Entities}RequestHandler.cs
 23: 
 24: {Project}.Application/DTOs/{Entity}/
 25: ├── {Entity}ListDto.cs          # For list views
 26: ├── {Entity}Dto.cs              # For detail views
 27: └── (other DTOs)
 28: ```
 29: 
 30: ## List Query Pattern
 31: 
 32: ### 1. Query Request
 33: 
 34: **Example**:
 35: ```csharp
 36: // File: {Project}.Application/Features/{Entities}/Requests/Queries/Get{Entity}ListRequest.cs
 37: namespace {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Requests.Queries;
 38: 
 39: using System.Collections.Generic;
 40: using {Project}.Application.DTOs.{Entity};
 41: using MediatR;
 42: 
 43: public class Get{Entity}ListRequest : IRequest<List<{Entity}ListDto>>
 44: {
 45: }
 46: ```
 47: 
 48: **Key Conventions**:
 49: - ✅ Class name ends with `Request` (not `Query`)
 50: - ✅ Implements `IRequest<List<TDto>>`
 51: - ✅ Returns `List<{Entity}ListDto>` directly (no wrapper)
 52: - ✅ Can include filter properties if needed
 53: 
 54: ### 2. Query Handler
 55: 
 56: **Example**:
 57: ```csharp
 58: // File: {Project}.Application/Features/{Entities}/Handlers/Queries/Get{Entity}ListRequestHandler.cs
 59: namespace {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Handlers.Queries;
 60: 
 61: using System.Collections.Generic;
 62: using System.Threading;
 63: using System.Threading.Tasks;
 64: using AutoMapper;
 65: using {Project}.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 66: using {Project}.Application.DTOs.{Entity};
 67: using {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Requests.Queries;
 68: using MediatR;
 69: 
 70: public class Get{Entity}ListRequestHandler : IRequestHandler<Get{Entity}ListRequest, List<{Entity}ListDto>>
 71: {
 72:     private readonly I{Entity}Repository _{entity}Repository;
 73:     private readonly IMapper _mapper;
 74: 
 75:     public Get{Entity}ListRequestHandler(I{Entity}Repository {entity}Repository, IMapper mapper)
 76:     {
 77:         _{entity}Repository = {entity}Repository;
 78:         _mapper = mapper;
 79:     }
 80: 
 81:     public async Task<List<{Entity}ListDto>> Handle(Get{Entity}ListRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
 82:     {
 83:         // ✅ Repository returns List<{Entity}> (entities)
 84:         var {entities} = await _{entity}Repository.Get{Entities}WithDetails();
 85: 
 86:         // ✅ AutoMapper maps entities → DTOs
 87:         return _mapper.Map<List<{Entity}ListDto>>({entities});
 88:     }
 89: }
 90: ```
 91: 
 92: **Key Patterns**:
 93: - ✅ Uses `I{Entity}Repository`, not DbContext
 94: - ✅ Repository method returns `List<{Entity}>` (entities)
 95: - ✅ AutoMapper maps entities to DTOs
 96: - ✅ Returns DTOs directly, no `BaseCommandResponse` wrapper
 97: 
 98: ### 3. List DTO
 99: 
100: **Example**:
101: ```csharp
102: // File: {Project}.Application/DTOs/{Entity}/{Entity}ListDto.cs
103: namespace {Project}.Application.DTOs.{Entity};
104: 
105: using System;
106: 
107: public class {Entity}ListDto
108: {
109:     public {IdType} Id { get; set; }
110:     public string Title { get; set; } = string.Empty;
111:     public string Description { get; set; } = string.Empty;
112:     public string {LookupEntity}Name { get; set; } = string.Empty;
113:     public string {RelatedEntity1}Name { get; set; } = string.Empty;
114:     public string {RelatedEntity2}Name { get; set; } = string.Empty;
115: }
116: ```
117: 
118: **Conventions**:
119: - ✅ Minimal properties for list views
120: - ✅ Include navigation property names (e.g., `{LookupEntity}Name`, not just `{LookupEntity}Id`)
121: - ✅ Suffix with `ListDto`
122: 
123: ## Details Query Pattern
124: 
125: ### 1. Query Request
126: 
127: **Example**:
128: ```csharp
129: // File: {Project}.Application/Features/{Entities}/Requests/Queries/Get{Entity}DetailsRequest.cs
130: namespace {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Requests.Queries;
131: 
132: using System;
133: using {Project}.Application.DTOs.{Entity};
134: using MediatR;
135: 
136: public class Get{Entity}DetailsRequest : IRequest<{Entity}Dto?>
137: {
138:     public {IdType} Id { get; set; }
139: }
140: ```
141: 
142: ### 2. Query Handler
143: 
144: **Example**:
145: ```csharp
146: // File: {Project}.Application/Features/{Entities}/Handlers/Queries/Get{Entity}DetailsRequestHandler.cs
147: namespace {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Handlers.Queries;
148: 
149: using System.Threading;
150: using System.Threading.Tasks;
151: using AutoMapper;
152: using {Project}.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
153: using {Project}.Application.DTOs.{Entity};
154: using {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Requests.Queries;
155: using MediatR;
156: 
157: public class Get{Entity}DetailsRequestHandler : IRequestHandler<Get{Entity}DetailsRequest, {Entity}Dto?>
158: {
159:     private readonly I{Entity}Repository _{entity}Repository;
160:     private readonly IMapper _mapper;
161: 
162:     public Get{Entity}DetailsRequestHandler(I{Entity}Repository {entity}Repository, IMapper mapper)
163:     {
164:         _{entity}Repository = {entity}Repository;
165:         _mapper = mapper;
166:     }
167: 
168:     public async Task<{Entity}Dto?> Handle(Get{Entity}DetailsRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
169:     {
170:         // ✅ Repository returns {Entity}? (nullable entity)
171:         var {entity} = await _{entity}Repository.Get{Entity}WithDetails(request.Id);
172: 
173:         // ✅ Return null if not found (controller handles NotFound)
174:         if ({entity} == null)
175:         {
176:             return null;
177:         }
178: 
179:         // ✅ Map entity → DTO
180:         return _mapper.Map<{Entity}Dto>({entity});
181:     }
182: }
183: ```
184: 
185: ### 3. Details DTO
186: 
187: **Example**:
188: ```csharp
189: // File: {Project}.Application/DTOs/{Entity}/{Entity}Dto.cs
190: namespace {Project}.Application.DTOs.{Entity};
191: 
192: using System;
193: 
194: public class {Entity}Dto
195: {
196:     public {IdType} Id { get; set; }
197:     public string Title { get; set; } = string.Empty;
198:     public string? Description { get; set; }
199:     public string? Slug { get; set; }
200: 
201:     public {LookupIdType} {LookupEntity}Id { get; set; }
202:     public string {LookupEntity}FullName { get; set; } = string.Empty;
203:     public string {LookupEntity}MasterCode { get; set; } = string.Empty;
204: 
205:     public {LookupIdType} {RelatedEntity1}Id { get; set; }
206:     public string {RelatedEntity1}FullName { get; set; } = string.Empty;
207:     public string {RelatedEntity1}MasterCode { get; set; } = string.Empty;
208: 
209:     public {LookupIdType} {RelatedEntity2}Id { get; set; }
210:     public string {RelatedEntity2}FullName { get; set; } = string.Empty;
211:     public string {RelatedEntity2}MasterCode { get; set; } = string.Empty;
212:     public int? {RelatedEntity2}MinValue { get; set; }
213:     public int? {RelatedEntity2}MaxValue { get; set; }
214: 
215:     public {IdType} OwnerId { get; set; }
216:     public string OwnerDisplayName { get; set; } = string.Empty;
217:     public string? OwnerHandle { get; set; }
218:     public int OwnerTypeId { get; set; }
219:     public string OwnerTypeFullName { get; set; } = string.Empty;
220:     public {IdType}? OwnerProfilePictureId { get; set; }
221:     public string? OwnerProfilePictureUri { get; set; }
222: 
223:     public decimal? Price { get; set; }
224:     public string? CurrencyCode { get; set; }
225: 
226:     public {IdType}? FeaturedImageId { get; set; }
227:     public string? FeaturedImageUri { get; set; }
228: 
229:     public bool IsActive { get; set; }
230:     public string? ExternalUrl { get; set; }
231: 
232:     public {LookupIdType} StatusId { get; set; }
233:     public string StatusFullName { get; set; } = string.Empty;
234:     public string StatusMasterCode { get; set; } = string.Empty;
235: 
236:     public {LookupIdType} VisibilityTypeId { get; set; }
237:     public string VisibilityTypeFullName { get; set; } = string.Empty;
238:     public string VisibilityTypeMasterCode { get; set; } = string.Empty;
239: 
240:     public {LookupIdType} FormatId { get; set; }
241:     public string FormatFullName { get; set; } = string.Empty;
242:     public string FormatMasterCode { get; set; } = string.Empty;
243: 
244:     public {LookupIdType}? OptionalLookupId { get; set; }
245:     public string? OptionalLookupFullName { get; set; }
246:     public string? OptionalLookupMasterCode { get; set; }
247: 
248:     public int? ChildCount { get; set; }
249:     public DateOnly? StartDate { get; set; }
250:     public DateOnly? EndDate { get; set; }
251:     public string? Timezone { get; set; }
252: 
253:     public int ViewCount { get; set; }
254: 
255:     public {IdType} TenantId { get; set; }
256: 
257:     public {IdType}? ExternalRecordId { get; set; }
258:     public string? ExternalRecordUri { get; set; }
259:     public string? ExternalRecordCid { get; set; }
260: }
261: ```
262: 
263: **Conventions**:
264: - ✅ All entity properties
265: - ✅ Include both IDs and Names for foreign keys
266: - ✅ Suffix with `Dto` (not `DetailsDto`)
267: 
268: ## User-Specific Query Pattern
269: 
270: **Example**:
271: ```csharp
272: // File: {Project}.Application/Features/{Entities}/Requests/Queries/GetMy{Entities}Request.cs
273: namespace {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Requests.Queries;
274: 
275: using System.Collections.Generic;
276: using {Project}.Application.DTOs.{Entity};
277: using MediatR;
278: 
279: public class GetMy{Entities}Request : IRequest<List<{Entity}ListDto>>
280: {
281:     public string UserId { get; set; } = string.Empty;
282: }
283: 
284: // File: {Project}.Application/Features/{Entities}/Handlers/Queries/GetMy{Entities}RequestHandler.cs
285: namespace {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Handlers.Queries;
286: 
287: using System.Collections.Generic;
288: using System.Threading;
289: using System.Threading.Tasks;
290: using AutoMapper;
291: using {Project}.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
292: using {Project}.Application.DTOs.{Entity};
293: using {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Requests.Queries;
294: using MediatR;
295: 
296: public class GetMy{Entities}RequestHandler : IRequestHandler<GetMy{Entities}Request, List<{Entity}ListDto>>
297: {
298:     private readonly I{Entity}Repository _{entity}Repository;
299:     private readonly IMapper _mapper;
300: 
301:     public GetMy{Entities}RequestHandler(I{Entity}Repository {entity}Repository, IMapper mapper)
302:     {
303:         _{entity}Repository = {entity}Repository;
304:         _mapper = mapper;
305:     }
306: 
307:     public async Task<List<{Entity}ListDto>> Handle(GetMy{Entities}Request request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
308:     {
309:         // ✅ Repository handles complex filtering
310:         var {entities} = await _{entity}Repository.GetMy{Entities}WithDetails(request.UserId);
311: 
312:         // ✅ Map to DTOs
313:         return _mapper.Map<List<{Entity}ListDto>>({entities});
314:     }
315: }
316: ```
317: 
318: ## Repository Pattern for Queries
319: 
320: **Example**:
321: ```csharp
322: // File: {Project}.Application/Contracts/Persistence/I{Entity}Repository.cs
323: namespace {Project}.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
324: 
325: using System;
326: using System.Collections.Generic;
327: using System.Threading.Tasks;
328: using {Project}.Domain;
329: 
330: public interface I{Entity}Repository : IGenericRepository<{Entity}, {IdType}>
331: {
332:     Task<{Entity}?> Get{Entity}WithDetails({IdType} id);
333:     Task<List<{Entity}>> Get{Entities}WithDetails();
334:     Task<List<{Entity}>> GetMy{Entities}WithDetails(string userId);
335: }
336: 
337: // File: {Project}.Persistence/Repositories/{Entity}Repository.cs
338: namespace {Project}.Persistence.Repositories;
339: 
340: using System;
341: using System.Collections.Generic;
342: using System.Linq;
343: using System.Threading.Tasks;
344: using {Project}.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
345: using {Project}.Domain;
346: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
347: 
348: public class {Entity}Repository : GenericRepository<{Entity}, {IdType}>, I{Entity}Repository
349: {
350:     private readonly {DbContext} _dbContext;
351: 
352:     public {Entity}Repository({DbContext} dbContext) : base(dbContext)
353:     {
354:         _dbContext = dbContext;
355:     }
356: 
357:     public async Task<{Entity}?> Get{Entity}WithDetails({IdType} id)
358:     {
359:         return await _dbContext.{Entities}
360:             .Include(e => e.{LookupEntity})
361:             .Include(e => e.{RelatedEntity1})
362:             .Include(e => e.{RelatedEntity2})
363:             .Include(e => e.Owner)
364:                 .ThenInclude(o => o.OwnerType)
365:             .Include(e => e.Status)
366:             .Include(e => e.VisibilityType)
367:             .Include(e => e.Format)
368:             .Include(e => e.OptionalLookup)
369:             .Include(e => e.FeaturedImage)
370:             .Include(e => e.ExternalRecord)
371:             .FirstOrDefaultAsync(e => e.Id == id);
372:     }
373: 
374:     public async Task<List<{Entity}>> Get{Entities}WithDetails()
375:     {
376:         return await _dbContext.{Entities}
377:             .Include(e => e.{LookupEntity})
378:             .Include(e => e.{RelatedEntity1})
379:             .Include(e => e.{RelatedEntity2})
380:             .Include(e => e.Owner)
381:                 .ThenInclude(o => o.OwnerType)
382:             .Include(e => e.Status)
383:             .Include(e => e.VisibilityType)
384:             .Include(e => e.Format)
385:             .Include(e => e.OptionalLookup)
386:             .Include(e => e.FeaturedImage)
387:             .ToListAsync();
388:     }
389: 
390:     public async Task<List<{Entity}>> GetMy{Entities}WithDetails(string userId)
391:     {
392:         // Current implementation supports GUID user ids and checks both:
393:         // - direct user owner ownership
394:         // - organization membership ownership
395:         {IdType} userGuid;
396:         var isGuid = {IdType}.TryParse(userId, out userGuid);
397: 
398:         var query = _dbContext.{Entities}
399:             .Include(e => e.{LookupEntity})
400:             .Include(e => e.{RelatedEntity1})
401:             .Include(e => e.{RelatedEntity2})
402:             .Include(e => e.Owner)
403:                 .ThenInclude(o => o.OwnerType)
404:             .Include(e => e.FeaturedImage)
405:             .Include(e => e.Status)
406:             .Include(e => e.VisibilityType)
407:             .Include(e => e.Format)
408:             .Include(e => e.OptionalLookup)
409:             .AsQueryable();
410: 
411:         if (isGuid)
412:         {
413:             query = query.Where(e =>
414:                 _dbContext.Users.Any(u => u.Id == userGuid && u.OwnerId == e.OwnerId) ||
415:                 _dbContext.{ParentEntity}Members.Any(pm =>
416:                     pm.UserId == userGuid &&
417:                     _dbContext.{ParentEntities}.Any(p => p.Id == pm.{ParentEntity}Id && p.OwnerId == e.OwnerId)));
418:         }
419: 
420:         return await query.ToListAsync();
421:     }
422: }
423: ```
424: 
425: **Critical Patterns**:
426: - ✅ Repository returns `List<{Entity}>` (entities), not DTOs
427: - ✅ Use `.Include()` and `.ThenInclude()` for eager loading
428: - ✅ Complex filtering happens in repository
429: - ✅ Handler maps entities → DTOs
430: 
431: ## AutoMapper Configuration
432: 
433: **Example**:
434: ```csharp
435: // File: {Project}.Application/Profiles/MappingProfile.cs
436: namespace {Project}.Application.Profiles;
437: 
438: using AutoMapper;
439: using {Project}.Application.DTOs.{Entity};
440: using {Project}.Domain;
441: 
442: public class MappingProfile : Profile
443: {
444:     public MappingProfile()
445:     {
446:         // {Entity} → {Entity}ListDto (AutoMapper infers navigation properties)
447:         CreateMap<{Entity}, {Entity}ListDto>();
448: 
449:         // {Entity} → {Entity}Dto (AutoMapper infers navigation properties)
450:         CreateMap<{Entity}, {Entity}Dto>();
451: 
452:         // Create{Entity}Dto → {Entity}
453:         CreateMap<Create{Entity}Dto, {Entity}>();
454: 
455:         // Update{Entity}Dto → {Entity}
456:         CreateMap<Update{Entity}Dto, {Entity}>();
457:     }
458: }
459: ```
460: 
461: **AutoMapper Note**:
462: 
463: This codebase uses explicit `.ForMember(...)` mappings for many "*FullName" / "*MasterCode" / owner fields.
464: 
465: ## Naming Conventions
466: 
467: | Pattern | Example | Returns |
468: |---------|---------|---------|
469: | Get{Entity}ListRequest | Get{Entity}ListRequest | `List<{Entity}ListDto>` |
470: | Get{Entity}DetailsRequest | Get{Entity}DetailsRequest | `{Entity}Dto?` |
471: | GetMy{Entities}Request | GetMy{Entities}Request | `List<{Entity}ListDto>` |
472: | Check{Condition}Query | CheckUserExistsQuery | `bool` |
473: 
474: **Note**: Most queries use `Request` suffix. Some newer ones use `Query` suffix (both patterns exist).
475: 
476: ## Controller Usage
477: 
478: **Example**:
479: ```csharp
480: // File: {Project}.API/Controllers/{Entity}Controller.cs
481: namespace {Project}.API.Controllers;
482: 
483: using System;
484: using System.Collections.Generic;
485: using System.Linq;
486: using System.Security.Claims;
487: using System.Threading.Tasks;
488: using {Project}.Application.DTOs.{Entity};
489: using {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Requests.Queries;
490: using MediatR;
491: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
492: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
493: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
494: 
495: [Route("api/v1/[controller]")]
496: [ApiController]
497: public class {Entity}Controller : ControllerBase
498: {
499:     private readonly IMediator _mediator;
500:     private readonly IHttpContextAccessor _httpContextAccessor;
501: 
502:     public {Entity}Controller(IMediator mediator, IHttpContextAccessor httpContextAccessor)
503:     {
504:         _mediator = mediator;
505:         _httpContextAccessor = httpContextAccessor;
506:     }
507: 
508:     // ✅ Public read access
509:     [HttpGet]
510:     [AllowAnonymous]
511:     public async Task<ActionResult<List<{Entity}ListDto>>> GetAll()
512:     {
513:         var {entities} = await _mediator.Send(new Get{Entity}ListRequest());
514:         return Ok({entities});
515:     }
516: 
517:     // ✅ Public read access for single item
518:     [HttpGet("{id}")]
519:     [AllowAnonymous]
520:     public async Task<ActionResult<{Entity}Dto>> GetById({IdType} id)
521:     {
522:         var {entity} = await _mediator.Send(new Get{Entity}DetailsRequest { Id = id });
523: 
524:         if ({entity} == null)
525:             return NotFound();
526: 
527:         return Ok({entity});
528:     }
529: 
530:     // ✅ User-specific query (authenticated)
531:     [HttpGet("my")]
532:     [Authorize]
533:     public async Task<ActionResult<List<{Entity}ListDto>>> GetMy{Entities}()
534:     {
535:         var userId = _httpContextAccessor.HttpContext?.User?.FindFirst("sub")?.Value
536:             ?? _httpContextAccessor.HttpContext?.User?.FindFirst("http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/ws/2005/05/identity/claims/nameidentifier")?.Value
537:             ?? _httpContextAccessor.HttpContext?.User?.FindFirst("sid")?.Value;
538: 
539:         if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(userId))
540:         {
541:             return Unauthorized(new { error = "User ID not found in token" });
542:         }
543: 
544:         var {entities} = await _mediator.Send(new GetMy{Entities}Request { UserId = userId });
545:         return Ok({entities});
546:     }
547: }
548: ```
549: 
550: **Key Points**:
551: - ✅ GET endpoints use `[AllowAnonymous]` for public read
552: - ✅ Return `null` for not found, handle in controller with `NotFound()`
553: - ✅ Simple `return Ok(result)` - no wrapper needed
554: - ✅ Extract userId from JWT claims for user-specific queries
555: 
556: ---
557: 
558: **Next**: See [command-patterns.md](command-patterns.md) for write operations and [handler-patterns.md](handler-patterns.md) for common handler patterns.
````

## File: .claude/skills/cqrs-mediatr-guidelines/resources/validation-integration.md
````markdown
  1: # Validation Integration - Complete Reference
  2: 
  3: > **Project-Agnostic Validation Patterns**
  4: >
  5: > Placeholders use `{Placeholder}` syntax - see [docs/TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md](../../../../docs/TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md).
  6: 
  7: ## Validation Pattern Overview
  8: 
  9: **CRITICAL**: Validation is **manual in handlers** (not automated pipeline behavior).
 10: 
 11: ---
 12: 
 13: ## Validator Structure
 14: 
 15: ```csharp
 16: // File: {Project}.Application/DTOs/{Entity}/Validators/Create{Entity}DtoValidator.cs
 17: namespace {Project}.Application.DTOs.{Entity}.Validators;
 18: 
 19: using FluentValidation;
 20: using {Project}.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 21: 
 22: public class Create{Entity}DtoValidator : AbstractValidator<Create{Entity}Dto>
 23: {
 24:     private readonly I{RelatedEntity1}Repository _{relatedEntity1}Repository;
 25:     private readonly I{RelatedEntity2}Repository _{relatedEntity2}Repository;
 26:     private readonly I{LookupEntity}Repository _{lookupEntity}Repository;
 27:     private readonly I{ParentEntity}Repository _{parentEntity}Repository;
 28:     private readonly IStorageObjectRepository _storageObjectRepository;
 29: 
 30:     public Create{Entity}DtoValidator(
 31:         I{RelatedEntity1}Repository {relatedEntity1}Repository,
 32:         I{RelatedEntity2}Repository {relatedEntity2}Repository,
 33:         I{LookupEntity}Repository {lookupEntity}Repository,
 34:         I{ParentEntity}Repository {parentEntity}Repository,
 35:         IStorageObjectRepository storageObjectRepository)
 36:     {
 37:         _{relatedEntity1}Repository = {relatedEntity1}Repository;
 38:         _{relatedEntity2}Repository = {relatedEntity2}Repository;
 39:         _{lookupEntity}Repository = {lookupEntity}Repository;
 40:         _{parentEntity}Repository = {parentEntity}Repository;
 41:         _storageObjectRepository = storageObjectRepository;
 42: 
 43:         RuleFor(x => x.Title)
 44:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("Title is required")
 45:             .MaximumLength(200).WithMessage("Title must not exceed 200 characters");
 46: 
 47:         RuleFor(x => x.Description)
 48:             .MaximumLength(5000).When(x => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(x.Description))
 49:             .WithMessage("Description must not exceed 5000 characters");
 50: 
 51:         RuleFor(x => x.{LookupEntity}Id)
 52:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{LookupEntity} is required")
 53:             .MustAsync(async (id, cancellation) =>
 54:             {
 55:                 var exists = await _{lookupEntity}Repository.Exists(id);
 56:                 return exists;
 57:             })
 58:             .WithMessage("{LookupEntity} not found");
 59: 
 60:         RuleFor(x => x.{RelatedEntity1}Id)
 61:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{RelatedEntity1} is required")
 62:             .MustAsync(async (id, cancellation) =>
 63:             {
 64:                 var exists = await _{relatedEntity1}Repository.Exists(id);
 65:                 return exists;
 66:             })
 67:             .WithMessage("{RelatedEntity1} not found");
 68: 
 69:         RuleFor(x => x.{RelatedEntity2}Id)
 70:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{RelatedEntity2} is required")
 71:             .MustAsync(async (id, cancellation) =>
 72:             {
 73:                 var exists = await _{relatedEntity2}Repository.Exists(id);
 74:                 return exists;
 75:             })
 76:             .WithMessage("{RelatedEntity2} not found");
 77: 
 78:         RuleFor(x => x.{ParentEntity}Id)
 79:             .MustAsync(async (id, cancellation) =>
 80:             {
 81:                 if (!id.HasValue) return true;
 82:                 return await _{parentEntity}Repository.Exists(id.Value);
 83:             })
 84:             .When(x => x.{ParentEntity}Id.HasValue)
 85:             .WithMessage("{ParentEntity} does not exist.");
 86: 
 87:         RuleFor(x => x.FeaturedImageId)
 88:             .MustAsync(async (id, cancellation) =>
 89:             {
 90:                 if (!id.HasValue) return true;
 91:                 return await _storageObjectRepository.Exists(id.Value);
 92:             })
 93:             .When(x => x.FeaturedImageId.HasValue)
 94:             .WithMessage("FeaturedImageId does not exist.");
 95:     }
 96: }
 97: ```
 98: 
 99: **Key Patterns**:
100: - ✅ Validators take repositories in constructor
101: - ✅ Use `MustAsync` for async database validation
102: - ✅ Check foreign key existence with repository
103: - ✅ Custom error messages with `.WithMessage()`
104: 
105: ---
106: 
107: ## Handler Validation Pattern
108: 
109: ```csharp
110: // File: {Project}.Application/Features/{Entities}/Handlers/Commands/Create{Entity}CommandHandler.cs
111: public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>> Handle(Create{Entity}Command request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
112: {
113:     var response = new BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>();
114: 
115:     // 1. Create validator instance (manual instantiation)
116:     var validator = new Create{Entity}DtoValidator(
117:         _{relatedEntity1}Repository,
118:         _{relatedEntity2}Repository,
119:         _{lookupEntity}Repository,
120:         _{parentEntity}Repository,
121:         _storageObjectRepository);
122: 
123:     // 2. Validate DTO
124:     var validationResult = await validator.ValidateAsync(request.{Entity}Dto, cancellationToken);
125: 
126:     // 3. Check result
127:     if (!validationResult.IsValid)
128:     {
129:         response.Success = false;
130:         response.Message = "{Entity} creation failed.";
131:         response.Errors = validationResult.Errors.Select(e => e.ErrorMessage).ToList();
132:         return response;
133:     }
134: 
135:     // 4. Proceed with business logic
136:     var {entity} = _mapper.Map<{Entity}>(request.{Entity}Dto);
137:     {entity}.ViewCount = 0;
138:     {entity}.TenantId = _tenantContext.TenantId;
139:     {entity} = await _{entity}Repository.Create({entity});
140: 
141:     response.Success = true;
142:     response.Id = {entity}.Id;
143:     response.Message = "{Entity} created successfully.";
144: 
145:     return response;
146: }
147: ```
148: 
149: **Critical Steps**:
150: 1. **Instantiate validator manually** with repository dependencies
151: 2. **Validate DTO** using `ValidateAsync`
152: 3. **Check `IsValid`** property
153: 4. **Return errors** in `BaseCommandResponse.Errors` list
154: 5. **Early return** if validation fails
155: 
156: ---
157: 
158: ## Common Validation Rules
159: 
160: ### Required Field
161: ```csharp
162: RuleFor(x => x.Title)
163:     .NotEmpty().WithMessage("Title is required");
164: ```
165: 
166: ### String Length
167: ```csharp
168: RuleFor(x => x.Title)
169:     .MaximumLength(200).WithMessage("Title must not exceed 200 characters");
170: 
171: RuleFor(x => x.Description)
172:     .MinimumLength(10).WithMessage("Description must be at least 10 characters")
173:     .MaximumLength(5000);
174: ```
175: 
176: ### Numeric Range
177: ```csharp
178: RuleFor(x => x.Price)
179:     .GreaterThanOrEqualTo(0).WithMessage("Price must be non-negative");
180: 
181: RuleFor(x => x.MaxAttendees)
182:     .InclusiveBetween(1, 10000).WithMessage("Max attendees must be between 1 and 10000");
183: ```
184: 
185: ### Email Validation
186: ```csharp
187: RuleFor(x => x.Email)
188:     .EmailAddress().WithMessage("Invalid email address");
189: ```
190: 
191: ### Async Database Validation (Foreign Keys)
192: ```csharp
193: RuleFor(x => x.{LookupEntity}Id)
194:     .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{LookupEntity} is required")
195:     .MustAsync(async (id, cancellation) =>
196:     {
197:         var exists = await _{lookupEntity}Repository.Exists(id);
198:         return exists;
199:     })
200:     .WithMessage("{LookupEntity} not found");
201: ```
202: 
203: ### Conditional Validation
204: ```csharp
205: RuleFor(x => x.ExternalUrl)
206:     .NotEmpty()
207:     .When(x => x.IsExternalEnabled)
208:     .WithMessage("External URL is required when external option is enabled");
209: 
210: RuleFor(x => x.Price)
211:     .GreaterThan(0)
212:     .When(x => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(x.CurrencyCode))
213:     .WithMessage("Price must be greater than 0 when currency is specified");
214: ```
215: 
216: ### Custom Validation Logic
217: ```csharp
218: RuleFor(x => x.Slug)
219:     .MustAsync(async (dto, slug, cancellation) =>
220:     {
221:         // Custom logic: slug must be unique
222:         var existing = await _{entity}Repository.GetBySlug(slug);
223:         return existing == null;
224:     })
225:     .WithMessage("Slug must be unique");
226: ```
227: 
228: ### Complex Validation (Multiple Properties)
229: ```csharp
230: RuleFor(x => x)
231:     .Must(x => x.StartDate <= x.EndDate)
232:     .WithMessage("Start date must be before or equal to end date")
233:     .When(x => x.StartDate.HasValue && x.EndDate.HasValue);
234: ```
235: 
236: ---
237: 
238: ## Update DTO Validation
239: 
240: **Different from Create**:
241: ```csharp
242: // File: {Project}.Application/DTOs/{Entity}/Validators/Update{Entity}DtoValidator.cs
243: public class Update{Entity}DtoValidator : AbstractValidator<Update{Entity}Dto>
244: {
245:     public Update{Entity}DtoValidator()
246:     {
247:         // ID is required for updates
248:         RuleFor(x => x.Id)
249:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{Entity} ID is required");
250: 
251:         // Title might be optional for partial updates
252:         RuleFor(x => x.Title)
253:             .MaximumLength(200).When(x => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(x.Title))
254:             .WithMessage("Title must not exceed 200 characters");
255: 
256:         // Description optional
257:         RuleFor(x => x.Description)
258:             .MaximumLength(5000).When(x => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(x.Description))
259:             .WithMessage("Description must not exceed 5000 characters");
260:     }
261: }
262: ```
263: 
264: **Key Differences**:
265: - ✅ `Id` property is required
266: - ⚠️ Some fields might be optional (partial updates)
267: - ✅ Validation rules can be less strict than create
268: 
269: ---
270: 
271: ## Error Response Format
272: 
273: **Validation Failure Response**:
274: ```json
275: {
276:   "id": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000",
277:   "success": false,
278:   "message": "{Entity} creation failed.",
279:   "errors": [
280:     "Title is required",
281:     "{LookupEntity} not found",
282:     "{RelatedEntity1} is required"
283:   ]
284: }
285: ```
286: 
287: **Success Response**:
288: ```json
289: {
290:   "id": "3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6",
291:   "success": true,
292:   "message": "{Entity} created successfully.",
293:   "errors": []
294: }
295: ```
296: 
297: ---
298: 
299: ## Why Manual Validation?
300: 
301: | Approach | Manual Pattern | Pipeline Behavior |
302: |----------|---------------|-------------------|
303: | **When runs** | Manually in handler | Automatically before handler |
304: | **Validator creation** | Manual instantiation | DI injection |
305: | **Dependencies** | Passed to constructor | Must be registered in DI |
306: | **Flexibility** | High - can skip validation | Fixed - always runs |
307: | **Error handling** | BaseCommandResponse | Exceptions or custom |
308: | **Control** | Explicit in handler | Hidden in pipeline |
309: 
310: **Benefits of Manual Validation**:
311: - ✅ Fine-grained control over when validation runs
312: - ✅ Validators can have different repository dependencies per use case
313: - ✅ No need to register validators in DI container
314: - ✅ Clear and explicit validation flow
315: - ✅ Easy to understand for new developers
316: 
317: ---
318: 
319: ## Self-Referencing Entity Validation
320: 
321: For entities with parent relationships (e.g., hierarchical categories):
322: 
323: ```csharp
324: public class Create{Entity}DtoValidator : AbstractValidator<Create{Entity}Dto>
325: {
326:     private readonly I{Entity}Repository _{entity}Repository;
327: 
328:     public Create{Entity}DtoValidator(I{Entity}Repository {entity}Repository)
329:     {
330:         _{entity}Repository = {entity}Repository;
331: 
332:         // Prevent self-reference (relevant for Update scenarios where Id exists)
333:         RuleFor(x => x.ParentId)
334:             .NotEqual(x => x.Id)
335:             .When(x => x.ParentId.HasValue && x.Id != default)
336:             .WithMessage("{Entity} cannot be its own parent");
337: 
338:         // Validate parent exists
339:         RuleFor(x => x.ParentId)
340:             .MustAsync(async (id, cancellation) =>
341:             {
342:                 if (!id.HasValue) return true;
343:                 return await _{entity}Repository.Exists(id.Value);
344:             })
345:             .When(x => x.ParentId.HasValue)
346:             .WithMessage("Parent {Entity} not found");
347: 
348:         // Prevent circular reference (for update)
349:         RuleFor(x => x.ParentId)
350:             .MustAsync(NotCreateCircularReference)
351:             .When(x => x.ParentId.HasValue && x.Id != default)
352:             .WithMessage("Would create circular reference");
353:     }
354: 
355:     private async Task<bool> NotCreateCircularReference(
356:         Create{Entity}Dto dto,
357:         {IdType}? parentId,
358:         CancellationToken cancellation)
359:     {
360:         // Implementation depends on business logic
361:         return true;
362:     }
363: }
364: ```
365: 
366: ---
367: 
368: ## FluentValidation NuGet Package
369: 
370: ```xml
371: <PackageReference Include="FluentValidation" Version="11.9.0" />
372: ```
373: 
374: **No need for** `FluentValidation.AspNetCore` or `FluentValidation.DependencyInjectionExtensions` - we don't use pipeline behaviors or DI registration.
375: 
376: ---
377: 
378: **See Also**:
379: - [command-patterns.md](command-patterns.md) - Complete command handler examples
380: - [handler-patterns.md](handler-patterns.md) - Handler structure and patterns
````

## File: docs/CONFIGURATION.md
````markdown
  1: # Configuration
  2: 
  3: > **Project-Agnostic Configuration Guide**
  4: >
  5: > Placeholders use `{Placeholder}` syntax - see [TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md](TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md).
  6: 
  7: ## Placeholder Substitutions
  8: 
  9: | Placeholder | Replace With | Example (ISLAMU Event) |
 10: |-------------|--------------|------------------------|
 11: | `{Project}` | Your solution name | `Explore` |
 12: | `{project}` | Lowercase project name | `explore` |
 13: | `{Project}.API` | API project name | `Explore.API` |
 14: | `{Instance Name}` | Your instance display name | `ISLAMU Event` |
 15: | `{Instance Domain}` | Your instance domain | `events.islamu.org` |
 16: 
 17: ---
 18: 
 19: ## Application Settings
 20: 
 21: **Generic Template:**
 22: ```json
 23: {
 24:   "Keycloak": {
 25:     "Authority": "https://your-keycloak-instance.com/realms/{realm}",
 26:     "Realm": "your-realm",
 27:     "ClientId": "{project}-api",
 28:     "ClientSecret": ""
 29:   },
 30:   "ConnectionStrings": {
 31:     "DefaultConnection": ""
 32:   },
 33:   "Federation": {
 34:     "InstanceDomain": "{Instance Domain}",
 35:     "InstanceName": "{Instance Name}",
 36:     "EnableFederation": true,
 37:     "SharedInboxEnabled": true
 38:   },
 39:   "Serilog": {
 40:     "MinimumLevel": {
 41:       "Default": "Information",
 42:       "Override": {
 43:         "Microsoft": "Warning",
 44:         "System": "Warning"
 45:       }
 46:     },
 47:     "WriteTo": [
 48:       { "Name": "Console" },
 49:       { "Name": "File", "Args": { "path": "logs/log-.txt", "rollingInterval": "Day" } },
 50:       { "Name": "Seq", "Args": { "serverUrl": "http://localhost:5341" } }
 51:     ]
 52:   }
 53: }
 54: ```
 55: 
 56: ### Implementation Example: ISLAMU Event
 57: ```json
 58: {
 59:   "Keycloak": {
 60:     "Authority": "https://keycloak.openislamu.org/realms/islamu-dev",
 61:     "Realm": "islamu-dev",
 62:     "ClientId": "explore-api",
 63:     "ClientSecret": ""
 64:   },
 65:   "Federation": {
 66:     "InstanceDomain": "events.islamu.org",
 67:     "InstanceName": "ISLAMU Event",
 68:     "EnableFederation": true,
 69:     "SharedInboxEnabled": true
 70:   }
 71: }
 72: ```
 73: 
 74: ## Environment Variables
 75: 
 76: | Variable | Description | Example |
 77: |----------|-------------|---------|
 78: | `ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT` | Runtime environment | `Development`, `Staging`, `Production` |
 79: | `ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection` | PostgreSQL connection | `Host=...;Database=...` |
 80: | `Keycloak__ClientSecret` | Keycloak client secret | `...` |
 81: | `Infisical__ClientId` | Secrets manager client | `...` |
 82: | `Infisical__ClientSecret` | Secrets manager secret | `...` |
 83: 
 84: ## Secret Management
 85: 
 86: The application uses a unified secret management system (`Explore.Secrets`) that supports multiple providers:
 87: 
 88: ### Secret Providers
 89: 
 90: | Provider | Use Case | Configuration |
 91: |----------|----------|---------------|
 92: | `none` | Self-hosters, local dev | Use environment variables directly |
 93: | `infisical` | Production with Infisical | Connects to Infisical service |
 94: 
 95: ### Configuration Options
 96: 
 97: ```json
 98: {
 99:   "SecretProvider": {
100:     "Provider": "infisical",
101:     "FailFast": true
102:   },
103:   "Infisical": {
104:     "Url": "https://app.infisical.com",
105:     "ProjectId": "your-project-id",
106:     "ClientId": "your-client-id",
107:     "ClientSecret": "your-client-secret",
108:     "Environment": "dev"
109:   },
110:   "SecretRefresh": {
111:     "RefreshInterval": "00:05:00",
112:     "BaseBackoffDelay": "00:00:30",
113:     "MaxBackoffDelay": "00:05:00"
114:   }
115: }
116: ```
117: 
118: ### Environment Variables
119: 
120: | Variable | Description | Required |
121: |----------|-------------|----------|
122: | `SECRET_PROVIDER` | Provider type: `none` or `infisical` | No (default: `none`) |
123: | `Infisical__Url` | Infisical server URL | Only if using Infisical |
124: | `Infisical__ProjectId` | Infisical project ID | Only if using Infisical |
125: | `Infisical__ClientId` | Universal Auth client ID | Only if using Infisical |
126: | `Infisical__ClientSecret` | Universal Auth client secret | Only if using Infisical |
127: | `Infisical__Environment` | Environment slug (dev, staging, prod) | No (default: `dev`) |
128: 
129: ### Self-Hosted Deployment (No Secret Manager)
130: 
131: For self-hosters who don't want to use Infisical, set `SECRET_PROVIDER=none` and provide all secrets via environment variables:
132: 
133: ```bash
134: # Required environment variables for self-hosted deployment
135: SECRET_PROVIDER=none
136: ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection=Host=...;Database=...;Username=...;Password=...
137: Keycloak__Authority=https://your-keycloak/realms/your-realm
138: Keycloak__ClientId=explore-api
139: Keycloak__ClientSecret=your-secret
140: S3Settings__AccessKeyId=your-access-key
141: S3Settings__SecretAccessKey=your-secret-key
142: ```
143: 
144: ### Infisical Deployment
145: 
146: For production with Infisical:
147: 
148: ```bash
149: SECRET_PROVIDER=infisical
150: Infisical__Url=https://app.infisical.com
151: Infisical__ProjectId=your-project-id
152: Infisical__ClientId=your-client-id
153: Infisical__ClientSecret=your-client-secret
154: Infisical__Environment=prod
155: ```
156: 
157: Secrets are automatically loaded from Infisical paths:
158: - `/keycloak` - Keycloak configuration
159: - `/postgresql` - Database credentials
160: - `/api` - API-specific secrets (S3, etc.)
161: - `/blazor` - Blazor-specific configuration
162: 
163: ### Features
164: 
165: - **Automatic Refresh**: Secrets are refreshed periodically (configurable interval)
166: - **Health Checks**: Secret provider health is exposed at `/health`
167: - **Metrics**: Prometheus-compatible metrics for monitoring
168: - **Audit Logging**: All secret access is logged with redaction
169: - **Graceful Fallback**: Falls back to environment variables if Infisical unavailable
170: 
171: ## Cerbos (Planned - Not Currently Integrated)
172: 
173: Some older docs/templates mention a `Cerbos` configuration section.
174: 
175: Cerbos is **not currently integrated** into `{Project}.API`. All authorization logic is currently implemented within the application code. There is no active Cerbos configuration required for the running system.
176: 
177: ### Implementation Example: ISLAMU Event
178: Cerbos is not currently integrated into `Explore.API`. Authorization is handled by MediatR handlers and endpoint-level `[Authorize]` attributes.
179: 
180: ---
181: 
182: ## Instance-Level Settings
183: 
184: The system supports **instance-level configuration** that controls deployment modes, feature toggles, and system-wide settings through the `SystemSetting` table.
185: 
186: ### SystemSetting Table
187: 
188: Instance administrators can configure system behavior through database-stored settings:
189: 
190: **Generic Pattern:**
191: ```csharp
192: public class SystemSetting
193: {
194:     public Guid Id { get; set; }
195:     public string Key { get; set; } = string.Empty;
196:     public string Value { get; set; } = string.Empty;
197:     public string? Description { get; set; }
198: 
199:     // Auditing
200:     public DateTime CreatedAt { get; set; }
201:     public Guid? CreatedBy { get; set; }
202:     public DateTime? UpdatedAt { get; set; }
203:     public Guid? UpdatedBy { get; set; }
204: }
205: ```
206: 
207: ### Governance Setting Keys
208: 
209: System settings are defined as constants in `GovernanceSettingKeys`:
210: 
211: ```csharp
212: public static class GovernanceSettingKeys
213: {
214:     // Deployment Mode
215:     public const string DeploymentMode = "System.DeploymentMode";  // "SingleTenant" or "MultiTenant"
216: 
217:     // Feature Flags
218:     public const string FederationEnabled = "System.Federation.Enabled";
219:     public const string RegistrationOpen = "System.Registration.Open";
220:     public const string MaintenanceMode = "System.MaintenanceMode";
221: 
222:     // Module Governance (see Module-Specific Configuration section)
223:     public const string IslamicModuleEnabled = "System.Modules.Islamic.Enabled";
224:     public const string TechModuleEnabled = "System.Modules.Tech.Enabled";
225: 
226:     // Instance Metadata
227:     public const string InstanceName = "System.Instance.Name";
228:     public const string InstanceDomain = "System.Instance.Domain";
229: }
230: ```
231: 
232: ### Deployment Mode Switching
233: 
234: The `DeploymentMode` setting controls multi-tenant vs single-tenant behavior:
235: 
236: **Generic Pattern:**
237: ```csharp
238: // Retrieve deployment mode
239: var deploymentMode = await _systemSettingService.GetAsync(
240:     GovernanceSettingKeys.DeploymentMode);
241: 
242: if (deploymentMode == "SingleTenant")
243: {
244:     // Single tenant: All users belong to default tenant
245:     // No tenant selection UI shown
246: }
247: else if (deploymentMode == "MultiTenant")
248: {
249:     // Multi-tenant: Users can belong to multiple tenants
250:     // Tenant selection UI shown
251:     // Tenant context required for all operations
252: }
253: ```
254: 
255: ### Implementation Example: ISLAMU Event
256: 
257: ```csharp
258: // Explore.Domain/Constants/GovernanceSettingKeys.cs
259: public static class GovernanceSettingKeys
260: {
261:     public const string DeploymentMode = "System.DeploymentMode";
262:     public const string FederationEnabled = "System.Federation.Enabled";
263:     public const string IslamicModuleEnabled = "System.Modules.Islamic.Enabled";
264:     // ... more keys
265: }
266: 
267: // Usage in services
268: var federationEnabled = await _systemSettingService.GetBoolAsync(
269:     GovernanceSettingKeys.FederationEnabled);
270: 
271: if (federationEnabled)
272: {
273:     // Enable federation endpoints
274: }
275: ```
276: 
277: **See Also**: [OPERATIONS.md](OPERATIONS.md) for deployment mode details.
278: 
279: ---
280: 
281: ## Module-Specific Configuration
282: 
283: The system supports **modular event types** through per-tenant capability configuration. Different tenants can enable different event modules (e.g., Islamic events, Tech events).
284: 
285: ### TenantCapability Table
286: 
287: Modules are enabled per-tenant through the `TenantCapability` table:
288: 
289: **Generic Pattern:**
290: ```csharp
291: public class TenantCapability
292: {
293:     public Guid Id { get; set; }
294:     public Guid TenantId { get; set; }
295:     public string ModuleName { get; set; } = string.Empty;  // "Islamic", "Tech", etc.
296:     public bool Enabled { get; set; }
297:     public Dictionary<string, string>? Configuration { get; set; }  // Module-specific settings
298: 
299:     // Relationships
300:     public Tenant? Tenant { get; set; }
301: }
302: ```
303: 
304: ### Module Governance Settings
305: 
306: Modules can be enabled/disabled at two levels:
307: 
308: 1. **System Level** (via `SystemSetting` table):
309:    - Controls if a module is available at all
310:    - Instance admin configures
311: 
312: 2. **Tenant Level** (via `TenantCapability` table):
313:    - Controls if a specific tenant can use a module
314:    - Tenant admin configures
315: 
316: **Hierarchy**:
317: ```
318: System.Modules.Islamic.Enabled = true   (System-wide toggle)
319:   └── TenantCapability: TenantId=abc, ModuleName="Islamic", Enabled=true   (Tenant-specific)
320: ```
321: 
322: If system-level setting is `false`, the module is unavailable to ALL tenants, regardless of `TenantCapability` settings.
323: 
324: ### Module Resolution Example
325: 
326: **Generic Pattern:**
327: ```csharp
328: // Check if module is available for tenant
329: public async Task<bool> IsModuleAvailableAsync(Guid tenantId, string moduleName)
330: {
331:     // 1. Check system-level setting
332:     var systemKey = $"System.Modules.{moduleName}.Enabled";
333:     var systemEnabled = await _systemSettingService.GetBoolAsync(systemKey);
334:     if (!systemEnabled) return false;
335: 
336:     // 2. Check tenant-level capability
337:     var capability = await _tenantCapabilityRepository.GetByTenantAndModule(
338:         tenantId, moduleName);
339: 
340:     return capability?.Enabled ?? false;
341: }
342: 
343: // Usage in handlers
344: if (await _moduleService.IsModuleAvailableAsync(tenantId, "Islamic"))
345: {
346:     // Load EventIslamicAspect
347:     var aspect = await _islamicAspectRepository.GetByEventId(eventId);
348: }
349: ```
350: 
351: ### Implementation Example: ISLAMU Event
352: 
353: ```csharp
354: // Module availability check in Create Event handler
355: public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<Guid>> Handle(...)
356: {
357:     // ... create base event ...
358: 
359:     // If Islamic module enabled for this tenant, create Islamic aspect
360:     if (await _moduleService.IsModuleAvailableAsync(tenantId, "Islamic"))
361:     {
362:         if (request.EventDto.IslamicAspect != null)
363:         {
364:             var islamicAspect = new EventIslamicAspect
365:             {
366:                 EventId = newEvent.Id,
367:                 PrayerTimesAvailable = request.EventDto.IslamicAspect.PrayerTimesAvailable,
368:                 // ... map other fields
369:             };
370:             await _islamicAspectRepository.Create(islamicAspect);
371:         }
372:     }
373: 
374:     return response;
375: }
376: ```
377: 
378: **See Also**: [CODEBASE_INSIGHTS.md](CODEBASE_INSIGHTS.md) Section 7 for module governance implementation.
379: 
380: ---
381: 
382: ## Monitoring & Observability
383: 
384: The system uses **Prometheus** for metrics and **Loki** for centralized logging.
385: 
386: ### Prometheus (Metrics)
387: 
388: Application metrics are exposed at `/metrics` endpoint using Prometheus format:
389: 
390: **Generic Configuration:**
391: ```json
392: {
393:   "Prometheus": {
394:     "Enabled": true,
395:     "MetricsPath": "/metrics",
396:     "Port": 9090
397:   }
398: }
399: ```
400: 
401: **Metrics Exposed**:
402: - HTTP request duration histograms
403: - Database query performance
404: - Command/Query execution times (MediatR pipeline)
405: - Repository operation counters
406: - Exception counts by type
407: 
408: **Implementation Example: ISLAMU Event**
409: ```csharp
410: // Explore.API/Program.cs
411: builder.Services.AddOpenTelemetry()
412:     .WithMetrics(metrics =>
413:     {
414:         metrics.AddPrometheusExporter();
415:         metrics.AddMeter("Explore.API");
416:         metrics.AddAspNetCoreInstrumentation();
417:         metrics.AddHttpClientInstrumentation();
418:     });
419: 
420: app.MapPrometheusScrapingEndpoint();  // Exposes /metrics
421: ```
422: 
423: ### Loki (Centralized Logging)
424: 
425: Logs are shipped to Loki via Serilog:
426: 
427: **Generic Configuration:**
428: ```json
429: {
430:   "Serilog": {
431:     "WriteTo": [
432:       {
433:         "Name": "GrafanaLoki",
434:         "Args": {
435:           "uri": "http://loki:3100",
436:           "labels": [
437:             { "key": "app", "value": "{project}-api" },
438:             { "key": "environment", "value": "production" }
439:           ]
440:         }
441:       }
442:     ]
443:   }
444: }
445: ```
446: 
447: **Implementation Example: ISLAMU Event**
448: ```csharp
449: // Explore.API/Program.cs
450: builder.Host.UseSerilog((context, configuration) =>
451: {
452:     configuration
453:         .ReadFrom.Configuration(context.Configuration)
454:         .Enrich.FromLogContext()
455:         .Enrich.WithProperty("Application", "Explore.API")
456:         .WriteTo.Console()
457:         .WriteTo.GrafanaLoki(
458:             context.Configuration["Loki:Uri"]!,
459:             labels: new List<LokiLabel>
460:             {
461:                 new() { Key = "app", Value = "explore-api" },
462:                 new() { Key = "env", Value = context.HostingEnvironment.EnvironmentName }
463:             });
464: });
465: ```
466: 
467: ### Observability Stack
468: 
469: **Recommended Stack**:
470: - **Prometheus**: Metrics collection and storage
471: - **Loki**: Log aggregation and querying
472: - **Grafana**: Unified dashboards for metrics + logs
473: - **Aspire Dashboard** (Development): Local observability during development
474: 
475: **Key Benefits**:
476: - Unified observability (metrics + logs in Grafana)
477: - Label-based log filtering (tenant, user, request ID)
478: - Performance monitoring (P50, P95, P99 latencies)
479: - Error tracking with stack traces
480: - Correlation between logs and metrics
481: 
482: **See Also**: [TROUBLESHOOTING.md](TROUBLESHOOTING.md) for debugging with Prometheus/Loki.
````

## File: docs/PROJECT.md
````markdown
  1: ## 1. Project Overview
  2: 
  3: ## What is ISLAMU Event?
  4: 
  5: **ISLAMU Event** (also known as ISLAMU Explore or Event Explorer) is an **open-source event discovery platform**.
  6: 
  7: The long-term vision includes **ATProto-first federation** with an **ActivityPub gateway**, but HTTP federation endpoints are **not currently implemented** in `Explore.API`.
  8: 
  9: ## Core Value Proposition
 10: 
 11: | Component | Value |
 12:   |-----------|-------|
 13: | **Software** | Multi-tenant federated event platform (AGPL) |
 14: | **Primary Instance** | Trusted Islamic event directory with verification |
 15: | **Filtering System** | Culturally-appropriate discovery (age, gender, madhab) |
 16: 
 17: ## Organizational Context
 18: 
 19: - **Organization**: ISLAMU Non Profit Organization (Islamic Software Lighthouse Alliance of the Muslim Ummah)
 20: - **Legal Entity**: Belgian non-profit organization ASBL (Association sans but lucratif)
 21: - **GitHub Organization**: `islamu-ngo`
 22: - **Repository**: `https://github.com/islamu-ngo/explore`
 23: - **License**: AGPL-3.0
 24: 
 25: ---
 26: 
 27: # Strategic Context
 28: 
 29: ## Ecosystem Architecture
 30: 
 31: ```
 32: ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
 33: │                      ISLAMU Event Ecosystem                         │
 34: ├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
 35: │                                                                     │
 36: │  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
 37: │  │           ISLAMU-Hosted Instance (Primary Focus)            │   │
 38: │  │  ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────  │   │
 39: │  │  • Islamic events globally                                  │   │
 40: │  │  • Verified actors (fact-checked)                           │   │
 41: │  │  • User-submitted events (flagged as unverified)            │   │
 42: │  │  • Strike/ban system for policy violations                  │   │
 43: │  │  • Advanced filtering (age, gender, location, language, and more)│   │
 44: │  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
 45: │                              │                                      │

 47: │                              │                                      │

 49: │  │ Community A  │  │ Community B  │  │ Organization │  ...         │

100: 
101: # Core Features
102: 
103: ## Two-Tier Verification System
104: 
105: ```
106: ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
107: │                    VERIFICATION SYSTEM                              │
108: ├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
109: │                                                                     │
110: │  TIER 1: User-Submitted Events                                      │
111: │  ├── Anyone can create account                                      │
112: │  ├── Can post events immediately                                    │
113: │  ├── Events marked as "User Reported"                               │
114: │  ├── Subject to community moderation                                │
115: │  └── Strike/ban system for violations                               │
116: │                                                                     │
117: │  TIER 2: Verified Organizations                                     │
118: │  ├── Application required                                           │
119: │  └── Fact-checking process:                                         │
120: │      └── Organization exists? (registration check)                  │
121: │                                                                     │
122: └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
123: ```
124: 
125: ## Advanced Filtering System
126: 
127: | Filter | Options | Description |
128: |--------|---------|-------------|
129: | **Audience Age** | Children, Youth, Adults, Seniors, All Ages | Target demographic |
130: | **Gender** | Men-only, Women-only, Mixed, Family | Audience type |
131: | **Location** | Country, Region, City, Radius | Geographic filtering with PostGIS |
132: | **Language** | Arabic, English, French, etc. | Event language |
133: | **Event Type** | Webinar, Conference | Event Type |
134: | **Madhab** | Hanafi, Maliki, Shafi'i, Hanbali | Islamic jurisprudence school |
135: | **Category** | Aqidah, Fiqh, Tafsir, Hadith, etc. | Event classification |
136: | **Tag** | Mohammed Hijab, Mufti Menk etc... | Event tags |
137: | **TagType** | Person, Channel, oeuvres | Tag classification |
138: | **TagTypeTags** | Specific tags within TagType | e.g., Person → Mohammed Hijab |
139: | **Event Format** | In-person Local (physical), Digital (online), Hybrid | Event format |
140: | **Date/Time** | Upcoming, This Week, This Month, Custom | Temporal filtering |
141: | **Verification** | Verified only, All | Trust level |
142: 
143: ## Liturgical Temporal Engine
144: 
145: **Dynamic Prayer-Relative Scheduling**:
146: 
147: - Events can be scheduled relative to prayer times (e.g., "15 minutes after Maghrib")
148: - exact times based on event geolocation using Third-party API
149: 
150: ## Moderation System
151: 
152: Still todo
153: 
154: ## Data Portability
155: 
156: Export formats supported:
157: - **iCal/ICS**: Standard calendar format for events
158: - **CSV**: Attendee lists, organizations, bulk data
159: - **ActivityPub-native** (planned): Federation-compatible JSON-LD
160: - **Full database dump**: Complete data export for self-hosters
161:

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Components/Event/EventSessionManager.razor
````razor
  1: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients
  2: @using MudBlazor
  3: @inject IDialogService DialogService
  4: @inject IEventService EventService
  5: @inject ISnackbar Snackbar
  6: 
  7: <div class="event-session-manager">
  8:     @if (_isLoading)
  9:     {
 10:         <div class="d-flex justify-center pa-4">
 11:             <MudProgressCircular Color="Color.Primary" Indeterminate="true" />
 12:         </div>
 13:     }
 14:     else if (Sessions.Count > 1)
 15:     {
 16:         <MudStack Spacing="3">
 17:             @foreach (var session in Sessions)
 18:             {
 19:                 <MudPaper Elevation="0" Class="pa-4 border-solid border-1 mud-border-lines-default rounded-lg">
 20:                     <div class="d-flex flex-wrap gap-4 justify-space-between align-center">
 21:                         <div>
 22:                             <MudText Typo="Typo.h6">@session.Title</MudText>
 23:                             <div class="d-flex align-center gap-4 mt-1">
 24:                                 <div class="d-flex align-center gap-1">
 25:                                     <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.CalendarToday" Size="Size.Small" Color="Color.Secondary" />
 26:                                     <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Secondary">
 27:                                         @(session.StartTime?.ToString("f") ?? "")
 28:                                     </MudText>
 29:                                 </div>
 30:                                 <div class="d-flex align-center gap-1">
 31:                                     <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.LocationOn" Size="Size.Small" Color="Color.Secondary" />
 32:                                     <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Secondary">
 33:                                         @session.LocationFullName
 34:                                     </MudText>
 35:                                 </div>
 36:                             </div>
 37:                         </div>
 38:                         
 39:                         <div>
 40:                             @if (ShowRegisterButton)
 41:                             {
 42:                                 <MudButton Variant="Variant.Outlined" 
 43:                                            Color="Color.Primary" 
 44:                                            OnClick="@(() => OnRegisterClick.InvokeAsync(session))">
 45:                                     Register
 46:                                 </MudButton>
 47:                             }
 48:                         </div>
 49:                     </div>
 50:                 </MudPaper>
 51:             }
 52:         </MudStack>
 53:     }
 54:     else if (Sessions.Count == 0)
 55:     {
 56:         <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Info">No sessions available.</MudAlert>
 57:     }
 58:     else
 59:     {
 60:         // Single session case - intentionally empty or minimal if desired
 61:         // The parent component handles the display for single session
 62:     }
 63: </div>
 64: 
 65: @code {
 66:     [Parameter] public Guid EventId { get; set; }
 67:     [Parameter] public bool ShowRegisterButton { get; set; } = false;
 68:     [Parameter] public EventCallback<EventSessionListDto> OnRegisterClick { get; set; }
 69: 
 70:     public List<EventSessionListDto> Sessions { get; private set; } = new();
 71:     
 72:     private Guid _previousEventId;
 73:     private bool _isLoading = true;
 74: 
 75:     protected override async Task OnParametersSetAsync()
 76:     {
 77:         if (EventId != Guid.Empty && EventId != _previousEventId)
 78:         {
 79:             _previousEventId = EventId;
 80:             await LoadSessions();
 81:         }
 82:     }
 83: 
 84:     public async Task LoadSessions()
 85:     {
 86:         _isLoading = true;
 87:         try
 88:         {
 89:             var result = await EventService.GetSessionsByEventAsync(EventId);
 90:             Sessions = result.OrderBy(s => s.StartTime).ToList();
 91:         }
 92:         catch (Exception ex)
 93:         {
 94:             Snackbar.Add($"Error loading sessions: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
 95:             Sessions = new List<EventSessionListDto>();
 96:         }
 97:         finally
 98:         {
 99:             _isLoading = false;
100:             StateHasChanged();
101:         }
102:     }
103: }
````

````razor
 1: <!--
 2:     Footer Component - BEM Methodology
 3:     Block: site-footer
 4:     Elements: __brand, __brand-icon, __brand-text, __brand-highlight, __description,
 5:               __section, __heading, __link, __bottom, __copyright, __social, __social-btn

 8: 
 9: <footer class="site-footer">
10:     <MudContainer MaxWidth="MaxWidth.Large">
11:         <MudGrid Spacing="4">
12:             <!-- Brand Column -->
13:             <MudItem xs="12" md="4">
14:                 <div class="site-footer__brand">
15:                     @if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_brandLogoUrl))
16:                     {
17:                         <MudImage Src="@_brandLogoUrl" Alt="@_brandDisplayName" Width="28" Height="28" Class="site-footer__brand-icon" />
18:                     }
19:                     else
20:                     {
21:                         <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Explore" Color="Color.Primary" Size="Size.Large" Class="site-footer__brand-icon" />
22:                     }
23:                     <div class="site-footer__brand-text">@_brandDisplayName</div>
24:                 </div>
25:                 <MudText Class="site-footer__description">
26:                     Connecting Muslims through meaningful events, gatherings, and community building initiatives across the globe.
