## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Services/CategoryService.cs
````csharp
  1: using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients;
  2: using Explore.Blazor.Client.Constants;
  3: using Explore.Blazor.Client.Helpers;
  4: using Explore.Blazor.Client.Models;
  5: using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
  6: 
  7: namespace Explore.Blazor.Client.Services;
  8: 
  9: public interface ICategoryService
 10: {
 11:     Task<ICollection<CategoryListDto>> GetCategoriesAsync();
 12:     Task<ICollection<CategoryListDto>> GetAllCategoriesAsync();
 13:     Task<PaginatedResult<CategoryListDto>> GetCategoriesPagedAsync(int pageNumber, int pageSize);
 14:     Task<CategoryDto?> GetCategoryByIdAsync(Guid categoryId);
 15:     Task<BaseCommandResponseOfGuid?> CreateCategoryAsync(CreateCategoryDto dto);
 16:     Task<BaseCommandResponseOfGuid?> UpdateCategoryAsync(Guid id, UpdateCategoryDto dto);
 17:     Task<bool> DeleteCategoryAsync(Guid categoryId);
 18:     Task<ICollection<object>> GetCategoriesByEventAsync(Guid eventId);
 19:     Task<ICollection<object>> GetEventsByCategoryAsync(Guid categoryId);
 20:     Task<BaseCommandResponseOfGuid?> AssignCategoryToEventAsync(object dto);
 21:     Task<bool> RemoveCategoryFromEventAsync(Guid eventCategoryId);
 22: }
 23: 
 24: public class CategoryService : ICategoryService
 25: {
 26:     private readonly IEventApiClient _apiClient;
 27:     private readonly ILogger<CategoryService> _logger;
 28: 
 29:     public CategoryService(IEventApiClient apiClient, ILogger<CategoryService> logger)
 30:     {
 31:         _apiClient = apiClient ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(apiClient));
 32:         _logger = logger ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(logger));
 33:     }
 34: 
 35:     public async Task<ICollection<CategoryListDto>> GetCategoriesAsync()
 36:     {
 37:         try
 38:         {
 39:             var result = await _apiClient.GetCategoriesAsync(pageNumber: ApiConstants.FirstPage, pageSize: ApiConstants.DefaultPageSize);
 40:             return result?.GetItems() ?? new List<CategoryListDto>();
 41:         }
 42:         catch (ApiException ex)
 43:         {
 44:             _logger.LogError(ex, "[CATEGORY SERVICE] API error fetching categories: {StatusCode}", ex.StatusCode);
 45:             return new List<CategoryListDto>();
 46:         }
 47:     }
 48: 
 49:     public Task<ICollection<CategoryListDto>> GetAllCategoriesAsync() => GetCategoriesAsync();
 50: 
 51:     public async Task<PaginatedResult<CategoryListDto>> GetCategoriesPagedAsync(int pageNumber, int pageSize)
 52:     {
 53:         try
 54:         {
 55:             var result = await _apiClient.GetCategoriesAsync(pageNumber, pageSize);
 56:             return result.ToPaginatedResult();
 57:         }
 58:         catch (Exception ex)
 59:         {
 60:             _logger.LogError(ex, "[CATEGORY SERVICE] Error fetching paged categories (page {PageNumber}, size {PageSize})", pageNumber, pageSize);
 61:             return PaginatedResult<CategoryListDto>.Empty(pageNumber, pageSize);
 62:         }
 63:     }
 64: 
 65:     public async Task<CategoryDto?> GetCategoryByIdAsync(Guid categoryId)
 66:     {
 67:         try
 68:         {
 69:             var result = await _apiClient.GetCategoryByIdAsync(categoryId);
 70:             return result?.ToDto();
 71:         }
 72:         catch (ApiException ex) when (ex.StatusCode == 404)
 73:         {
 74:             _logger.LogWarning("[CATEGORY SERVICE] Category not found: {CategoryId}", categoryId);
 75:             return null;
 76:         }
 77:         catch (ApiException ex)
 78:         {
 79:             _logger.LogError(ex, "[CATEGORY SERVICE] API error fetching category {CategoryId}: {StatusCode}", categoryId, ex.StatusCode);
 80:             return null;
 81:         }
 82:     }
 83: 
 84:     public async Task<BaseCommandResponseOfGuid?> CreateCategoryAsync(CreateCategoryDto dto)
 85:     {
 86:         try
 87:         {
 88:             return await _apiClient.CreateCategoryAsync(dto);
 89:         }
 90:         catch (ApiException ex)
 91:         {
 92:             _logger.LogError(ex, "API error creating category: {StatusCode}", ex.StatusCode);
 93:             return new BaseCommandResponseOfGuid { Success = false, Message = $"API error: {ex.Message}", Errors = new List<string> { ex.Response ?? ex.Message } };
 94:         }
 95:     }
 96: 
 97:     public async Task<BaseCommandResponseOfGuid?> UpdateCategoryAsync(Guid id, UpdateCategoryDto dto)
 98:     {
 99:         try
100:         {
101:             return await _apiClient.UpdateCategoryAsync(id, dto);
102:         }
103:         catch (ApiException ex)
104:         {
105:             _logger.LogError(ex, "API error updating category: {StatusCode}", ex.StatusCode);
106:             return new BaseCommandResponseOfGuid { Success = false, Message = $"API error: {ex.Message}", Errors = new List<string> { ex.Response ?? ex.Message } };
107:         }
108:     }
109: 
110:     public async Task<bool> DeleteCategoryAsync(Guid categoryId)
111:     {
112:         try
113:         {
114:             await _apiClient.DeleteCategoryAsync(categoryId);
115:             return true;
116:         }
117:         catch (ApiException ex)
118:         {
119:             _logger.LogError(ex, "API error deleting category: {StatusCode}", ex.StatusCode);
120:             return false;
121:         }
122:     }
123:

## File: .claude/agents/documentation-architect.md
````markdown
 1: ---
 2: name: documentation-architect
 3: description: Generates C# XML documentation, Swagger/Scalar annotations, and architecture documentation for {Project}.
 4: tools: All tools
 5: ---
 6: 
 7: > **Project-Agnostic Documentation Agent**
 8: >
 9: > Placeholders use `{Placeholder}` syntax - see [docs/TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md](../../docs/TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md).
10: 
11: You are the **Documentation Architect** for the {Project} platform. You ensure the codebase is self-documenting via XML comments and that high-level documentation reflects the actual Clean Architecture implementation.
12: 
13: ## Technology Stack
14: 
15: - **.NET**: 10.0
16: - **Language**: C# 13
17: - **API Documentation**: Scalar (primary), Swagger/OpenAPI
18: - **Architecture**: Clean Architecture with CQRS
19: - **Diagrams**: Mermaid.js for architecture flows
20: 
21: ## Core Responsibilities
22: 
23: ### 1. C# XML Documentation
24: 
25: The agent ensures that all public APIs (classes, methods, properties) in the C# codebase are well-documented using XML comments. This includes Controllers, MediatR Commands/Queries/Handlers, and Domain Entities.
26: 
27: - For **Controllers**: Document HTTP endpoints, parameters, return types, and response codes. See `auth-patterns` and `cqrs-mediatr-guidelines` for typical controller structures.
28: - For **MediatR Handlers**: Document the handler's purpose, the command/query it handles, and its side effects. **CRITICAL**: Ensure the manual validator instantiation pattern and repository return types are explicitly mentioned in `remarks` if relevant. See `cqrs-mediatr-guidelines` (handler patterns).
29: - For **Domain Entities**: Document the entity's purpose, its key properties, and any domain invariants. **CRITICAL**: Explicitly state if properties do NOT have default values in the entity. See `dotnet-efcore-guidelines` (key principles & conventions).
30: 
31: ### 2. Scalar/Swagger Configuration
32: 
33: The agent configures API documentation using Scalar (primary) and Swagger/OpenAPI. This involves adding `[ProducesResponseType]` attributes to controller actions and ensuring `Program.cs` correctly sets up Scalar/Swagger UI.
34: 
35: ```csharp
36: // Example: {Project}.API/Program.cs - Scalar/OpenAPI setup
37: builder.Services.AddOpenApi(); // .NET 9+ built-in OpenAPI support
38: var app = builder.Build();
39: app.MapScalarApiReference(options => { /* ... */ });
40: app.MapOpenApi();
41: ```
42: 
43: ### 3. Architecture Documentation
44: 
45: The agent maintains and generates architectural documentation, including Mermaid.js diagrams for visualizing complex flows (e.g., CQRS flow, Clean Architecture layers) in `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`.
46: 
47: - **Reference**: [`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`](../../docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) and the `clean-architecture-rules` skill for detailed architectural diagrams and layer dependency rules.
48: 
49: ## Key Principles
50: 
51: - ✅ Document **WHY**, not just WHAT (capture business intent, decisions).
52: - ✅ Add XML comments to all public APIs (classes, methods, properties).
53: - ✅ Use `/// <summary>`, `/// <param>`, `/// <returns>`, `/// <remarks>` comprehensively.
54: - ✅ Add `[ProducesResponseType]` for all HTTP endpoints for accurate API documentation.
55: - ✅ Explicitly document **CRITICAL PATTERNS** (e.g., manual validator instantiation, repository return types) in MediatR handler `remarks`.
56: - ✅ Create Mermaid diagrams for complex flows and architectural overviews.
57: - ✅ Keep documentation close to code (same repository, e.g., in `.claude/skills` resources).
58: - ❌ Don't write documentation that duplicates obvious code logic.
59: - ❌ Don't forget to document edge cases and business rules.
60: - ❌ Don't use generic descriptions ("This method does X").
61: 
62: ## Related Skills
63: 
64: - [`clean-architecture-rules`](../skills/clean-architecture-rules/SKILL.md) - Architectural patterns and dependency rules to document.
65: - [`cqrs-mediatr-guidelines`](../skills/cqrs-mediatr-guidelines/SKILL.md) - CQRS flow, handler patterns, and validation integration to document.
66: - [`dotnet-efcore-guidelines`](../skills/dotnet-efcore-guidelines/SKILL.md) - EF Core patterns, entity documentation concerns.
67: - [`auth-patterns`](../skills/auth-patterns/SKILL.md) - Authentication/Authorization flows and security aspects to document.
68: - [`blazor-ui-conventions`](../skills/blazor-ui-conventions/SKILL.md) - Blazor component documentation, theming, state management.
69: - [`blazor-bff-patterns`](../skills/blazor-bff-patterns/SKILL.md) - BFF pattern and its documentation needs.
70: - [`error-tracking`](../skills/error-tracking/SKILL.md) - Error handling and observability patterns to document.
71: 
72: ## Output Format
73: 
74: When assisting with documentation, provide:
75: 
76: 1.  **Documentation Plan**: Outline which code elements need documentation and which patterns to follow.
77: 2.  **Proposed XML Comments/Annotations**: Provide generated XML comments or `[ProducesResponseType]` attributes for specific code blocks.
78: 3.  **Mermaid Diagram (if requested)**: Provide Mermaid code for architectural visualizations.
79: 4.  **Review Feedback**: Identify missing or unclear documentation, suggest improvements, and ensure compliance with project standards.
80: 5.  **Code Examples**: Before/after examples for clarity where appropriate.
81: 
82: Always ensure documentation is accurate and reflects the actual implementation. Update documentation when code changes.
83: 
84: **Enforcement Level**: SUGGEST (Provides guidance and recommendations)
````

## File: .claude/agents/refactor-planner.md
````markdown
  1: ---
  2: name: refactor-planner
  3: description: Creates strategic refactoring plans to modernize legacy code, clean up technical debt, and enforce Clean Architecture in {Project}.
  4: tools: All tools
  5: ---
  6: 
  7: > **Project-Agnostic Refactoring Strategy Agent**
  8: >
  9: > Placeholders use `{Placeholder}` syntax - see [docs/TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md](../../docs/TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md).
 10: 
 11: You are a **Technical Strategist** for the {Project} platform. You create comprehensive refactoring plans that transform disorganized code into Clean Architecture-compliant structures without breaking the build.
 12: 
 13: ## Technology Stack
 14: 
 15: - **.NET**: 10.0
 16: - **Language**: C# 13
 17: - **Architecture**: Clean Architecture with CQRS
 18: - **Frontend**: Blazor Server + WebAssembly (Hybrid)
 19: - **Database**: Entity Framework Core + PostgreSQL
 20: 
 21: ## CRITICAL RULES (Must Enforce in Refactoring)
 22: 
 23: These rules are strictly enforced during any refactoring effort. Violations **MUST** be addressed. For detailed explanations and examples, refer to the respective skills.
 24: 
 25: 1.  **Repositories Return ENTITIES, Never DTOs**: Repositories **MUST** return domain entities. DTO mapping always happens in the Application layer handlers via AutoMapper.
 26:     -   **Reference**: `cqrs-mediatr-guidelines` (repository return types), `dotnet-efcore-guidelines` (repository pattern).
 27: 2.  **Validators Use Manual Instantiation (NOT DI)**: Validators are instantiated manually within handlers, with all required dependencies passed to their constructor. They are **NOT** injected via Dependency Injection.
 28:     -   **Reference**: `cqrs-mediatr-guidelines` (validation integration), `clean-architecture-rules` (manual validator instantiation).
 29: 3.  **Navigation Properties Are Readonly**: Navigation properties on link/mapping tables are **readonly for queries only**. Writes **MUST** go through the link table's repository directly.
 30:     -   **Reference**: `dotnet-efcore-guidelines` (key principles & conventions).
 31: 4.  **Use `int` Instead of `long`**: Unless explicitly required for large values (e.g., file sizes, pagination cursors), use `int` for lookup table IDs and `Guid` for main entities.
 32:     -   **Reference**: `dotnet-efcore-guidelines` (key principles & conventions).
 33: 5.  **No Default Values in Entities**: **DO NOT** add default values in domain entity property initializers. Defaults are set in application handlers or via `IEntityTypeConfiguration`.
 34:     -   **Reference**: `dotnet-efcore-guidelines` (key principles & conventions).
 35: 6.  **Commands Return `BaseCommandResponse<Guid>`**: All commands (write operations) **MUST** return `BaseCommandResponse<Guid>` (or `bool` for delete operations).
 36:     -   **Reference**: `cqrs-mediatr-guidelines` (command patterns).
 37: 7.  **GET = AllowAnonymous, Write = Authorize**: **`GET`** endpoints should be `[AllowAnonymous]`. **`POST`, `PUT`, `DELETE`** endpoints **MUST** be `[Authorize]`.
 38:     -   **Reference**: `auth-patterns` (controller endpoint authorization).
 39: 8.  **Extract User ID with Fallback**: When extracting the user ID from JWT claims, **ALWAYS** use the provided fallback pattern (`sub` → `nameidentifier` → `sid`).
 40:     -   **Reference**: `auth-patterns` (user ID extraction).
 41: 9.  **File-Scoped Namespaces**: All new C# files **SHOULD** use file-scoped namespaces for conciseness.
 42: 10. **Do Not Remove Using Statements**: Keep ALL `using` statements even if they appear unused, except for old references that are broken.
 43: 
 44: ## Refactoring Scope Analysis
 45: 
 46: The first step in planning any refactoring is to identify the current state and the desired target state, leveraging the established architectural patterns.
 47: 
 48: ### Identifying Problem Areas
 49: 
 50: Analyze the current codebase to pinpoint common architectural violations. For detailed identification strategies, refer to the `code-architecture-reviewer` agent.
 51: 
 52: -   **Fat Controllers**: Controllers containing significant business logic or direct `DbContext` access.
 53:     -   **Target State**: Thin controllers using MediatR. Refer to `clean-architecture-rules` (layer responsibilities) and `cqrs-mediatr-guidelines` (controller usage).
 54: -   **Wrong Validator Pattern**: Validators injected via DI rather than manually instantiated.
 55:     -   **Target State**: Manual validator instantiation in handlers. Refer to `cqrs-mediatr-guidelines` (validation integration) and `clean-architecture-rules` (manual validator instantiation).
 56: -   **Repository Returns DTOs**: Repositories performing mapping or returning DTOs instead of domain entities.
 57:     -   **Target State**: Repositories returning entities, handlers mapping to DTOs. Refer to `cqrs-mediatr-guidelines` (repository usage) and `dotnet-efcore-guidelines` (repository pattern).
 58: -   **Missing Authorization**: Write endpoints lacking `[Authorize]` or proper resource-level checks.
 59:     -   **Target State**: Consistent endpoint authorization and handler-level resource checks. Refer to `auth-patterns`.
 60: 
 61: ## Phased Execution Plan
 62: 
 63: Refactoring should be approached incrementally to minimize risk and allow for continuous verification. Each phase should result in a stable, tested codebase.
 64: 
 65: ### Phase 1: Create Abstractions (Non-Breaking)
 66: 
 67: **Goal**: Introduce new Clean Architecture-compliant components without altering existing functionality.
 68: -   [ ] Create MediatR Commands/Queries for existing controller actions.
 69: -   [ ] Create Handlers for these Commands/Queries, ensuring manual validator instantiation.
 70: -   [ ] Ensure existing repository methods in `{Project}.Persistence` return domain entities.
 71: 
 72: **Risk Level**: 🟢 Low (focus on non-breaking additions)
 73: 
 74: ### Phase 2: Switch Implementation
 75: 
 76: **Goal**: Transition existing code to use the newly created abstractions.
 77: -   [ ] Update Controllers to use MediatR for handling requests.
 78: -   [ ] Apply `[AllowAnonymous]` to `GET` endpoints and `[Authorize]` to `POST`/`PUT`/`DELETE` endpoints.
 79: -   [ ] Implement user ID extraction with the fallback pattern in controllers or custom middleware.
 80: 
 81: **Risk Level**: 🟡 Medium (requires thorough testing)
 82: 
 83: ### Phase 3: Cleanup
 84: 
 85: **Goal**: Remove old, deprecated code after the new implementation is proven stable and thoroughly tested.
 86: -   [ ] Remove direct `DbContext` usage from controllers.
 87: -   [ ] Delete old service classes, repositories, or DTOs that have been replaced.
 88: -   [ ] Remove any unused DI registrations.
 89: 
 90: **Risk Level**: 🟢 Low (already tested in Phase 2)
 91: 
 92: ## Risk Assessment & Rollback Plan
 93: 
 94: Each refactoring plan should include a basic risk assessment and a clear rollback strategy.
 95: 
 96: ### Risk Assessment
 97: 
 98: Analyze potential risks associated with the refactoring. For each risk, propose mitigation strategies.
 99: 
100: | Risk | Likelihood | Impact | Mitigation |
101: |------|------------|--------|------------|
102: | **Breaking existing API clients** | Low | High | Ensure API contract remains unchanged (internal refactor only). |
103: | **Validation errors not caught** | Medium | High | Implement manual validators with full FK repo checks (refer `cqrs-mediatr-guidelines`). |
104: | **Repository returning wrong type** | Medium | High | Review all repository methods return entities (refer `dotnet-efcore-guidelines`). |
105: | **Missing authorization** | Low | High | Add `[Authorize]` to all write endpoints (refer `auth-patterns`). |
106: | **UserId extraction fails** | Medium | Medium | Use fallback pattern (`sub` → `nameidentifier` → `sid`) (refer `auth-patterns`). |
107: | **Performance regression (N+1)** | Medium | High | Implement eager loading (`Include`) or projections (refer `dotnet-efcore-guidelines`). |
108: 
109: ### Rollback Plan (PowerShell Example)
110: 
111: In case a phase introduces critical issues, a quick rollback is essential.
112: 
113: ```powershell
114: # If Phase X fails, revert the last commit
115: git revert HEAD --no-edit
116: 
117: # Rebuild the solution
118: dotnet build {Project}.sln
119: 
120: # Re-run the application with Aspire
121: dotnet run --project {Project}.AppHost
122: ```
123: 
124: ## Testing Strategy
125: 
126: Each phase **MUST** be thoroughly tested.
127: 
128: -   **Unit Tests**: Verify individual components (handlers, validators) in isolation.
129: -   **Integration Tests**: Test the full flow from controller to database.
130: -   **Manual API Tests**: Use PowerShell `Invoke-RestMethod` to verify endpoints.
131: -   **Test Coverage**: Aim for high code coverage for refactored components.
132: -   **Reference**: `error-tracking` skill for overall testing guidelines.
133: 
134: ## Deliverable Format
135: 
136: ```markdown
137: # Refactoring Plan: [Module/Feature Name]
138: 
139: **Date**: YYYY-MM-DD
140: **Author**: Claude Code
141: **Estimated Duration**: [X hours/days]
142: 
143: ---
144: 
145: ## Executive Summary
146: 
147: **Current State**: [Brief description of the problem/technical debt being addressed.]
148: **Target State**: [Brief description of the desired Clean Architecture-compliant structure.]
149: **Business Value**: [Explain why this refactoring is important (e.g., improved maintainability, testability, performance).]
150: 
151: ---
152: 
153: ## CRITICAL RULES Checklist (Pre-Refactoring Check)
154: 
155: Before proceeding, ensure the refactoring plan explicitly addresses these critical rules. If not, the plan requires revision.
156: 
157: - [ ] Repositories return entities (not DTOs) - See `cqrs-mediatr-guidelines`, `dotnet-efcore-guidelines`
158: - [ ] Validators use manual instantiation (not DI) - See `cqrs-mediatr-guidelines`, `clean-architecture-rules`
159: - [ ] Commands return BaseCommandResponse<Guid> - See `cqrs-mediatr-guidelines`
160: - [ ] GET = AllowAnonymous, Write = Authorize - See `auth-patterns`
161: - [ ] UserId extraction with fallback pattern - See `auth-patterns`
162: - [ ] Use int instead of long (except size/cursor) - See `dotnet-efcore-guidelines`
163: - [ ] No default values in entities - See `dotnet-efcore-guidelines`
164: - [ ] Navigation properties are readonly (link tables) - See `dotnet-efcore-guidelines`
165: - [ ] File-scoped namespaces used - See `clean-architecture-rules` (though not explicit)
166: - [ ] Keep all using statements - See `code-refactor-master` (though not explicit)
167: 
168: ---
169: 
170: ## Current State Analysis: Problem Areas Identified
171: 
172: List the specific code sections or patterns that require refactoring.
173: 
174: 1.  **[Problem Title]**: [Brief description of the problem, e.g., "Fat Controller: {Entity}Controller contains direct DbContext calls and business logic"].
175:     -   **Violation**: [Reference violated critical rule or architectural principle, e.g., "Violates Clean Architecture's separation of concerns. See `clean-architecture-rules` (layer responsibilities)."]
176:     -   **Impact**: [e.g., "High coupling, low testability, difficult to maintain."]
177:     -   **Code Snippet (Current)**: (Optional: provide small, relevant snippet)
178: 
179: ---
180: 
181: ## Target Architecture
182: 
183: Provide a high-level overview or diagram of the desired structure after refactoring.
184: 
185: ```
186: Controller (Thin)
187: └─> MediatR Command/Query (Application Layer)
188:     └─> Handler (Application Layer)
189:         ├─> Manual Validator Instantiation
190:         ├─> Repository (returns entities)
191:         └─> AutoMapper (handler maps to DTOs)
192: ```
193: -   **Reference**: `clean-architecture-rules`, `cqrs-mediatr-guidelines`, `dotnet-efcore-guidelines`.
194: 
195: ---
196: 
197: ## Phased Execution Plan
198: 
199: Detailed steps for each phase, focusing on incremental changes and verification.
200: 
201: ### Phase 1: Create Abstractions (Non-Breaking)
202: 
203: -   **Objective**: Introduce MediatR commands/queries, handlers, and ensure repositories return entities without changing existing controller logic.
204: -   **Steps**:
205:     1.  Create `Create{Entity}Command` and `{Entity}Dto` in `{Project}.Application`.
206:     2.  Create `{Entity}CommandHandler` in `{Project}.Application`, implementing manual validator instantiation and using repository interfaces.
207:     3.  Ensure existing repository methods in `{Project}.Persistence` return domain entities.
208: -   **Verification**: `dotnet build`, `dotnet test` (for new unit tests).
209: -   **Risk Level**: 🟢 Low (non-breaking additions).
210: 
211: ### Phase 2: Switch Implementation
212: 
213: -   **Objective**: Update existing controllers to utilize the new MediatR abstractions.
214: -   **Steps**:
215:     1.  Modify `{Entity}Controller` to inject `IMediator`.
216:     2.  Replace direct `DbContext` calls/business logic with `await _mediator.Send(command/query)`.
217:     3.  Apply `[AllowAnonymous]` to `GET` endpoints and `[Authorize]` to `POST`/`PUT`/`DELETE` endpoints.
218:     4.  Implement user ID extraction with the fallback pattern.
219: -   **Verification**: `dotnet build`, `dotnet test`, manual API testing via PowerShell `Invoke-RestMethod`.
220: -   **Risk Level**: 🟡 Medium (requires thorough testing).
221: 
222: ### Phase 3: Cleanup
223: 
224: -   **Objective**: Remove old, deprecated code after the new implementation is proven stable and thoroughly tested.
225: -   **Steps**:
226:     1.  Remove old, direct `DbContext` usage and related DTOs/services from controllers.
227:     2.  Remove any unused DI registrations.
228:     3.  Run code analysis tools (`dotnet format --verify-no-changes`).
229: -   **Verification**: `dotnet clean`, `dotnet build`, `dotnet test`.
230: -   **Risk Level**: 🟢 Low (already tested in Phase 2).
231: 
232: ---
233: 
234: ## Testing Commands (PowerShell)
235: 
236: ```powershell
237: # Build the solution
238: dotnet build {Project}.sln
239: 
240: # Run all tests
241: dotnet test
242: 
243: # Run the application with Aspire (for integration testing/manual testing)
244: dotnet run --project {Project}.AppHost
245: 
246: # Check API logs for runtime errors
247: $today = Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd"
248: Get-Content "{Project}.API/logs/log-$today.txt" -Tail 50
249: ```
250: 
251: ---
252: 
253: ## Success Criteria
254: 
255: - [ ] All automated tests passing.
256: - [ ] No breaking changes to existing API contracts (unless explicitly planned).
257: - [ ] All handlers use manual validator instantiation.
258: - [ ] All repositories return entities.
259: - [ ] Controllers are thin, mediating requests to MediatR.
260: - [ ] Endpoint authorization (`[AllowAnonymous]`, `[Authorize]`) is correctly applied.
261: - [ ] User ID extraction uses the fallback pattern.
262: 
263: ---
264:

268: - [`cqrs-mediatr-guidelines`](../skills/cqrs-mediatr-guidelines/SKILL.md) - **CRITICAL**: CQRS patterns, handler logic, validation, DTO mapping.
269: - [`dotnet-efcore-guidelines`](../skills/dotnet-efcore-guidelines/SKILL.md) - **CRITICAL**: EF Core patterns, repository usage, performance.

## File: .claude/skills/clean-architecture-rules/SKILL.md
````markdown
  1: ---
  2: name: clean-architecture-rules
  3: description: Enforces Clean Architecture dependency rules (Domain → Application → Infrastructure → API/Blazor). Blocks violations to maintain architectural integrity.
  4: type: guardrail
  5: enforcement: block
  6: priority: critical
  7: ---
  8: 
  9: # Clean Architecture Dependency Rules
 10: 
 11: > **Project-Agnostic Clean Architecture Guidelines**
 12: >
 13: > Placeholders use `{Placeholder}` syntax - see [docs/TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md](../../../docs/TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md).
 14: 
 15: ## Purpose
 16: 
 17: This is a **CRITICAL GUARDRAIL** that enforces Clean Architecture's fundamental dependency rule: **dependencies flow inward only**. Violations are **BLOCKED** to prevent architectural degradation.
 18: 
 19: ## When This Skill Activates
 20: 
 21: **Automatically BLOCKS when**:
 22: - Attempting to add wrong project references
 23: - Importing namespaces that violate dependency rules
 24: - Detecting prohibited `using` statements in Domain or Application layers
 25: 
 26: **Triggered by**:
 27: - Keywords: "dependency", "reference", "architecture", "layer", "add project"
 28: - File patterns: Domain/**/*.cs, Application/**/*.cs
 29: - Content patterns: `using {Project}.Infrastructure`, `using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore` in Domain
 30: 
 31: ## The Dependency Rule
 32: 
 33: ```
 34: ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
 35: │              CLEAN ARCHITECTURE LAYERS                       │
 36: ├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
 37: │                                                             │
 38: │  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
 39: │  │              1. DOMAIN (Core)                       │   │
 40: │  │              {Project}.Domain                       │   │
 41: │  │              ↑ NO DEPENDENCIES                      │   │
 42: │  │  • Entities, Enums, Value Objects, Domain Events    │   │
 43: │  │  • Pure C# - No framework dependencies             │   │
 44: │  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
 45: │                         ▲                                   │
 46: │                         │ References                        │
 47: │  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
 48: │  │         2. APPLICATION (Use Cases)                  │   │
 49: │  │         {Project}.Application                       │   │
 50: │  │         ↑ References: Domain ONLY                   │   │
 51: │  │  • CQRS Commands/Queries, DTOs, Interfaces          │   │
 52: │  │  • MediatR, FluentValidation, AutoMapper            │   │
 53: │  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
 54: │                         ▲                                   │
 55: │                         │ References                        │
 56: │  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
 57: │  │    3. INFRASTRUCTURE (Implementation)               │   │
 58: │  │    {Project}.Persistence + {Project}.Infrastructure │   │
 59: │  │    ↑ References: Application, Domain                │   │
 60: │  │  • DbContext, Repositories, External APIs           │   │
 61: │  │  • EF Core, Database Provider, Email, File Storage  │   │
 62: │  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
 63: │                         ▲                                   │
 64: │                         │ References                        │
 65: │  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
 66: │  │       4. PRESENTATION (Entry Points)                │   │
 67: │  │       {Project}.API + {Project}.Blazor              │   │
 68: │  │       ↑ References: ALL (Composition Root)          │   │
 69: │  │  • Controllers, Pages, Dependency Registration      │   │
 70: │  │  • ASP.NET Core, Blazor, SignalR                    │   │
 71: │  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
 72: │                                                             │
 73: └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
 74: ```
 75: 
 76: ## Resources
 77: 
 78: | Resource | Description |
 79: |----------|-------------|
 80: | [dependency-rules.md](resources/dependency-rules.md) | Complete dependency matrix and flow diagram |
 81: | [layer-responsibilities.md](resources/layer-responsibilities.md) | What code belongs in each layer |
 82: | [violation-examples.md](resources/violation-examples.md) | Common violations and error messages |
 83: | [fix-patterns.md](resources/fix-patterns.md) | How to fix violations using interfaces and DI |
 84: 
 85: ## Valid Dependency Examples
 86: 
 87: ```csharp
 88: // ✅ VALID: Application references Domain
 89: namespace {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Commands;
 90: 
 91: using {Project}.Domain.Entities;  // ✅ OK - App can reference Domain
 92: using {Project}.Domain.Enums;     // ✅ OK
 93: using MediatR;                    // ✅ OK - Framework dependency
 94: 
 95: // ✅ VALID: Infrastructure references Application and Domain
 96: namespace {Project}.Persistence.Repositories;
 97: 
 98: using {Project}.Application.Interfaces;  // ✅ OK - Implements interfaces
 99: using {Project}.Domain.Entities;         // ✅ OK - Works with entities
100: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;     // ✅ OK - Infrastructure can use EF Core
101: 
102: // ✅ VALID: API references all layers
103: namespace {Project}.API.Controllers;
104: 
105: using {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Commands;  // ✅ OK
106: using {Project}.Infrastructure.Services;                   // ✅ OK
107: using MediatR;                                             // ✅ OK
108: ```
109: 
110: ## BLOCKED Violations
111: 
112: ```csharp
113: // ❌ BLOCKED: Domain referencing ANYTHING
114: namespace {Project}.Domain.Entities;
115: 
116: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;    // ❌ BLOCKED! Domain must be pure
117: using {Project}.Application.DTOs;       // ❌ BLOCKED! Dependency flows wrong way
118: 
119: // ❌ BLOCKED: Application referencing Infrastructure
120: namespace {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Queries;
121: 
122: using {Project}.Infrastructure.Persistence;  // ❌ BLOCKED! Use interfaces instead
123: using {Project}.API.Controllers;             // ❌ BLOCKED! Wrong direction
124: 
125: // ❌ BLOCKED: Application referencing Presentation
126: namespace {Project}.Application.Commands;
127: 
128: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;  // ❌ BLOCKED! Application must be framework-agnostic
129: ```
130: 
131: ## Quick Fix: Use Dependency Inversion
132: 
133: **Problem**: Application needs database access (Infrastructure)
134: 
135: **❌ Wrong - Direct dependency**:
136: ```csharp
137: // In {Project}.Application
138: using {Project}.Infrastructure.Persistence;  // ❌ BLOCKED
139: 
140: public class Get{Entities}Handler
141: {
142:     private readonly {DbContext} _context;  // ❌ Concrete class
143: }
144: ```
145: 
146: **✅ Correct - Interface in Application, Implementation in Infrastructure**:
147: ```csharp
148: // Step 1: Define interface in Application layer
149: // File: {Project}.Application/Contracts/Persistence/I{Entity}Repository.cs
150: namespace {Project}.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
151: 
152: public interface I{Entity}Repository
153: {
154:     Task<List<{Entity}>> GetAllAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken);
155: }
156: 
157: // Step 2: Use interface in Application
158: // File: {Project}.Application/Features/{Entities}/Handlers/Queries/Get{Entity}ListRequestHandler.cs
159: namespace {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Handlers.Queries;
160: 
161: using {Project}.Application.Contracts.Persistence;  // ✅ OK - Same layer
162: 
163: public class Get{Entity}ListRequestHandler : IRequestHandler<Get{Entity}ListRequest, List<{Entity}ListDto>>
164: {
165:     private readonly I{Entity}Repository _repository;  // ✅ Abstraction
166: 
167:     public Get{Entity}ListRequestHandler(I{Entity}Repository repository)
168:     {
169:         _repository = repository;
170:     }
171: 
172:     public async Task<List<{Entity}ListDto>> Handle(Get{Entity}ListRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
173:     {
174:         var {entities} = await _repository.GetAllAsync(cancellationToken);
175:         return {entities}.Select(e => e.ToDto()).ToList();
176:     }
177: }
178: 
179: // Step 3: Implement in Infrastructure layer
180: // File: {Project}.Persistence/Repositories/{Entity}Repository.cs
181: namespace {Project}.Persistence.Repositories;
182: 
183: using {Project}.Application.Contracts.Persistence;  // ✅ OK - Implements interface
184: using {Project}.Domain.Entities;                    // ✅ OK - Works with entities
185: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;                // ✅ OK - Infrastructure can use EF Core
186: 
187: public class {Entity}Repository : I{Entity}Repository
188: {
189:     private readonly {DbContext} _context;
190: 
191:     public async Task<List<{Entity}>> GetAllAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
192:     {
193:         return await _context.{Entities}.ToListAsync(cancellationToken);
194:     }
195: }
196: 
197: // Step 4: Register in API/Blazor (Composition Root)
198: // File: {Project}.API/Program.cs
199: builder.Services.AddScoped<I{Entity}Repository, {Entity}Repository>();  // ✅ DI binding
200: ```
201: 
202: ## Why This Matters
203: 
204: **Benefits of Clean Architecture**:
205: 1. **Testability**: Domain and Application can be tested without database
206: 2. **Flexibility**: Swap database providers without changing business logic
207: 3. **Maintainability**: Business logic isolated from framework changes
208: 4. **Team Scalability**: Clear boundaries for parallel development
209: 5. **Deployment Options**: Domain can be reused across API, Blazor, CLI, etc.
210: 
211: **Cost of Violations**:
212: - Tight coupling makes testing difficult
213: - Framework upgrades break business logic
214: - Cannot reuse domain logic across projects
215: - Circular dependencies cause build failures
216: 
217: ## CRITICAL: Validator Manual Instantiation Pattern
218: 
219: ### Rule: Validators Must Be Instantiated Manually, NOT DI Injected
220: 
221: **BLOCKED Violation**: Validators injected via DI in handler constructor
222: 
223: ```csharp
224: // ❌ BLOCKED: DI injection of validators
225: public class Create{Entity}CommandHandler : IRequestHandler<Create{Entity}Command, BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>>
226: {
227:     private readonly IValidator<Create{Entity}Dto> _validator;  // ❌ BLOCKED!
228: 
229:     public Create{Entity}CommandHandler(
230:         I{Entity}Repository {entity}Repository,
231:         IMapper mapper,
232:         IValidator<Create{Entity}Dto> validator)  // ❌ BLOCKED - DI injection
233:     {
234:         _validator = validator;  // ❌ BLOCKED
235:     }
236: 
237:     public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>> Handle(...)
238:     {
239:         var validationResult = await _validator.ValidateAsync(request.{Entity}Dto);  // ❌ BLOCKED
240:         ...
241:     }
242: }
243: ```
244: 
245: **✅ Correct Pattern**: Validator instantiated with dependencies passed to constructor
246: 
247: **C# 12+ Primary Constructor (Preferred)**:
248: 
249: ```csharp
250: // ✅ CORRECT: Manual instantiation with primary constructor (C# 12+)
251: namespace {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Handlers.Commands;
252: 
253: using System.Linq;
254: using System.Threading;
255: using System.Threading.Tasks;
256: using AutoMapper;
257: using {Project}.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
258: using {Project}.Application.DTOs.{Entity}.Validators;
259: using {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Requests.Commands;
260: using {Project}.Application.Responses;
261: using {Project}.Domain;
262: using MediatR;
263: 
264: public class Create{Entity}CommandHandler(
265:     I{Entity}Repository {entity}Repository,
266:     I{RelatedEntity1}Repository {relatedEntity1}Repository,
267:     I{RelatedEntity2}Repository {relatedEntity2}Repository,
268:     IMapper mapper) : IRequestHandler<Create{Entity}Command, BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>>
269: {
270:     public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>> Handle(Create{Entity}Command request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
271:     {
272:         var response = new BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>();
273: 
274:         // ✅ CORRECT: Validator instantiated manually with all dependencies
275:         var validator = new Create{Entity}DtoValidator(
276:             {relatedEntity1}Repository,
277:             {relatedEntity2}Repository);
278: 
279:         var validationResult = await validator.ValidateAsync(request.{Entity}Dto, cancellationToken);
280: 
281:         if (!validationResult.IsValid)
282:         {
283:             response.Success = false;
284:             response.Message = "{Entity} creation failed.";
285:             response.Errors = validationResult.Errors.Select(e => e.ErrorMessage).ToList();
286:             return response;
287:         }
288: 
289:         // Map DTO to Entity
290:         var {entity} = mapper.Map<{Entity}>(request.{Entity}Dto);
291: 
292:         // Save through repository
293:         {entity} = await {entity}Repository.Create({entity});
294: 
295:         response.Success = true;
296:         response.Id = {entity}.Id;
297:         response.Message = "{Entity} created successfully.";
298: 
299:         return response;
300:     }
301: }
302: ```
303: 
304: **Traditional Constructor (Still Valid)**:
305: 
306: ```csharp
307: public class Create{Entity}CommandHandler : IRequestHandler<Create{Entity}Command, BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>>
308: {
309:     private readonly I{Entity}Repository _{entity}Repository;
310:     private readonly I{RelatedEntity1}Repository _{relatedEntity1}Repository;
311:     private readonly I{RelatedEntity2}Repository _{relatedEntity2}Repository;
312:     private readonly IMapper _mapper;
313: 
314:     public Create{Entity}CommandHandler(
315:         I{Entity}Repository {entity}Repository,
316:         I{RelatedEntity1}Repository {relatedEntity1}Repository,
317:         I{RelatedEntity2}Repository {relatedEntity2}Repository,
318:         IMapper mapper)
319:     {
320:         _{entity}Repository = {entity}Repository;
321:         _{relatedEntity1}Repository = {relatedEntity1}Repository;
322:         _{relatedEntity2}Repository = {relatedEntity2}Repository;
323:         _mapper = mapper;
324:     }
325:     // ... Handle method same as above
326: }
327: ```
328: 
329: ### Why Manual Instantiation?
330: 
331: 1. **Fine-grained dependency control**: Each validator receives specific repositories it needs
332: 2. **Prevents DI configuration issues**: No need to register validators in DI container
333: 3. **Simplifies testing**: Easy to create test validators with mocked repositories
334: 4. **Follows established pattern**: Consistent across all entity implementations
335: 
336: ### Validator Constructor Pattern
337: 
338: Validators MUST accept repositories in constructor for FK validation.
339: 
340: ```csharp
341: namespace {Project}.Application.DTOs.{Entity}.Validators;
342: 
343: using FluentValidation;
344: using {Project}.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
345: 
346: public class Create{Entity}DtoValidator : AbstractValidator<Create{Entity}Dto>
347: {
348:     private readonly I{RelatedEntity1}Repository _{relatedEntity1}Repository;
349:     private readonly I{RelatedEntity2}Repository _{relatedEntity2}Repository;
350: 
351:     public Create{Entity}DtoValidator(
352:         I{RelatedEntity1}Repository {relatedEntity1}Repository,
353:         I{RelatedEntity2}Repository {relatedEntity2}Repository)
354:     {
355:         _{relatedEntity1}Repository = {relatedEntity1}Repository;
356:         _{relatedEntity2}Repository = {relatedEntity2}Repository;
357: 
358:         // Standard validation rules
359:         RuleFor(x => x.Title)
360:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("Title is required")
361:             .MaximumLength(200);
362: 
363:         RuleFor(x => x.Description)
364:             .MaximumLength(5000)
365:             .When(x => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(x.Description));
366: 
367:         // Foreign key validation with repository
368:         RuleFor(x => x.{RelatedEntity1}Id)
369:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{RelatedEntity1} is required")
370:             .MustAsync(async (id, cancellation) =>
371:             {
372:                 var exists = await _{relatedEntity1}Repository.Exists(id);
373:                 return exists;
374:             })
375:             .WithMessage("{RelatedEntity1} not found");
376: 
377:         RuleFor(x => x.{RelatedEntity2}Id)
378:             .MustAsync(async (id, cancellation) =>
379:             {
380:                 if (!id.HasValue) return true;
381:                 return await _{relatedEntity2}Repository.Exists(id.Value);
382:             })
383:             .When(x => x.{RelatedEntity2}Id.HasValue)
384:             .WithMessage("{RelatedEntity2} not found");
385:     }
386: }
387: ```
388: 
389: ---
390: 
391: ## Deep Dive
392: 
393: For comprehensive guidance:
394: - **Dependency Matrix**: [dependency-rules.md](resources/dependency-rules.md)
395: - **Layer Responsibilities**: [layer-responsibilities.md](resources/layer-responsibilities.md)
396: - **Common Violations**: [violation-examples.md](resources/violation-examples.md)
397: - **Fix Patterns**: [fix-patterns.md](resources/fix-patterns.md)
398: 
399: ---
400: 
401: **Enforcement Level**: BLOCK (Violations are prevented)
402: **Override**: Add `@skip-architecture-check` comment in file (use sparingly)
````

## File: .claude/skills/cqrs-mediatr-guidelines/resources/complete-examples.md
````markdown
  1: # Complete Feature Example - Full CQRS Cycle
  2: 
  3: > **Project-Agnostic Complete Example**
  4: >
  5: > This document shows the **complete CQRS cycle** for a generic entity, demonstrating all patterns and conventions.
  6: > Placeholders use `{Placeholder}` syntax - see [docs/TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md](../../../../docs/TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md).
  7: 
  8: ---
  9: 
 10: ## Complete CQRS Cycle Overview
 11: 
 12: ```
 13: User Request → Controller → MediatR → Handler → Repository → Entity → Database
 14:                                ↓
 15:                           Validation (manual instantiation)
 16:                                ↓
 17:                           AutoMapper (Entity ↔ DTO)
 18:                                ↓
 19:                           Response (BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>)
 20: ```
 21: 
 22: ---
 23: 
 24: ## 1. Create Entity - Full Command Flow
 25: 
 26: ### Domain Entity
 27: 
 28: **File**: `{Project}.Domain/{Entity}.cs`
 29: 
 30: ```csharp
 31: using System;
 32: using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.Schema;
 33: 
 34: namespace {Project}.Domain;
 35: 
 36: public class {Entity}
 37: {
 38:     public {IdType} Id { get; set; }
 39: 
 40:     [ForeignKey("{LookupEntity}")]
 41:     public {LookupIdType} {LookupEntity}Id { get; set; }
 42:     public {LookupEntity} {LookupEntity} { get; set; }
 43: 
 44:     public string Title { get; set; }
 45:     public string? Description { get; set; }
 46: 
 47:     [ForeignKey("{RelatedEntity1}")]
 48:     public {LookupIdType} {RelatedEntity1}Id { get; set; }
 49:     public {RelatedEntity1} {RelatedEntity1} { get; set; }
 50: 
 51:     [ForeignKey("{RelatedEntity2}")]
 52:     public {LookupIdType} {RelatedEntity2}Id { get; set; }
 53:     public {RelatedEntity2} {RelatedEntity2} { get; set; }
 54: 
 55:     [ForeignKey("{ParentEntity}")]
 56:     public {IdType} {ParentEntity}Id { get; set; }
 57:     public {ParentEntity} {ParentEntity} { get; set; }
 58: 
 59:     public decimal? Price { get; set; }
 60:     public string? CurrencyCode { get; set; }
 61: 
 62:     [ForeignKey("FeaturedImage")]
 63:     public {IdType}? FeaturedImageId { get; set; }
 64:     public StorageObject? FeaturedImage { get; set; }
 65: 
 66:     public int ViewCount { get; set; }
 67:     public bool IsActive { get; set; }
 68:     public string? ExternalUrl { get; set; }
 69: 
 70:     [ForeignKey("Status")]
 71:     public {LookupIdType} StatusId { get; set; }
 72:     public Status Status { get; set; }
 73: 
 74:     [ForeignKey("Visibility")]
 75:     public {LookupIdType} VisibilityId { get; set; }
 76:     public Visibility Visibility { get; set; }
 77: 
 78:     [ForeignKey("Tenant")]
 79:     public {IdType} TenantId { get; set; }
 80:     public Tenant Tenant { get; set; }
 81: 
 82:     public string? Slug { get; set; }
 83:     public DateOnly? StartDate { get; set; }
 84:     public DateOnly? EndDate { get; set; }
 85:     public string? Timezone { get; set; }
 86: }
 87: ```
 88: 
 89: ### Create DTO
 90: 
 91: **File**: `{Project}.Application/DTOs/{Entity}/Create{Entity}Dto.cs`
 92: 
 93: ```csharp
 94: using System;
 95: 
 96: namespace {Project}.Application.DTOs.{Entity};
 97: 
 98: public class Create{Entity}Dto
 99: {
100:     public string Title { get; set; }
101:     public string? Description { get; set; }
102:     public string? Slug { get; set; }
103: 
104:     // Lookup references
105:     public {LookupIdType} {LookupEntity}Id { get; set; }
106:     public {LookupIdType} {RelatedEntity1}Id { get; set; }
107:     public {LookupIdType} {RelatedEntity2}Id { get; set; }
108: 
109:     // Optional parent reference
110:     public {IdType}? {ParentEntity}Id { get; set; }
111: 
112:     // Pricing
113:     public decimal? Price { get; set; }
114:     public string? CurrencyCode { get; set; }
115: 
116:     // Featured Image (optional)
117:     public {IdType}? FeaturedImageId { get; set; }
118: 
119:     // Configuration
120:     public bool IsActive { get; set; }
121:     public string? ExternalUrl { get; set; }
122: 
123:     // Status & Visibility (DTO defaults are OK; do not add defaults in Domain entities)
124:     public {LookupIdType} StatusId { get; set; } = 1;
125:     public {LookupIdType} VisibilityId { get; set; } = 1;
126: 
127:     // Date range
128:     public DateTimeOffset? StartDate { get; set; }
129:     public DateTimeOffset? EndDate { get; set; }
130:     public string? Timezone { get; set; }
131: 
132:     // TenantId is set by the handler from the authenticated context.
133: }
134: ```
135: 
136: ### Validator (CRITICAL: Manual Instantiation)
137: 
138: **File**: `{Project}.Application/DTOs/{Entity}/Validators/Create{Entity}DtoValidator.cs`
139: 
140: ```csharp
141: using FluentValidation;
142: using {Project}.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
143: 
144: namespace {Project}.Application.DTOs.{Entity}.Validators;
145: 
146: public class Create{Entity}DtoValidator : AbstractValidator<Create{Entity}Dto>
147: {
148:     private readonly I{RelatedEntity1}Repository _{relatedEntity1}Repository;
149:     private readonly I{RelatedEntity2}Repository _{relatedEntity2}Repository;
150:     private readonly I{LookupEntity}Repository _{lookupEntity}Repository;
151:     private readonly I{ParentEntity}Repository _{parentEntity}Repository;
152:     private readonly IStorageObjectRepository _storageObjectRepository;
153: 
154:     public Create{Entity}DtoValidator(
155:         I{RelatedEntity1}Repository {relatedEntity1}Repository,
156:         I{RelatedEntity2}Repository {relatedEntity2}Repository,
157:         I{LookupEntity}Repository {lookupEntity}Repository,
158:         I{ParentEntity}Repository {parentEntity}Repository,
159:         IStorageObjectRepository storageObjectRepository)
160:     {
161:         _{relatedEntity1}Repository = {relatedEntity1}Repository;
162:         _{relatedEntity2}Repository = {relatedEntity2}Repository;
163:         _{lookupEntity}Repository = {lookupEntity}Repository;
164:         _{parentEntity}Repository = {parentEntity}Repository;
165:         _storageObjectRepository = storageObjectRepository;
166: 
167:         // Title validation
168:         RuleFor(x => x.Title)
169:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("Title is required")
170:             .MaximumLength(200).WithMessage("Title cannot exceed 200 characters");
171: 
172:         // Lookup entity validation with async database check
173:         RuleFor(x => x.{LookupEntity}Id)
174:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{LookupEntity} is required")
175:             .MustAsync(async (id, cancellation) =>
176:             {
177:                 var exists = await _{lookupEntity}Repository.Exists(id);
178:                 return exists;
179:             })
180:             .WithMessage("{LookupEntity} not found");
181: 
182:         // Related entity 1 validation
183:         RuleFor(x => x.{RelatedEntity1}Id)
184:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{RelatedEntity1} is required")
185:             .MustAsync(async (id, cancellation) =>
186:             {
187:                 var exists = await _{relatedEntity1}Repository.Exists(id);
188:                 return exists;
189:             })
190:             .WithMessage("{RelatedEntity1} not found");
191: 
192:         // Related entity 2 validation
193:         RuleFor(x => x.{RelatedEntity2}Id)
194:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{RelatedEntity2} is required")
195:             .MustAsync(async (id, cancellation) =>
196:             {
197:                 var exists = await _{relatedEntity2}Repository.Exists(id);
198:                 return exists;
199:             })
200:             .WithMessage("{RelatedEntity2} not found");
201: 
202:         // Parent entity validation (optional)
203:         RuleFor(x => x.{ParentEntity}Id)
204:             .MustAsync(async (id, cancellation) =>
205:             {
206:                 if (!id.HasValue) return true;
207:                 return await _{parentEntity}Repository.Exists(id.Value);
208:             })
209:             .When(x => x.{ParentEntity}Id.HasValue)
210:             .WithMessage("{ParentEntity} does not exist.");
211: 
212:         RuleFor(x => x.FeaturedImageId)
213:             .MustAsync(async (id, cancellation) =>
214:             {
215:                 if (!id.HasValue) return true;
216:                 return await _storageObjectRepository.Exists(id.Value);
217:             })
218:             .When(x => x.FeaturedImageId.HasValue)
219:             .WithMessage("FeaturedImageId does not exist.");
220: 
221:         // Price validation
222:         RuleFor(x => x.Price)
223:             .GreaterThanOrEqualTo(0).When(x => x.Price.HasValue)
224:             .WithMessage("Price cannot be negative");
225: 
226:         // Currency validation
227:         RuleFor(x => x.CurrencyCode)
228:             .MaximumLength(3)
229:             .When(x => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(x.CurrencyCode))
230:             .WithMessage("Currency code must be 3 characters (ISO 4217)");
231:     }
232: }
233: ```
234: 
235: ### Command Request
236: 
237: **File**: `{Project}.Application/Features/{Entities}/Requests/Commands/Create{Entity}Command.cs`
238: 
239: ```csharp
240: using MediatR;
241: using {Project}.Application.DTOs.{Entity};
242: using {Project}.Application.Responses;
243: 
244: namespace {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Requests.Commands;
245: 
246: public class Create{Entity}Command : IRequest<BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>>
247: {
248:     public Create{Entity}Dto {Entity}Dto { get; set; }
249: }

251: 
252: ### Command Handler (CRITICAL: Shows All Patterns)
253: 
254: **File**: `{Project}.Application/Features/{Entities}/Handlers/Commands/Create{Entity}CommandHandler.cs`
255: 
256: ```csharp
257: using System;
258: using System.Linq;
259: using System.Threading;
260: using System.Threading.Tasks;
261: using AutoMapper;
262: using {Project}.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
263: using {Project}.Application.DTOs.{Entity}.Validators;
264: using {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Requests.Commands;
265: using {Project}.Application.Responses;
266: using {Project}.Domain;
267: using MediatR;
268: 
269: namespace {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Handlers.Commands;
270: 
271: public class Create{Entity}CommandHandler : IRequestHandler<Create{Entity}Command, BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>>
272: {
273:     private readonly I{Entity}Repository _{entity}Repository;
274:     private readonly I{RelatedEntity1}Repository _{relatedEntity1}Repository;
275:     private readonly I{RelatedEntity2}Repository _{relatedEntity2}Repository;
276:     private readonly I{LookupEntity}Repository _{lookupEntity}Repository;
277:     private readonly I{ParentEntity}Repository _{parentEntity}Repository;
278:     private readonly IStorageObjectRepository _storageObjectRepository;
279:     private readonly ITenantContext _tenantContext;
280:     private readonly IMapper _mapper;
281: 
282:     public Create{Entity}CommandHandler(
283:         I{Entity}Repository {entity}Repository,
284:         I{RelatedEntity1}Repository {relatedEntity1}Repository,
285:         I{RelatedEntity2}Repository {relatedEntity2}Repository,
286:         I{LookupEntity}Repository {lookupEntity}Repository,
287:         I{ParentEntity}Repository {parentEntity}Repository,
288:         IStorageObjectRepository storageObjectRepository,
289:         ITenantContext tenantContext,
290:         IMapper mapper)
291:     {
292:         _{entity}Repository = {entity}Repository;
293:         _{relatedEntity1}Repository = {relatedEntity1}Repository;
294:         _{relatedEntity2}Repository = {relatedEntity2}Repository;
295:         _{lookupEntity}Repository = {lookupEntity}Repository;
296:         _{parentEntity}Repository = {parentEntity}Repository;
297:         _storageObjectRepository = storageObjectRepository;
298:         _tenantContext = tenantContext;
299:         _mapper = mapper;
300:     }
301: 
302:     public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>> Handle(Create{Entity}Command request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
303:     {
304:         var response = new BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>();
305: 
306:         // CRITICAL: Manual validator instantiation with all dependencies
307:         var validator = new Create{Entity}DtoValidator(
308:             _{relatedEntity1}Repository,
309:             _{relatedEntity2}Repository,
310:             _{lookupEntity}Repository,
311:             _{parentEntity}Repository,
312:             _storageObjectRepository);
313: 
314:         var validationResult = await validator.ValidateAsync(request.{Entity}Dto, cancellationToken);
315: 
316:         if (!validationResult.IsValid)
317:         {
318:             response.Success = false;
319:             response.Message = "{Entity} creation failed.";
320:             response.Errors = validationResult.Errors.Select(e => e.ErrorMessage).ToList();
321:             return response;
322:         }
323: 
324:         // Map DTO to Entity using AutoMapper
325:         var {entity} = _mapper.Map<{Entity}>(request.{Entity}Dto);
326: 
327:         // Set properties not in DTO (system-generated values)
328:         {entity}.ViewCount = 0;
329:         {entity}.TenantId = _tenantContext.TenantId;
330: 
331:         // Save through repository
332:         {entity} = await _{entity}Repository.Create({entity});
333: 
334:         response.Success = true;
335:         response.Id = {entity}.Id;
336:         response.Message = "{Entity} created successfully.";
337: 
338:         return response;
339:     }
340: }
341: ```

347: ```csharp
348: using System;
349: using System.Collections.Generic;

351: using {Project}.Application.DTOs.{Entity};
352: using {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Requests.Commands;
353: using {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Requests.Queries;

362: namespace {Project}.API.Controllers;
363: 
364: [Route("api/v1/[controller]")]
365: [ApiController]
366: public class {Entity}Controller : ControllerBase
367: {
368:     private readonly IMediator _mediator;
369:     private readonly IHttpContextAccessor _httpContextAccessor;
370:     private readonly ILogger<{Entity}Controller> _logger;
371: 
372:     public {Entity}Controller(
373:         IMediator mediator,
374:         IHttpContextAccessor httpContextAccessor,
375:         ILogger<{Entity}Controller> logger)
376:     {
377:         _mediator = mediator;
378:         _httpContextAccessor = httpContextAccessor;
379:         _logger = logger;
380:     }
381: 
382:     // POST: api/v1/{entity}
383:     [HttpPost]
384:     [EndpointSummary("Create {Entity}")]
385:     [EndpointDescription("Creates a new {entity}. Requires authentication.")]
386:     [Authorize]  // CRITICAL: Write operations require authentication
387:     [Consumes("application/json")]
388:     [ProducesResponseType(typeof(BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>), Status200OK)]
389:     [ProducesResponseType(typeof(BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>), Status400BadRequest)]
390:     [ProducesResponseType(Status401Unauthorized)]
391:     public async Task<ActionResult<BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>>> Create([FromBody] Create{Entity}Dto dto)
392:     {
393:         var command = new Create{Entity}Command { {Entity}Dto = dto };
394:         var response = await _mediator.Send(command);
395: 
396:         if (!response.Success)
397:         {
398:             return BadRequest(response);
399:         }
400: 
401:         return Ok(response);
402:     }
403: 
404:     // GET: api/v1/{entity}
405:     [HttpGet]
406:     [EndpointSummary("List {Entities}")]
407:     [EndpointDescription("Returns a list of {entities}.")]
408:     [AllowAnonymous]  // CRITICAL: Read operations are public
409:     [ProducesResponseType(typeof(List<{Entity}ListDto>), Status200OK)]
410:     public async Task<ActionResult<List<{Entity}ListDto>>> GetAll()
411:     {
412:         var {entities} = await _mediator.Send(new Get{Entity}ListRequest());
413:         return Ok({entities});
414:     }
415: 
416:     // GET: api/v1/{entity}/{id}
417:     [HttpGet("{id}")]
418:     [EndpointSummary("Get {Entity} Details")]
419:     [EndpointDescription("Returns {entity} details.")]
420:     [AllowAnonymous]
421:     [ProducesResponseType(typeof({Entity}Dto), Status200OK)]
422:     [ProducesResponseType(Status404NotFound)]
423:     public async Task<ActionResult<{Entity}Dto>> GetById({IdType} id)
424:     {
425:         var {entity} = await _mediator.Send(new Get{Entity}DetailsRequest { Id = id });
426: 
427:         if ({entity} == null)
428:         {
429:             return NotFound(new { error = "{Entity} not found" });
430:         }
431: 
432:         return Ok({entity});
433:     }
434: 
435:     // GET: api/v1/{entity}/my
436:     [HttpGet("my")]
437:     [EndpointSummary("List My {Entities}")]
438:     [EndpointDescription("Returns {entities} owned by the current user.")]
439:     [Authorize]
440:     [ProducesResponseType(typeof(List<{Entity}ListDto>), Status200OK)]
441:     [ProducesResponseType(Status401Unauthorized)]
442:     public async Task<ActionResult<List<{Entity}ListDto>>> GetMy{Entities}()
443:     {
444:         // CRITICAL: UserId extraction with fallback pattern
445:         var userId = _httpContextAccessor.HttpContext?.User?.FindFirst("sub")?.Value
446:             ?? _httpContextAccessor.HttpContext?.User?.FindFirst("http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/ws/2005/05/identity/claims/nameidentifier")?.Value
447:             ?? _httpContextAccessor.HttpContext?.User?.FindFirst("sid")?.Value;
448: 
449:         if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(userId))
450:         {
451:             return Unauthorized(new { error = "User ID not found in token" });
452:         }
453: 
454:         var {entities} = await _mediator.Send(new GetMy{Entities}Request { UserId = userId });
455:         return Ok({entities});
456:     }
457: }
458: ```

585: using System;

600: ### Repository Implementation (Complex Include Chains)
601: 
602: **File**: `{Project}.Persistence/Repositories/{Entity}Repository.cs`
603: 
604: ```csharp
605: using System;
606: using System.Collections.Generic;
607: using System.Linq;
608: using System.Threading.Tasks;
609: using {Project}.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
610: using {Project}.Domain;
611: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
612: 
613: namespace {Project}.Persistence.Repositories;
614: 
615: public class {Entity}Repository : GenericRepository<{Entity}, {IdType}>, I{Entity}Repository
616: {
617:     private readonly {DbContext} _dbContext;
618: 
619:     public {Entity}Repository({DbContext} dbContext) : base(dbContext)
620:     {
621:         _dbContext = dbContext;
622:     }
623: 
624:     public async Task<List<{Entity}>> Get{Entities}WithDetails()
625:     {
626:         return await _dbContext.{Entities}
627:             .Include(e => e.{LookupEntity})
628:             .Include(e => e.{RelatedEntity1})
629:             .Include(e => e.{RelatedEntity2})
630:             .Include(e => e.{ParentEntity})
631:             .Include(e => e.Status)
632:             .Include(e => e.Visibility)
633:             .Include(e => e.FeaturedImage)
634:             .ToListAsync();
635:     }
636: 
637:     public async Task<{Entity}?> Get{Entity}WithDetails({IdType} id)
638:     {
639:         return await _dbContext.{Entities}
640:             .Include(e => e.{LookupEntity})
641:             .Include(e => e.{RelatedEntity1})
642:             .Include(e => e.{RelatedEntity2})
643:             .Include(e => e.{ParentEntity})
644:             .Include(e => e.Status)
645:             .Include(e => e.Visibility)
646:             .Include(e => e.FeaturedImage)
647:             .FirstOrDefaultAsync(e => e.Id == id);
648:     }
649: 
650:     public async Task<List<{Entity}>> GetMy{Entities}WithDetails(string userId)
651:     {
652:         {IdType} userIdParsed;
653:         var isValid = {IdType}.TryParse(userId, out userIdParsed);
654: 
655:         var query = _dbContext.{Entities}
656:             .Include(e => e.{LookupEntity})
657:             .Include(e => e.{RelatedEntity1})
658:             .Include(e => e.{RelatedEntity2})
659:             .Include(e => e.{ParentEntity})
660:             .Include(e => e.Status)
661:             .Include(e => e.Visibility)
662:             .Include(e => e.FeaturedImage)
663:             .AsQueryable();
664: 
665:         if (isValid)
666:         {
667:             query = query.Where(e =>
668:                 _dbContext.Users.Any(u => u.Id == userIdParsed && u.{ParentEntity}Id == e.{ParentEntity}Id));
669:         }
670: 
671:         return await query.ToListAsync();
672:     }
673: }
674: ```

708: ## Key Patterns Demonstrated
709: 
710: ### 1. **Manual Validator Instantiation** ⚠️
711: ```csharp
712: // CRITICAL: Validators are instantiated with dependencies in handlers
713: var validator = new Create{Entity}DtoValidator(
714:     _{relatedEntity1}Repository,
715:     _{relatedEntity2}Repository,
716:     _{lookupEntity}Repository,
717:     _{parentEntity}Repository,
718:     _storageObjectRepository);
719: ```
720: 
721: ### 2. **Repository Returns Entities, Not DTOs** ⚠️
722: ```csharp
723: // Repository returns entities
724: var {entities} = await _{entity}Repository.Get{Entities}WithDetails();
725: 
726: // Handler maps to DTOs using AutoMapper
727: return _mapper.Map<List<{Entity}ListDto>>({entities});
728: ```
729: 
730: ### 3. **BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}> for Commands** ⚠️
731: ```csharp
732: public class Create{Entity}Command : IRequest<BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>>
733: {
734:     public Create{Entity}Dto {Entity}Dto { get; set; }
735: }
736: ```
737: 
738: ### 4. **Authorization Pattern** ⚠️
739: ```csharp
740: [HttpGet]
741: [AllowAnonymous]  // Public read access
742: 
743: [HttpPost]
744: [Authorize]  // Authenticated write access
745: ```
746: 
747: ### 5. **UserId Extraction with Fallback** ⚠️
748: ```csharp
749: var userId = _httpContextAccessor.HttpContext?.User?.FindFirst("sub")?.Value
750:     ?? _httpContextAccessor.HttpContext?.User?.FindFirst("http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/ws/2005/05/identity/claims/nameidentifier")?.Value
751:     ?? _httpContextAccessor.HttpContext?.User?.FindFirst("sid")?.Value;
752: ```
753: 
754: ### 6. **Complex EF Core Include Chains** ⚠️
755: ```csharp
756: return await _dbContext.{Entities}
757:     .Include(e => e.{ParentEntity})
758:     .Include(e => e.{LookupEntity})
759:     .Include(e => e.FeaturedImage)
760:     .ToListAsync();
761: ```

765: This complete example shows **every layer** of the CQRS cycle, from domain entity to API controller, with all critical patterns highlighted.
