````csharp
598: 
599: 
600:             using var httpClient = _httpClientFactory.CreateClient("BffClient");
601:             var response = await httpClient.GetAsync($"/api/v1/StorageObject/presigned-url-by-key/{objectKey}?expirationMinutes=60");
602: 
603:             if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
604:             {
605:                 var presignedResponse = await response.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<PresignedDownloadUrlResponse>();
606:                 if (presignedResponse != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(presignedResponse.PresignedUrl))
607:                 {
608:                     return presignedResponse.PresignedUrl;
609:                 }
610:             }
611: 
612:             _logger.LogWarning("Failed to get presigned URL for object key: {ObjectKey}, Status: {StatusCode}", objectKey, response.StatusCode);
613:             return null;
614:         }
615:         catch (Exception ex)
616:         {
617:             _logger.LogError(ex, "Error getting presigned URL");
618:             return null;
619:         }
620:     }
621: 
622: 
623: 
624: 
625:     public async Task<string?> GetPresignedUrlByIdAsync(Guid storageObjectId)
626:     {
627:         try
628:         {
629:             using var httpClient = _httpClientFactory.CreateClient("BffClient");
630:             var response = await httpClient.GetAsync($"/api/v1/StorageObject/{storageObjectId}/presigned-url?expirationMinutes=60");
631: 
632:             if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
633:             {
634:                 var presignedResponse = await response.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<PresignedDownloadUrlResponse>();
635:                 if (presignedResponse != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(presignedResponse.PresignedUrl))
636:                 {
637:                     return presignedResponse.PresignedUrl;
638:                 }
639:             }
640: 
641:             _logger.LogWarning("Failed to get presigned URL for storage object ID: {Id}, Status: {StatusCode}", storageObjectId, response.StatusCode);
642:             return null;
643:         }
644:         catch (Exception ex)
645:         {
646:             _logger.LogError(ex, "Error getting presigned URL by ID");
647:             return null;
648:         }
649:     }
650: 
651: 
652:     public async Task<bool> DeleteImageAsync(string imageKey)
653:     {
654:         try
655:         {
656: 
657:             _logger.LogWarning("Delete not implemented for: {ImageKey}", imageKey);
658:             return false;
659:         }
660:         catch (Exception ex)
661:         {
662:             _logger.LogError(ex, "Error deleting image");
663:             return false;
664:         }
665:     }
666: 
667: 
668:     public async Task<string> GenerateLocalPreviewAsync(IBrowserFile file, long maxFileSize = 5 * 1024 * 1024)
669:     {
670:         try
671:         {
672:             var resizedImage = await file.RequestImageFileAsync(file.ContentType, 400, 400);
673:             using var stream = resizedImage.OpenReadStream(maxFileSize);
674:             using var memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
675:             await stream.CopyToAsync(memoryStream);
676:             var bytes = memoryStream.ToArray();
677:             return $"data:{file.ContentType};base64,{Convert.ToBase64String(bytes)}";
678:         }
679:         catch (Exception ex)
680:         {
681:             _logger.LogError(ex, "Error generating preview");
682:             return string.Empty;
683:         }
684:     }
685: 
686: 
687:     public string GenerateLocalPreviewFromBytes(FileUploadData fileData)
688:     {
689:         if (fileData == null || fileData.Content.Length == 0)
690:         {
691:             _logger.LogWarning("GenerateLocalPreviewFromBytes called with null or empty file data");
692:             return string.Empty;
693:         }
694: 
695:         try
696:         {
697:             return $"data:{fileData.ContentType};base64,{Convert.ToBase64String(fileData.Content)}";
698:         }
699:         catch (Exception ex)
700:         {
701:             _logger.LogError(ex, "Error generating preview from bytes");
702:             return string.Empty;
703:         }
704:     }
705: 
706:     private int GetFileTypeId(string contentType)
707:     {
708:         return contentType.ToLower() switch
709:         {
710:             "image/jpeg" or "image/jpg" => 1,
711:             "image/png" => 2,
712:             "image/gif" => 3,
713:             "image/webp" => 4,
714:             "image/svg+xml" => 5,
715:             _ => 1
716:         };
717:     }
718: }
719: 
720: 
721: internal class BaseCommandResponse
722: {
723:     public bool Success { get; set; }
724:     public string? Message { get; set; }
725:     public Guid Id { get; set; }
726:     public List<string>? Errors { get; set; }
727: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Pages/Organization/OrganizationMembers.razor
````razor
  1: @using MudBlazor
  2: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients
  3: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services
  4: @using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Authorization
  5: @using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components
  6: @using Blazouter.Services
  7: 
  8: <PageTitle>Organization Members</PageTitle>
  9: 
 10: <MudContainer MaxWidth="MaxWidth.ExtraLarge" Class="py-8">
 11:     <div class="d-flex justify-space-between align-center flex-wrap gap-4 mb-6">
 12:         <MudStack Row AlignItems="AlignItems.Center" Spacing="3">
 13:             <MudAvatar Color="Color.Primary" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Rounded="true">
 14:                 <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.People" />
 15:             </MudAvatar>
 16:             <div>
 17:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.h4" Style="font-weight: 800;">Organization Members</MudText>
 18:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Secondary">Manage access and roles for your organization</MudText>
 19:             </div>
 20:         </MudStack>
 21: 
 22:         @if (RoleHelper.CanManage(currentUserRole))
 23:         {
 24:             <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled" Color="Color.Primary" OnClick="OpenInviteDialog" StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.PersonAdd" Class="rounded-pill">
 25:                 Invite Member
 26:             </MudButton>
 27:         }
 28:     </div>
 29: 
 30:     @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_errorMessage))
 31:     {
 32:         <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Error" Variant="Variant.Filled" Class="mb-6 rounded-lg" ShowCloseIcon="true" CloseIconClicked="@(() => _errorMessage = null)">
 33:             @_errorMessage
 34:         </MudAlert>
 35:     }
 36: 
 37:     <MudPaper Elevation="0" Class="pa-4 border-solid border-1 mud-border-lines-default rounded-xl overflow-hidden">
 38:         <div class="d-flex gap-4 mb-6 flex-wrap">
 39:             <MudTextField @bind-Value="_searchString"
 40:                           Placeholder="Search members..."
 41:                           Adornment="Adornment.Start"
 42:                           AdornmentIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Search"
 43:                           Immediate="true"
 44:                           Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 45:                           Margin="Margin.Dense"
 46:                           Class="rounded-pill"
 47:                           Style="max-width: 400px;"/>
 48: 
 49:             <MudSelect T="int?" Label="Role" @bind-Value="_roleFilter" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Margin="Margin.Dense" AnchorOrigin="Origin.BottomCenter" Style="min-width: 150px;" Clearable="true" Class="rounded-pill">
 50:                 @foreach (var role in RoleHelper.GetAllOrgRoles())
 51:                 {
 52:                     <MudSelectItem Value="(int?)role.Id">@role.Name</MudSelectItem>
 53:                 }
 54:             </MudSelect>
 55:         </div>
 56: 
 57:         <MudTable Items="@FilteredMembers" Hover="true" Loading="@_loading" Striped="true" Elevation="0" Class="border-none" Breakpoint="Breakpoint.Sm">
 58:             <HeaderContent>
 59:                 <MudTh>User</MudTh>
 60:                 <MudTh>Email</MudTh>
 61:                 <MudTh>Role</MudTh>
 62:                 @if (RoleHelper.CanManage(currentUserRole))
 63:                 {
 64:                     <MudTh Style="text-align:right">Actions</MudTh>
 65:                 }
 66:             </HeaderContent>
 67:             <RowTemplate>
 68:                 <MudTd DataLabel="User">
 69:                     <div class="d-flex align-center gap-3">
 70:                         <MudAvatar Color="Color.Secondary" Size="Size.Small" Variant="Variant.Filled">@(string.IsNullOrEmpty(context.UserEmail) ? "?" : context.UserEmail.Substring(0, 1).ToUpper())</MudAvatar>
 71:                         @if (context.UserId == Guid.Empty)
 72:                         {
 73:                             <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Style="font-style: italic;" Color="Color.Secondary">Pending Invite</MudText>
 74:                         }
 75:                         else
 76:                         {
 77:                             <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Style="font-weight: 600;">@(context.UserFullName ?? context.UserEmail)</MudText>
 78:                         }
 79:                     </div>
 80:                 </MudTd>
 81:                 <MudTd DataLabel="Email">
 82:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.body2">@context.UserEmail</MudText>
 83:                 </MudTd>
 84:                 <MudTd DataLabel="Role">
 85:                     <MudChip T="string" Color="@GetRoleColor(context.OrganizationRoleId ?? 0)" Size="Size.Small" Variant="Variant.Filled">@GetRoleName(context.OrganizationRoleId ?? 0)</MudChip>
 86:                 </MudTd>
 87:                 @if (RoleHelper.CanManage(currentUserRole))
 88:                 {
 89:                     <MudTd DataLabel="Actions" Style="text-align:right">
 90:                         @if (context.OrganizationRoleId != RoleHelper.OrgCreator)
 91:                         {
 92:                             <MudMenu Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.MoreVert" Size="Size.Small" Dense="true" AnchorOrigin="Origin.BottomRight" TransformOrigin="Origin.TopRight">
 93:                                 <MudMenuItem OnClick="@(() => OpenEditRoleDialog(context))" Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Edit">Change Role</MudMenuItem>
 94:                                 <MudMenuItem OnClick="@(() => RemoveMember(context))" Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Delete" IconColor="Color.Error">Remove</MudMenuItem>
 95:                             </MudMenu>
 96:                         }
 97:                     </MudTd>
 98:                 }
 99:             </RowTemplate>
100:             <NoRecordsContent>
101:                 <div class="d-flex flex-column align-center justify-center pa-8">
102:                     <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.PersonSearch" Size="Size.Large" Color="Color.Default" />
103:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.h6" Class="mt-2" Style="font-weight: 700;">No members found</MudText>
104:                 </div>
105:             </NoRecordsContent>
106:         </MudTable>
107:     </MudPaper>
108: </MudContainer>
````

````csharp
263:     public async Task<bool> CanDeleteEventAsync(Guid eventId)
264:     {
265:         try
266:         {
267:             var eventResource = await _apiClient.GetEventByIdAsync(eventId);
268:             if (eventResource?.ActorId is null) return false;
269: 
270:             var actorResource = await _apiClient.GetActorByIdAsync(eventResource.ActorId.Value);
271:             if (actorResource?.OrganizationId is null) return true;
272: 
273:             var myOrgs = await _organizationService.GetMyOrganizationsAsync();
274:             return myOrgs?.Any(o => o.Id == actorResource.OrganizationId.Value) ?? false;
275:         }
276:         catch (Exception ex)
277:         {
278:             _logger.LogError(ex, "Error checking CanDeleteEvent for {EventId}", eventId);
279:             return false;
280:         }
281:     }
````

````razor
  1: @*

  8:               __dropdown-item, __dropdown-overlay

 12: <div class="navbar">

 16:             @if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_brandLogoUrl))

 18:                 <MudImage Src="@_brandLogoUrl" Alt="@_brandDisplayName" Class="navbar__brand-icon" Width="28" Height="28" />
 19:             }

 23:             }

 25:         </a>
 26: 
 27:         <!-- Global Search -->
 28:         <div class="navbar__search">

 44:                 Events
 45:             </NavLink>
 46: 
 47:             @* Dynamic tenant navigation links *@
 48:             @foreach (var link in _navigationLinks.OrderBy(l => l.Order))
 49:             {

 51: 
 52:                 @if (link.OpenInNewTab == true)

 55:                         <MudIcon Icon="@icon" Size="Size.Small" Class="mr-2" />
 56:                         @link.Label
````

````razor
 64:                     <MudAvatar Color="Color.Primary" Size="Size.Large" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Class="mb-6" Style="width: 80px; height: 80px;">

 69:                 </MudPaper>

 71:             <MudItem xs="12" md="4">
 72:                 <MudPaper Elevation="0" Class="pa-8 rounded-xl border-solid border-1 mud-border-lines-default h-100 d-flex flex-column align-center text-center">
 73:                     <MudAvatar Color="Color.Secondary" Size="Size.Large" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Class="mb-6" Style="width: 80px; height: 80px;">
 74:                         <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Handshake" Size="Size.Large" />
 75:                     </MudAvatar>
 76:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.h6" Style="font-weight: 700;" Class="mb-2">Meet & Connect</MudText>
 77:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Secondary">Make meaningful connections, collaborate on projects, and expand your network locally.</MudText>
 78:                 </MudPaper>

 83:                         <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.VolunteerActivism" Size="Size.Large" />
 84:                     </MudAvatar>
 85:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.h6" Style="font-weight: 700;" Class="mb-2">Act & Give Back</MudText>
 86:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Secondary">Take part in charity drives, social causes, and community-building initiatives.</MudText>
 87:                 </MudPaper>
 88:             </MudItem>
 89:         </MudGrid>
 90:     </MudContainer>
 91: 
 92:     <!-- UPCOMING -->
 93:     <MudContainer MaxWidth="MaxWidth.ExtraLarge" Class="mb-16">
 94:         <MudStack AlignItems="AlignItems.Center" Spacing="2" Class="mb-8 text-center">
 95:             <MudText Typo="Typo.overline" Color="Color.Primary">UPCOMING</MudText>
 96:             <MudText Typo="Typo.h4" Style="font-weight: 700;">Don't Miss These Events</MudText>
 97:         </MudStack>
 98: 
 99:         @if (_isLoading)
100:         {
101:             <div class="d-flex justify-center py-12">
102:                 <MudProgressCircular Color="Color.Primary" Indeterminate="true" />
103:             </div>
104:         }
105:         else if (_events.Any())
106:         {
107:             <MudCarousel TData="object" AutoCycle="true" CycleInterval="7000" ShowArrows="true" ShowBullets="true" Style="height: 460px;">
108:                 @foreach (var chunk in Chunk(_events, 3))
109:                 {
110:                     <MudCarouselItem Transition="Transition.Slide" Color="Color.Transparent">
111:                         <div class="d-flex justify-center gap-6 px-12 h-100 align-center">
112:                             @foreach (var evt in chunk)
113:                             {
114:                                 <MudCard @key="evt.Id" Elevation="0" Class="border-solid border-1 mud-border-lines-default rounded-xl overflow-hidden d-flex flex-column h-100 cursor-pointer hover:mud-elevation-4 transition-all" Style="flex: 1; max-width: 400px;" @onclick="@(() => ScrollToRegister())">
115:                                     <div style="height: 200px; background-color: var(--mud-palette-background-grey); position: relative;">
116:                                         @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(evt.FeaturedImageUri))
117:                                         {
118:                                             <MudImage Src="@evt.FeaturedImageUri" ObjectFit="ObjectFit.Cover" Style="width: 100%; height: 100%;" />
119:                                         }
120:                                         else
121:                                         {
122:                                             <div class="d-flex justify-center align-center h-100">
123:                                                 <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Image" Size="Size.Large" Color="Color.Secondary" />
124:                                             </div>
125:                                         }
126:                                         <div class="absolute pa-3 d-flex gap-2" style="top: 0; left: 0;">
127:                                             <MudChip T="string" Color="Color.Primary" Size="Size.Small" Variant="Variant.Filled">@(evt.EventTypeFullName ?? "Event")</MudChip>
128:                                         </div>
129:                                     </div>
130:                                     <MudCardContent Class="flex-grow-1 d-flex flex-column pa-4">
131:                                         <MudText Typo="Typo.h6" Class="mb-2" Style="font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.3;">@evt.Title</MudText>
132:                                         <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Secondary" Class="mb-4 flex-grow-1">@TruncateText(evt.Description, 100)</MudText>
133:                                         <MudButton Variant="Variant.Text" Color="Color.Primary" EndIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.ArrowForward" Class="align-self-start px-0">View Details</MudButton>
134:                                     </MudCardContent>
135:                                 </MudCard>
136:                             }
137:                         </div>
138:                     </MudCarouselItem>
139:                 }
140:             </MudCarousel>
141:         }
142:         else
143:         {
144:             <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Info" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Class="justify-center">No upcoming events found.</MudAlert>
145:         }
146:     </MudContainer>
147: 
148:     <!-- FAQ -->
149:     <MudContainer MaxWidth="MaxWidth.Medium" Class="mb-16">
150:         <MudText Typo="Typo.h5" Align="Align.Center" Style="font-weight: 700;" Class="mb-8">Frequently Asked Questions</MudText>
151:         <MudExpansionPanels Elevation="0" Class="rounded-xl border-solid border-1 mud-border-lines-default overflow-hidden">
152:             <MudExpansionPanel Text="Is registration free?">
153:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body2">Yes, signing up is completely free. Some events might have a fee, but most are open to everyone.</MudText>
154:             </MudExpansionPanel>
155:             <MudExpansionPanel Text="How are events selected?">
156:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body2">We carefully verify organizers and feature only trustworthy, relevant, and community-oriented events.</MudText>
157:             </MudExpansionPanel>
158:             <MudExpansionPanel Text="Can I cancel my participation?">
159:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body2">Absolutely. You can cancel any event with one click from your dashboard.</MudText>
160:             </MudExpansionPanel>
161:         </MudExpansionPanels>
162:     </MudContainer>
163: 
164:     <!-- FINAL CTA -->
165:     <MudContainer MaxWidth="MaxWidth.Large" Class="mb-12" id="register">
166:         <MudPaper Elevation="0" Class="rounded-xl pa-12 text-center" Style="background: var(--mud-palette-primary-darken); color: white;">
167:             <MudText Typo="Typo.h4" Style="font-weight: 800;" Class="mb-4">Ready to Join?</MudText>
168:             <MudText Typo="Typo.h6" Style="opacity: 0.9; font-weight: 400;" Class="mb-8">Create your account now and get full access to all upcoming events.</MudText>
169:             <div class="d-flex justify-center gap-4">
170:                 <MudButton Href="/login" Variant="Variant.Filled" Color="Color.Surface" Size="Size.Large" Style="color: var(--mud-palette-primary-darken); font-weight: 700;" Class="rounded-pill px-8">Sign Up Now</MudButton>
171:             </div>
172:         </MudPaper>
173:     </MudContainer>
174: </div>
````

````razor
298:     private IEnumerable<Guid?> selectedTagIds = new HashSet<Guid?>();

315:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
316:     {
317:         var eventIdStr = RouterState.GetParam("eventId");
318:         if (Guid.TryParse(eventIdStr, out var id))
319:         {
320:             EventId = id;
321:         }
322: 
323:         try
324:         {
325:             isLoading = true;
326: 
327:             var eventTypesTask = AdminService.GetEventTypesAsync();
328:             var eventFormatsTask = AdminService.GetEventFormatsAsync();
329:             var eventStatusesTask = AdminService.GetEventStatusesAsync();
330:             var visibilityTypesTask = AdminService.GetVisibilityTypesAsync();
331:             var madhabsTask = AdminService.GetMadhabsAsync();
332: 
333:             await Task.WhenAll(eventTypesTask, eventFormatsTask, eventStatusesTask, visibilityTypesTask, madhabsTask);
334: 
335:             eventTypes = await eventTypesTask;
336:             eventFormats = await eventFormatsTask;
337:             eventStatuses = await eventStatusesTask;
338:             visibilityTypes = await visibilityTypesTask;
339:             madhabs = await madhabsTask;
340: 
341:             currentEvent = await EventService.GetEventByIdAsync(EventId);
342: 
343:             if (currentEvent != null)
344:             {
345:                 updateDto = new UpdateEventDto
346:                 {
347:                     Id = currentEvent.Id,
348:                     Title = currentEvent.Title,
349:                     Subtitle = currentEvent.Subtitle,
350:                     Description = currentEvent.Description,
351:                     AudienceGenderId = currentEvent.AudienceGenderId,
352:                     AudienceAgeId = currentEvent.AudienceAgeId,
353:                     ActorId = currentEvent.ActorId,
354:                     Price = currentEvent.Price,
355:                     CurrencyCode = currentEvent.CurrencyCode,
356:                     FeaturedImageId = currentEvent.FeaturedImageId,
357:                     IsRegistrationRequired = currentEvent.IsRegistrationRequired,
358:                     ExternalRegistrationUrl = currentEvent.EventUrl,
359:                     EventTypeId = currentEvent.EventTypeId,
360:                     EventFormatId = currentEvent.EventFormatId,
361:                     EventStatusId = currentEvent.EventStatusId,
362:                     VisibilityTypeId = currentEvent.VisibilityTypeId,
363:                     FirstSessionDate = currentEvent.FirstSessionDate,
364:                     LastSessionDate = currentEvent.LastSessionDate,
365:                     MetadataJson = currentEvent.MetadataJson
366:                 };
367:                 _appearance = EventAppearanceMetadataHelper.Parse(currentEvent.MetadataJson);
368: 
369:                 if (currentEvent.FirstSessionDate.HasValue)
370:                 {
371:                     var localStart = currentEvent.FirstSessionDate.Value.LocalDateTime;
372:                     _startDate = localStart.Date;
373:                     _startTime = localStart.TimeOfDay;
374:                 }
375: 
376:                 if (currentEvent.LastSessionDate.HasValue)
377:                 {
378:                     var localEnd = currentEvent.LastSessionDate.Value.LocalDateTime;
379:                     _endDate = localEnd.Date;
380:                     _endTime = localEnd.TimeOfDay;
381:                 }
382: 
383:                 _isOnline = currentEvent.EventFormatId == 2;
384:                 _previewImageUrl = currentEvent.FeaturedImageUri ?? GeneratePlaceholderImage();
385:                 selectedMadhabId = currentEvent.MadhabId;
386:                 selectedTimezone = currentEvent.Timezone;
387: 
388:                 var allCategoriesTask = CategoryService.GetAllCategoriesAsync();
389:                 var allTagsTask = TagService.GetAllTagsAsync();
390:                 var eventCategoriesTask = CategoryService.GetCategoriesByEventAsync(EventId);
391:                 var eventTagsTask = TagService.GetTagsByEventAsync(EventId);
392:                 var sessionsTask = EventService.GetSessionsByEventAsync(EventId);
393: 
394:                 await Task.WhenAll(allCategoriesTask, allTagsTask, eventCategoriesTask, eventTagsTask, sessionsTask);
395: 
396:                 allCategories = await allCategoriesTask;
397:                 allTags = await allTagsTask;
398:                 existingCategoriesRaw = await eventCategoriesTask;
399:                 existingTagsRaw = await eventTagsTask;
400:                 var eventSessions = await sessionsTask;
401: 
402:                 selectedCategoryIds = new HashSet<Guid?>();
403:                 selectedTagIds = new HashSet<Guid?>();
404: 
405:                 sessions = eventSessions?.Select(s => SessionEditorModel.FromDto(s)).ToList() ?? new List<SessionEditorModel>();
406:             }
407:             else
408:             {
409:                 _errorMessage = "Event not found";
410:             }
411:         }
412:         catch (Exception ex)
413:         {
414:             _errorMessage = $"Error loading event: {ex.Message}";
415:         }
416:         finally
417:         {
418:             isLoading = false;
419:         }

422:     private string GeneratePlaceholderImage()
423:     {
424:         if (currentEvent == null) return string.Empty;
425:         var eventTitle = Uri.EscapeDataString(currentEvent.Title ?? "Event");
426:         return $"https://via.placeholder.com/400x250/607D8B/ffffff?text={eventTitle}";
427:     }
428: 
429:     private async Task HandleValidSubmit()
430:     {
431:         if (updateDto == null) return;
432: 
433:         if (_isUploadingImage)
434:         {
435:             _errorMessage = "Please wait for the image upload to complete.";
436:             return;
437:         }
438: 
439:         try
440:         {
441:             updateDto.FirstSessionDate = DateTimeHelper.CombineDateTimeToUtc(_startDate, _startTime);
442:             updateDto.LastSessionDate = DateTimeHelper.CombineDateTimeToUtc(_endDate, _endTime);
443: 
444:             if (_uploadedStorageObjectId.HasValue)
445:             {
446:                 updateDto.FeaturedImageId = _uploadedStorageObjectId.Value;
447:             }
448: 
449:             updateDto.MetadataJson = EventAppearanceMetadataHelper.Upsert(updateDto.MetadataJson, _appearance);
450: 
451:             if (!updateDto.Id.HasValue)
452:             {
453:                 _errorMessage = "Event ID is missing";
454:                 return;
455:             }
456:             var response = await EventService.UpdateEventAsync(updateDto.Id.Value, updateDto);
457: 
458:             if (response?.Success == true)
459:             {
460:                 Navigation.NavigateTo("/myevents");
461:             }
462:             else
463:             {
464:                 _errorMessage = response?.Message ?? "Failed to update event";
465:             }
466:         }
467:         catch (Exception ex)
468:         {
469:             Logger.LogError(ex, "Unexpected error updating event");
470:             _errorMessage = $"Error updating event: {ex.Message}";
471:         }
472:     }
473: 
474:     private void NavigateBack()
475:     {
476:         Navigation.NavigateTo("/myevents");
477:     }
478: 
479:     private async Task OnImageFileDataSelected(FileUploadData? fileData)
480:     {
481:         _selectedFileData = fileData;
482:         _uploadError = null;
483: 
484:         if (fileData == null)
485:         {
486:             return;
487:         }
488: 
489:         _isUploadingImage = true;
490:         await InvokeAsync(StateHasChanged);
491: 
492:         try
493:         {
494:             var uploadResult = await ImageStorageService.UploadAndCreateRecordFromBytesAsync(fileData);
495: 
496:             if (uploadResult?.Success == true)
497:             {
498:                 _uploadedStorageObjectId = uploadResult.StorageObjectId;
499:                 _uploadError = null;
500:             }
501:             else
502:             {
503:                 _uploadError = uploadResult?.ErrorMessage ?? "Failed to upload image.";
504:                 await ClearUploadState();
505:             }
506:         }
507:         catch (Exception ex)
508:         {
509:             _uploadError = $"Upload error: {ex.Message}";
510:             await ClearUploadState();
511:         }
512:         finally
513:         {
514:             _isUploadingImage = false;
515:             await InvokeAsync(StateHasChanged);
516:         }
517:     }
518: 
519:     private async Task ClearUploadState()
520:     {
521:         try
522:         {
523:             if (_imageUploadComponent != null)
524:             {
525:                 await _imageUploadComponent.RemoveImage();
526:             }
527:         }
528:         catch { }
529: 
530:         _selectedFileData = null;
531:         if (currentEvent != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(currentEvent.FeaturedImageUri))
532:         {
533:             _previewImageUrl = currentEvent.FeaturedImageUri;
534:         }
535:         else
536:         {
537:             _previewImageUrl = GeneratePlaceholderImage();
538:         }
539:     }
540: 
541:     private void AddSession()
542:     {
543:         sessions.Add(new SessionEditorModel
544:         {
545:             StartTime = _startDate?.Date.Add(_startTime ?? TimeSpan.Zero) ?? DateTime.Today.AddHours(9),
546:             EndTime = _endDate?.Date.Add(_endTime ?? TimeSpan.Zero) ?? DateTime.Today.AddHours(17)
547:         });
548:     }
549: 
550:     private void RemoveSession(int index)
551:     {
552:         if (sessions.Count > 0 && index >= 0 && index < sessions.Count)
553:         {
554:             sessions.RemoveAt(index);
555:         }
556:     }
557: 
558:     private void OnSessionChanged(int index, SessionEditorModel session)
559:     {
560:         if (index >= 0 && index < sessions.Count)
561:         {
562:             sessions[index] = session;
563:         }
564:     }
565: 
566:     private string GetCategorySelectionText(List<string> selectedValues)
567:     {
568:         if (selectedValues == null || !selectedValues.Any()) return "Select categories";
569:         return $"{selectedValues.Count} categor{(selectedValues.Count == 1 ? "y" : "ies")} selected";
570:     }
571: 
572:     private string GetTagSelectionText(List<string> selectedValues)
573:     {
574:         if (selectedValues == null || !selectedValues.Any()) return "Select tags";
575:         return $"{selectedValues.Count} tag{(selectedValues.Count == 1 ? "" : "s")} selected";
576:     }
577: }
````

````razor
129:                                         {
130:                                             <MudMenuItem OnClick="@(() => ViewRegistrations(evt))">
131:                                                 <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.People" Class="mr-2" Size="Size.Small" /> Registrations
132:                                             </MudMenuItem>
133:                                             <MudMenuItem OnClick="@(() => DeleteEvent(evt))" Class="text-error">
134:                                                 <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Delete" Class="mr-2" Size="Size.Small" /> Delete
135:                                             </MudMenuItem>
136:                                         }
137:                                     </MudMenu>
138:                                 </div>
139: 
140:                                 <MudCardMedia Image="@GetEventImageUrl(evt)" Height="200" />
141:                                 
142:                                 <MudCardContent Class="flex-grow-1">
143:                                     <MudText Typo="Typo.button" Class="mud-text-disabled mb-1">@(evt.EventTypeFullName ?? "Event")</MudText>
144:                                     <MudText Typo="Typo.h6" Class="mb-4">@evt.Title</MudText>
145:                                     <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Style="overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 3; -webkit-box-orient: vertical;">
146:                                         @evt.Description
147:                                     </MudText>
148:                                     
149:                                     <div class="d-flex align-center gap-2 mt-4">
150:                                         <MudChip T="string" Size="Size.Small" Color="Color.Info" Variant="Variant.Outlined" StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Business">
151:                                             @(evt.ActorDisplayName ?? "Unknown")
152:                                         </MudChip>
153:                                         <div class="d-flex align-center gap-1 ml-auto">
154:                                             <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.LocationOn" Size="Size.Small" Color="Color.Secondary" />
155:                                             <MudText Typo="Typo.caption" Color="Color.Secondary">@(evt.EventFormatFullName ?? "Online")</MudText>
156:                                         </div>
157:                                     </div>
158:                                 </MudCardContent>
159: 
160:                                 <MudCardActions>
161:                                     <MudButton Variant="Variant.Text"
162:                                                Color="Color.Primary"
163:                                                Href="@($"/event/detail/{evt.Id}")"
164:                                                EndIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.ArrowForward">
165:                                         Details
166:                                     </MudButton>
167:                                     <MudSpacer />
168:                                     @if (CanEditEvent(evt))
169:                                     {
170:                                         <MudButton Variant="Variant.Text" Color="Color.Secondary" StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Edit" OnClick="@(() => EditEvent(evt))">Edit</MudButton>
171:                                     }
172:                                 </MudCardActions>
173:                             </MudCard>
174:                         </MudItem>
175:                     </ItemContent>
176:                     <Placeholder>
177:                         <MudItem xs="12" sm="6" md="4">
178:                             <MudCard Class="h-100 d-flex flex-column">
179:                                 <MudSkeleton SkeletonType="SkeletonType.Rectangle" Height="200px" />
180:                                 <MudCardContent>
181:                                     <MudSkeleton Width="40%" Class="mb-1" />
182:                                     <MudSkeleton Width="80%" Class="mb-4" />
183:                                     <MudSkeleton Width="100%" />
184:                                     <MudSkeleton Width="60%" />
185:                                 </MudCardContent>
186:                             </MudCard>
187:                         </MudItem>
188:                     </Placeholder>
189:                 </Virtualize>
190:             </MudGrid>
191: 
192:             <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Align="Align.Center" Color="Color.Secondary" Class="mt-8 mb-8">
193:                 @AllFilteredEvents.Count event(s)
194:             </MudText>
195:         }
196:     }
197: </MudContainer>
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Pages/Admin/AdminList.razor
````razor
  1: @page "/admin"
  2: @using MudBlazor
  3: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Components.Admin
  4: @using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization
  5: @attribute [Authorize]
  6: @attribute [StreamRendering]
  7: 
  8: <MudContainer MaxWidth="MaxWidth.ExtraLarge" Class="py-8">
  9: 
 10:     <!-- HERO -->
 11:     <MudPaper Elevation="0" Class="pa-6 mb-6 rounded-xl relative overflow-hidden" Style="background: radial-gradient(circle at 20% 10%, rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.15), transparent 60%), linear-gradient(180deg, var(--mud-palette-surface), var(--mud-palette-background)); border: 1px solid var(--mud-palette-lines-default);">
 12:         <div class="d-flex justify-space-between align-center flex-wrap gap-4">
 13:             <div class="d-flex align-center gap-4">
 14:                 <MudAvatar Rounded="true" Size="Size.Large" Color="Color.Primary" Variant="Variant.Filled">
 15:                     <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.AdminPanelSettings" Size="Size.Medium" />
 16:                 </MudAvatar>
 17:                 <div>
 18:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.h4" Style="font-weight: 800;">Admin Dashboard</MudText>
 19:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.body1" Color="Color.Secondary">Review and action incoming organization requests</MudText>
 20:                 </div>
 21:             </div>
 22:             <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled" Color="Color.Primary" StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Refresh" OnClick="LoadOrganizationRequests" Class="rounded-pill px-6">Refresh</MudButton>
 23:         </div>
 24: 
 25:         <MudGrid Class="mt-6" Spacing="3">
 26:             <MudItem xs="12" sm="4">
 27:                 <MudCard Elevation="0" Class="pa-4 border-solid border-1 mud-border-lines-default rounded-lg">
 28:                     <div class="d-flex align-center gap-4">
 29:                         <MudAvatar Rounded="true" Color="Color.Info" Variant="Variant.Outlined">
 30:                             <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.HourglassBottom" />
 31:                         </MudAvatar>
 32:                         <div>
 33:                             <MudText Typo="Typo.caption" Color="Color.Secondary">Pending</MudText>
 34:                             <MudText Typo="Typo.h5" Style="font-weight: 700;">@PendingCount</MudText>
 35:                         </div>
 36:                     </div>
 37:                 </MudCard>
 38:             </MudItem>
 39:             <MudItem xs="12" sm="4">
 40:                 <MudCard Elevation="0" Class="pa-4 border-solid border-1 mud-border-lines-default rounded-lg">
 41:                     <div class="d-flex align-center gap-4">
 42:                         <MudAvatar Rounded="true" Color="Color.Success" Variant="Variant.Outlined">
 43:                             <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.CheckCircle" />
 44:                         </MudAvatar>
 45:                         <div>
 46:                             <MudText Typo="Typo.caption" Color="Color.Secondary">Approved</MudText>
 47:                             <MudText Typo="Typo.h5" Style="font-weight: 700;">@ApprovedCount</MudText>
 48:                         </div>
 49:                     </div>
 50:                 </MudCard>
 51:             </MudItem>
 52:             <MudItem xs="12" sm="4">
 53:                 <MudCard Elevation="0" Class="pa-4 border-solid border-1 mud-border-lines-default rounded-lg">
 54:                     <div class="d-flex align-center gap-4">
 55:                         <MudAvatar Rounded="true" Color="Color.Error" Variant="Variant.Outlined">
 56:                             <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Cancel" />
 57:                         </MudAvatar>
 58:                         <div>
 59:                             <MudText Typo="Typo.caption" Color="Color.Secondary">Rejected</MudText>
 60:                             <MudText Typo="Typo.h5" Style="font-weight: 700;">@RejectedCount</MudText>
 61:                         </div>
 62:                     </div>
 63:                 </MudCard>
 64:             </MudItem>
 65:         </MudGrid>
 66:     </MudPaper>
 67: 
 68:     @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_errorMessage))
 69:     {
 70:         <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Error" Variant="Variant.Filled" Class="mb-4">@_errorMessage</MudAlert>
 71:     }
 72: 
 73:     <!-- SETTINGS -->
 74:     <div class="mb-8">
 75:         <MudText Typo="Typo.h5" Class="mb-4" Style="font-weight: 700;">Settings</MudText>
 76:         <MudGrid Spacing="3">
 77:             <MudItem xs="12" sm="6" md="4">
 78:                 <MudCard Elevation="0" Class="pa-4 cursor-pointer hover-elevation-4 transition-all border-solid border-1 mud-border-lines-default rounded-lg" @onclick="@(() => Nav.NavigateTo("/admin/instance/settings"))">
 79:                     <div class="d-flex justify-space-between align-start mb-2">
 80:                         <MudAvatar Rounded="true" Color="Color.Primary" Variant="Variant.Outlined">
 81:                             <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Dns" />
 82:                         </MudAvatar>
 83:                         <MudChip T="string" Size="Size.Small" Color="Color.Primary" Variant="Variant.Text">Settings</MudChip>
 84:                     </div>
 85:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.h6" Class="mt-2">Instance Settings</MudText>

208:                 <MudCard Elevation="0" Class="pa-4 cursor-pointer hover-elevation-4 transition-all border-solid border-1 mud-border-lines-default rounded-lg" @onclick="@(() => Nav.NavigateTo("/admin/madhabs"))">
209:                     <div class="d-flex justify-space-between align-start mb-2">
210:                         <MudAvatar Rounded="true" Color="Color.Secondary" Variant="Variant.Outlined">
211:                             <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.MenuBook" />
212:                         </MudAvatar>
213:                         <MudChip T="string" Size="Size.Small" Variant="Variant.Text">View</MudChip>
214:                     </div>
215:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.h6" Class="mt-2">Madhabs</MudText>
216:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.caption" Color="Color.Secondary">Schools of thought</MudText>
217:                 </MudCard>
218:             </MudItem>
219:         </MudGrid>
220:     </div>
221: 
222:     @if (_isLoading)
223:     {
224:         <div class="d-flex flex-column align-center justify-center py-12">
225:             <MudProgressCircular Color="Color.Primary" Size="Size.Large" Indeterminate="true" />
226:             <MudText Typo="Typo.body1" Class="mt-4" Color="Color.Secondary">Loading organization requests...</MudText>
227:         </div>
228:     }
229:     else
230:     {
231:         <MudPaper Elevation="0" Class="pa-4 border-solid border-1 mud-border-lines-default rounded-xl">
232:             <div class="d-flex justify-space-between align-center flex-wrap gap-4 mb-4">
233:                 <div>
234:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.h5" Style="font-weight: 700;">Admin Management</MudText>
235:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Secondary">Showing oldest first • @_organizationRequests.Count requests</MudText>
236:                 </div>
237: 
238:                 <div class="d-flex gap-2 align-center flex-wrap">
239:                     <MudTextField @bind-Value="_search"
240:                                   Placeholder="Search..."
241:                                   Adornment="Adornment.Start"
242:                                   AdornmentIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Search"
243:                                   Variant="Variant.Outlined"
244:                                   Margin="Margin.Dense"
245:                                   Class="rounded-pill"
246:                                   Style="background: var(--mud-palette-surface);" />
247: 
248:                     <MudSelect @bind-Value="_sort" Label="Sort" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Margin="Margin.Dense" Dense="true" Style="min-width: 150px;">
249:                         <MudSelectItem Value="SortOption.OldestFirst">Oldest first</MudSelectItem>
250:                         <MudSelectItem Value="SortOption.NewestFirst">Newest first</MudSelectItem>
251:                         <MudSelectItem Value="SortOption.Name">Name</MudSelectItem>
252:                         <MudSelectItem Value="SortOption.Status">Status</MudSelectItem>
253:                     </MudSelect>
254:                 </div>
255:             </div>
256: 
257:             <MudTabs @bind-ActivePanelIndex="_activeTab" Elevation="0" Rounded="true" ApplyEffectsToContainer="true" Color="Color.Primary" Class="mt-4">
258:                 <MudTabPanel Text="@($"All ({_organizationRequests.Count})")">
259:                     <AdminOrganizationTable Items="GetFilteredAndSorted(null)"
260:                                             OnApprove="Approve"
261:                                             OnReject="Reject"
262:                                             OnRevert="RevertToPending"
263:                                             OnViewDetails="ViewDetails"
264:                                             OnClearFilters="ClearFilters" />
265:                 </MudTabPanel>
266:                 <MudTabPanel Text="@($"Pending ({PendingCount})")">
267:                     <AdminOrganizationTable Items="GetFilteredAndSorted(RequestStatus.Pending)"
268:                                             OnApprove="Approve"
269:                                             OnReject="Reject"
270:                                             OnRevert="RevertToPending"
271:                                             OnViewDetails="ViewDetails"
272:                                             OnClearFilters="ClearFilters" />
273:                 </MudTabPanel>
274:                 <MudTabPanel Text="@($"Approved ({ApprovedCount})")">
275:                     <AdminOrganizationTable Items="GetFilteredAndSorted(RequestStatus.Approved)"
276:                                             OnApprove="Approve"
277:                                             OnReject="Reject"
278:                                             OnRevert="RevertToPending"
279:                                             OnViewDetails="ViewDetails"
280:                                             OnClearFilters="ClearFilters" />
281:                 </MudTabPanel>
282:                 <MudTabPanel Text="@($"Rejected ({RejectedCount})")">
283:                     <AdminOrganizationTable Items="GetFilteredAndSorted(RequestStatus.Rejected)"
284:                                             OnApprove="Approve"
285:                                             OnReject="Reject"
286:                                             OnRevert="RevertToPending"
287:                                             OnViewDetails="ViewDetails"
288:                                             OnClearFilters="ClearFilters" />
289:                 </MudTabPanel>
290:             </MudTabs>
291:         </MudPaper>
292:     }
293: 
294: </MudContainer>
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Pages/Event/EventList.razor
````razor
  1: @page "/events"
  2: @using MudBlazor
  3: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients
  4: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services
  5: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Components.Event
  6: @using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components
  7: @using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Web.Virtualization
  8: @using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging
  9: @attribute [StreamRendering]
 10: 
 11: <PageTitle>Explore Events</PageTitle>
 12: 
 13: <MudContainer Class="event-list-container pb-8">
 14:     @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_errorMessage))
 15:     {
 16:         <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Error" Variant="Variant.Filled" Class="mb-6 rounded-lg" ShowCloseIcon="true" CloseIconClicked="@(() => _errorMessage = null)">
 17:             @_errorMessage
 18:         </MudAlert>
 19:     }
 20:     @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_successMessage))
 21:     {
 22:         <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Success" Variant="Variant.Filled" Class="mb-6 rounded-lg" ShowCloseIcon="true" CloseIconClicked="@(() => _successMessage = null)">
 23:             @_successMessage
 24:         </MudAlert>
 25:     }
 26: 
 27:     <!-- Filter Bar Component -->
 28:     <EventFilterBar @ref="_filterBar"
 29:                     IsIslamicModuleEnabled="@_isIslamicModuleEnabled"
 30:                     IsTechModuleEnabled="@_isTechModuleEnabled"
 31:                     OnFilterChanged="@RefreshList"
 32:                     EventTypes="@eventTypes"
 33:                     Categories="@categories"
 34:                     Locations="@locations"
 35:                     EventFormats="@eventFormats"
 36:                     Madhabs="@madhabs"
 37:                     RegistrationModes="@registrationModes"
 38:                     Languages="@languages"
 39:                     Tags="@tags"
 40:                     AudienceGenders="@audienceGenders"
 41:                     AudienceAges="@audienceAges"
 42:                     EventStatuses="@eventStatuses" />
 43: 
 44:     <MudGrid Spacing="4">
 45:         @if (isLoading && !_dataLoaded)
 46:         {
 47:             <!-- Skeleton Loading State -->
 48:             @for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++)
 49:             {
 50:                 <MudItem xs="12" sm="6" md="4" lg="3">
 51:                     <MudCard Class="h-100 d-flex flex-column rounded-xl border-solid border-1 mud-border-lines-default" Elevation="0">
 52:                         <MudSkeleton SkeletonType="SkeletonType.Rectangle" Height="200px" />
 53:                         <MudCardContent>
 54:                             <MudSkeleton Width="30%" Height="20px" Class="mb-2" />
 55:                             <MudSkeleton Width="80%" Height="30px" Class="mb-4" />
 56:                             <MudSkeleton Width="100%" Height="20px" />
 57:                             <MudSkeleton Width="100%" Height="20px" />
 58:                         </MudCardContent>
 59:                     </MudCard>
 60:                 </MudItem>
 61:             }
 62:         }
 63:         else
 64:         {
 65:             <Virtualize @ref="_virtualize" ItemsProvider="LoadEventsAsync" OverscanCount="4" Context="evt">
 66:                 <ItemContent>
 67:                     <MudItem @key="evt.Id" xs="12" sm="6" md="4" lg="3">
 68:                         <MudCard Class="h-100 d-flex flex-column rounded-xl hover:mud-elevation-0 transition-all event-card" Outlined="true" Elevation="0" Style="overflow: hidden; background-color: var(--mud-palette-surface);">
 69:                             <MudCardMedia Image="@(string.IsNullOrEmpty(evt.FeaturedImageUri) ? GetEventImage(evt) : evt.FeaturedImageUri)" Height="200" />
 70: 
 71:                             <MudCardContent Class="d-flex flex-column flex-grow-1 pt-4 pb-2 px-4">
 72:                                 <div class="d-flex justify-space-between align-center mb-2">
 73:                                     <MudChip T="string" Size="Size.Small" Color="Color.Primary" Variant="Variant.Text" Class="ml-n1 font-weight-bold">@GetEventTypeName(evt)</MudChip>
 74:                                     @if (evt.IsUserReported == true)
 75:                                     {
 76:                                         <MudTooltip Text="Community Reported">
 77:                                             <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Person" Size="Size.Small" Color="Color.Info" />
 78:                                         </MudTooltip>
 79:                                     }
 80:                                 </div>
 81: 
 82:                                 <MudText Typo="Typo.h6" Style="font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.2; overflow: hidden; display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; min-height: 2.4em;" Class="mb-1">
 83:                                     @evt.Title
 84:                                 </MudText>
 85: 
 86:                                 @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(evt.Subtitle))
 87:                                 {
 88:                                     <MudText Typo="Typo.subtitle2" Color="Color.Primary" Style="font-weight: 500; overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis;" Class="mb-2">
 89:                                         @evt.Subtitle
 90:                                     </MudText>
 91:                                 }
 92:                                 else
 93:                                 {
 94:                                     <div style="height: 1.25rem;" class="mb-2"></div> <!-- Spacer to keep alignment -->
 95:                                 }
 96: 
 97:                                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Secondary" Style="overflow: hidden; display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 3; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; min-height: 4.5em;">
 98:                                     @GetTruncatedDescription(evt.Description)
 99:                                 </MudText>
100: 
101:                                 <MudDivider Class="mt-auto mb-2" />
102: 
103:                                 <div class="d-flex justify-space-between align-center">
104:                                     <MudText Typo="Typo.caption" Color="Color.Secondary">
105:                                         @(evt.FirstSessionDate?.ToString("MMM dd") ?? "TBD")
106:                                     </MudText>
107:                                     <MudText Typo="Typo.caption" Color="Color.Secondary">
108:                                         @GetLocationText(evt)
109:                                     </MudText>
110:                                 </div>
111:                             </MudCardContent>
112: 
113:                             <MudCardActions Class="px-2 pb-2">
114:                                 <MudButton Variant="Variant.Text" Color="Color.Primary" FullWidth="true" EndIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.ArrowForward" OnClick="@(() => Navigation.NavigateTo($"/event/detail/{evt.Id}"))">
115:                                     Details
116:                                 </MudButton>
117: 
118:                                 @if (IsUserRegistered(evt.Id ?? Guid.Empty))
119:                                 {
120:                                     <MudIconButton Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.EventAvailable" Color="Color.Success" Title="Registered" Disabled="true" />
121:                                 }
122:                                 else
123:                                 {
124:                                     <MudIconButton Icon="@Icons.Material.Outlined.AddCircleOutline" Color="Color.Secondary" OnClick="@(() => OpenQuickRegisterDialog(evt))" Title="Quick Register" />
125:                                 }
126:                             </MudCardActions>
127:                         </MudCard>
128:                     </MudItem>
129:                 </ItemContent>
130:                 <Placeholder>
131:                     <MudItem xs="12" sm="6" md="4" lg="3">
132:                         <MudCard Class="h-100 d-flex flex-column rounded-xl border-solid border-1 mud-border-lines-default" Elevation="0">
133:                             <MudSkeleton SkeletonType="SkeletonType.Rectangle" Height="200px" />
134:                             <MudCardContent>
135:                                 <MudSkeleton Width="30%" Height="20px" Class="mb-2" />
136:                                 <MudSkeleton Width="80%" Height="30px" Class="mb-4" />
137:                                 <MudSkeleton Width="100%" Height="20px" />
138:                                 <MudSkeleton Width="100%" Height="20px" />
139:                             </MudCardContent>
140:                         </MudCard>
141:                     </MudItem>
142:                 </Placeholder>
143:             </Virtualize>
144:         }
145:     </MudGrid>
146: 
147:     @if (_eventsLoaded && _totalCount == 0)
148:     {
149:         <div class="d-flex flex-column align-center justify-center py-16">
150:             <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.EventBusy" Size="Size.Large" Color="Color.Secondary" Class="mb-4" />
151:             <MudText Typo="Typo.h5" Color="Color.Secondary" Align="Align.Center">No events found</MudText>
152:             <MudText Typo="Typo.body1" Color="Color.Secondary" Align="Align.Center" Class="mt-2">
153:                 Try adjusting your filters or search query
154:             </MudText>
155:         </div>
156:     }
157: 
158:     @if (_totalCount > 0)
159:     {
160:         <MudText Typo="Typo.caption" Align="Align.Center" Color="Color.Secondary" Class="d-block mb-8">
161:             @_totalCount events found
162:         </MudText>
163:     }
164: 
165: </MudContainer>
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Pages/Organization/OrganizationProfile.razor
````razor
  1: @using MudBlazor
  2: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services
  3: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients
  4: @using Blazouter.Services
  5: @using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging
  6: @attribute [StreamRendering]
  7: 
  8: <PageTitle>Organization Profile</PageTitle>
  9: <MudContainer Class="organization-profile">
 10:     @if (_isLoading)
 11:     {
 12:         <MudProgressCircular Color="Color.Primary" Indeterminate="true" />
 13:     }
 14:     else if (_organization == null)
 15:     {
 16:         <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Error">Organization not found.</MudAlert>
 17:     }
 18:     else
 19:     {
 20:         <MudContainer MaxWidth="MaxWidth.Large" Class="organization-profile">
 21:             <!-- Header Section -->
 22:             <div class="organization-profile__header-section mb-6">
 23:                 <MudCard Elevation="0" Class="organization-profile__header-card">
 24:                     <div class="organization-profile__banner" style="@_bannerStyle"></div>
 25:                     <div class="organization-profile__header-content">
 26:                         <div class="organization-profile__avatar-wrapper">
 27:                             @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_organization.ActorProfilePictureUri))
 28:                             {
 29:                                 <MudImage Src="@_organization.ActorProfilePictureUri"
 30:                                           Alt="@($"{_organization.FullName} Logo")"
 31:                                           Class="organization-profile__avatar-image"
 32:                                           ObjectFit="ObjectFit.Cover" />
 33:                             }
 34:                             else
 35:                             {
 36:                                 <MudImage Src="@GetOrganizationPlaceholder()"
 37:                                           Alt="Organization Logo"
 38:                                           Class="organization-profile__avatar-image"
 39:                                           ObjectFit="ObjectFit.Cover" />
 40:                             }
 41:                         </div>
 42: 
 43:                         <div class="organization-profile__info">
 44:                             <div class="d-flex align-center gap-2 mb-1">
 45:                                 <MudText Typo="Typo.h4" Style="font-weight: 700;">@_organization.FullName</MudText>
 46:                                 @if (_organization.ApprovalStatusId == 2)
 47:                                 {
 48:                                     <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Verified" Color="Color.Primary" Title="Verified" Size="Size.Small" />
 49:                                 }
 50:                             </div>
 51: 
 52:                             <div class="d-flex align-center gap-4 mb-4 flex-wrap">
````

````razor
 90:                     </MudItem>

100:                             </MudCardContent>
101:                         </MudCard>
102:                     </MudItem>
103:                 </Placeholder>
104:             </Virtualize>
105:         </MudGrid>

107: </MudContainer>
````
